समय \(= \frac{d}{60} + \frac{2d}{90} = d\left(\frac{3 + 4}{180}\right) = \frac{7d}{180}\)
औसत चाल \(= \frac{3d}{7d/180} = \frac{540}{7}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{540}{7}}\) km/घंटा

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): \(\frac{540}{7}\) km/घंटा है।

question.en: A vehicle has a running speed of 88 km/h, but due to frequent halts, its average speed reduces to 66 km/h. Find the time it stops in one hour. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक वाहन की चलने की चाल 88 km/घंटा है, परंतु बार-बार रुकने के कारण उसकी औसत चाल 66 km/घंटा हो जाती है। एक घंटे में उसके रुकने का समय ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Stoppage time per hour \(= 60\left(1 - \frac{66}{88}\right)\)
\(= 60 \times \frac{22}{88} = 60 \times \frac{1}{4}\)
\(= \boxed{15}\) minutes

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 15 minutes.
solution.hi:
प्रति घंटा रुकने का समय \(= 60\left(1 - \frac{66}{88}\right)\)
\(= 60 \times \frac{22}{88} = 60 \times \frac{1}{4}\)
\(= \boxed{15}\) मिनट

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 15 मिनट है।

tests.title: CGL 2026 Time Speed and Distance PART-2

listing.title: CGL 2026 Time Speed and Distance PART-2

meta.title: SSC 2026 MATH TIME SPEED AND DISTANCE

question.en: Due to headwind, a drone took 2 hours to fly from City A to City B and 3 hours to return. If 72 km/h was the average speed for the entire journey, what was the distance (one way) between the two cities? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: प्रतिकूल हवा के कारण एक ड्रोन को शहर A से शहर B तक उड़ने में 2 घंटे और वापस आने में 3 घंटे लगे। यदि पूरी यात्रा की औसत चाल 72 km/घंटा थी, तो दोनों शहरों के बीच की दूरी (एक ओर) क्या थी? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let the one-way distance be \(d\) km
Total distance \(= 2d\), total time \(= 2 + 3 = 5\) hours
Average speed \(= \frac{2d}{5} = 72\)
\(2d = 360 \Rightarrow d = \boxed{180}\) km

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 180 km.
solution.hi:
एक ओर की दूरी \(d\) km मानिए
कुल दूरी \(= 2d\), कुल समय \(= 2 + 3 = 5\) घंटे
औसत चाल \(= \frac{2d}{5} = 72\)
\(2d = 360 \Rightarrow d = \boxed{180}\) km

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 180 km है।

question.en: A man travels to his destination at 60% of his normal walking speed and arrives 1 hour 40 minutes later than usual. Find his normal time (in hours) taken to reach the destination. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति अपनी सामान्य चाल के 60% से अपने गंतव्य तक जाता है और सामान्य समय से 1 घंटा 40 मिनट देरी से पहुँचता है। गंतव्य तक पहुँचने में उसका सामान्य समय (घंटों में) ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
At 60% of the speed, the time taken becomes \(\frac{T}{0.6} = \frac{5T}{3}\)
Extra time \(= \frac{5T}{3} - T = \frac{2T}{3} = 1\frac{2}{3}\) hours
\(T = \frac{5}{3} \times \frac{3}{2} = \boxed{2.5}\) hours

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 2.5 hours.
solution.hi:
चाल 60% होने पर लगने वाला समय \(\frac{T}{0.6} = \frac{5T}{3}\)
अतिरिक्त समय \(= \frac{5T}{3} - T = \frac{2T}{3} = 1\frac{2}{3}\) घंटे
\(T = \frac{5}{3} \times \frac{3}{2} = \boxed{2.5}\) घंटे

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 2.5 घंटे है।

question.en: A student goes to coaching at 6 km/hr and returns at 4 km/hr. If the total journey takes 4 hours, find the distance between home and coaching center. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक विद्यार्थी कोचिंग जाने में 6 km/घंटा और वापस आने में 4 km/घंटा की चाल से चलता है। यदि कुल यात्रा में 4 घंटे लगते हैं, तो घर और कोचिंग केंद्र के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let the distance be \(d\) km
\(\frac{d}{6} + \frac{d}{4} = 4 \Rightarrow \frac{2d + 3d}{12} = 4\)
\(\frac{5d}{12} = 4 \Rightarrow d = \frac{48}{5} = \boxed{9.6\ \text{km}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 9.6 km.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए दूरी \(d\) km है
\(\frac{d}{6} + \frac{d}{4} = 4 \Rightarrow \frac{2d + 3d}{12} = 4\)
\(\frac{5d}{12} = 4 \Rightarrow d = \frac{48}{5} = \boxed{9.6\ \text{km}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 9.6 km है।

question.en: A train travels a certain distance at a uniform speed. If the speed of the train is increased by 10 km/h, it takes 2 hours less than the scheduled time. If the speed of the train is further increased by another 10 km/h, it takes a further 45 minutes less than the reduced time. Find the distance (in km) covered by the train. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक रेलगाड़ी एक निश्चित दूरी एकसमान चाल से तय करती है। यदि रेलगाड़ी की चाल 10 km/घंटा बढ़ा दी जाए तो निर्धारित समय से 2 घंटे कम लगते हैं। यदि चाल में 10 km/घंटा और बढ़ा दी जाए तो घटे हुए समय से 45 मिनट और कम लगते हैं। रेलगाड़ी द्वारा तय की गई दूरी (km में) ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let the speed be \(v\) and the distance be \(D\)
\(\frac{D}{v} - \frac{D}{v+10} = 2\) and \(\frac{D}{v+10} - \frac{D}{v+20} = \frac{45}{60} = \frac{3}{4}\)
Writing \(D = \frac{2v(v+10)}{10}\) in the second equation: \(\frac{2v(v+10)}{10}\left(\frac{1}{v+10} - \frac{1}{v+20}\right) = \frac{3}{4}\)
\(\frac{2v}{10} \times \frac{10}{v+20} = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \frac{2v}{v+20} = \frac{3}{4}\)
\(8v = 3v + 60 \Rightarrow v = 12\) km/h, so \(D = \frac{2(12)(22)}{10} = \boxed{52.8\ \text{km}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 52.8 km.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए चाल \(v\) और दूरी \(D\) है
\(\frac{D}{v} - \frac{D}{v+10} = 2\) तथा \(\frac{D}{v+10} - \frac{D}{v+20} = \frac{45}{60} = \frac{3}{4}\)
पहले से \(D = \frac{2v(v+10)}{10}\) रखने पर: \(\frac{2v(v+10)}{10}\left(\frac{1}{v+10} - \frac{1}{v+20}\right) = \frac{3}{4}\)
\(\frac{2v}{10} \times \frac{10}{v+20} = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \frac{2v}{v+20} = \frac{3}{4}\)
\(8v = 3v + 60 \Rightarrow v = 12\) km/h, अतः \(D = \frac{2(12)(22)}{10} = \boxed{52.8\ \text{km}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 52.8 km है।

question.en: If a train takes 20 seconds to cross a platform of 180 m and the train's length is 120 m, what is its speed? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि कोई रेलगाड़ी 180 m के प्लेटफॉर्म को पार करने में 20 सेकंड लेती है और रेलगाड़ी की लंबाई 120 m है, तो उसकी गति क्या है? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Total distance \(= 180 + 120 = 300\) m
Speed \(= \frac{300}{20} = 15\) m/s
\(= 15 \times \frac{18}{5} = \boxed{54\ \text{km/h}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 54 km/h.

question.en:
A 240 m long train passes a man walking at 6 km/h in the opposite direction in 12 seconds.
Find the train's speed. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
240 m लंबी एक ट्रेन विपरीत दिशा में 6 km/h की चाल से चल रहे एक व्यक्ति को 12 सेकंड में पार करती है।
ट्रेन की चाल ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Relative speed (opposite direction) = \(\frac{240}{12} = 20\) m/s
\(20 \times \frac{18}{5} = 72\) km/h
Train's speed = \(72 - 6 = \boxed{66}\) km/h

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 66 km/h.
solution.hi:
सापेक्ष चाल (विपरीत दिशा) = \(\frac{240}{12} = 20\) m/s
\(20 \times \frac{18}{5} = 72\) km/h
ट्रेन की चाल = \(72 - 6 = \boxed{66}\) km/h

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 66 km/h है।

question.en: Working alone, Pipe P can fill 15% of a tank in 4 hours, and Pipe Q can fill 18% of the same tank in 4 hours. If both pipes are opened together, what percentage of the tank will be filled in 4 hours? [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: अकेले कार्य करते हुए, पाइप P एक टंकी का 15% भाग 4 घंटे में भर सकता है और पाइप Q उसी टंकी का 18% भाग 4 घंटे में भर सकता है। यदि दोनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाएँ, तो 4 घंटे में टंकी का कितना प्रतिशत भर जाएगा? [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
In 4 hours P fills 15% and Q fills 18%
Together in 4 hours \(= 15\% + 18\% = 33\%\)
\(= \boxed{33\%}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 33%.

question.en: A cistern has three taps M, N and P, through which water can be taken out from it. Tap M can fill 6 buckets in 30 minutes, tap N can fill 8 buckets in 1 hour 4 minutes and tap P can fill 2 buckets in 20 minutes. When the cistern is filled upto 4/5th of its capacity, all the three taps are opened together, as a result of which the cistern gets emptied in 2 hours 40 minutes. What is the capacity of the cistern if each bucket is identical and can hold 8 liters of water (assuming there is no wastage of water)? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक टंकी में तीन नल M, N और P हैं जिनसे पानी निकाला जा सकता है। नल M, 30 मिनट में 6 बाल्टियाँ भर सकता है, नल N, 1 घंटे 4 मिनट में 8 बाल्टियाँ और नल P, 20 मिनट में 2 बाल्टियाँ भर सकता है। जब टंकी अपनी क्षमता के 4/5 भाग तक भरी हो, तो तीनों नल एक साथ खोल दिए जाते हैं, जिससे टंकी 2 घंटे 40 मिनट में खाली हो जाती है। यदि प्रत्येक बाल्टी समान है और 8 लीटर पानी रख सकती है, तो टंकी की क्षमता क्या है (पानी की कोई बर्बादी नहीं)? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Rates: M \(= \frac{6}{30} = 0.2\) b/min, N \(= \frac{8}{64} = 0.125\) b/min, P \(= \frac{2}{20} = 0.1\) b/min
Together \(= 0.425\) buckets/min; in 160 min \(= 68\) buckets
\(\frac{4}{5}C = 68 \Rightarrow C = 85\) buckets
Capacity \(= 85 \times 8 = \boxed{680\ \text{Lts}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 680 Lts.

question.en: A tank is connected to 15 pipes. Some of these are inlet pipes, while the remaining are outlet pipes. An inlet pipe alone can fill the tank in 8 hrs. On the other hand, an outlet pipe alone can empty the tank in 6 hrs. The tank is emptied in 6 hrs if all the pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is exactly full. Find out how many of the pipes are outlet pipes. [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक टंकी 15 पाइपों से जुड़ी है। इनमें से कुछ भरने वाले पाइप और शेष निकालने वाले पाइप हैं। एक भरने वाला पाइप अकेला टंकी को 8 घंटे में भर सकता है। दूसरी ओर एक निकालने वाला पाइप अकेला टंकी को 6 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि टंकी पूरी भरी होने पर सभी पाइप एक साथ खोले जाएँ, तो टंकी 6 घंटे में खाली हो जाती है। ज्ञात कीजिए कि कितने पाइप निकालने वाले हैं। [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let outlets be \(x\), inlets \(15 - x\)
\(\frac{x}{6} - \frac{15 - x}{8} = \frac{1}{6}\)
\(4x - 3(15 - x) = 4 \Rightarrow 7x = 49 \Rightarrow x = \boxed{7}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 7.
solution.hi:
निकासी पाइप \(x\), भरण पाइप \(15 - x\) मानिए
\(\frac{x}{6} - \frac{15 - x}{8} = \frac{1}{6}\)
\(4x - 3(15 - x) = 4 \Rightarrow 7x = 49 \Rightarrow x = \boxed{7}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 7 है।

question.en:
A cistern is initially empty. Inlet pipes A and B fill it at constant rates of \(\frac{1}{12}\) and \(\frac{1}{8}\) of the cistern per hour, respectively, while outlet pipe C empties it at a constant rate of \(\frac{1}{8}\) per hour. Sumeet opens pipes A and B at time zero. Under his original plan, pipe C is programmed to start instantly when the cistern reaches 50%, and Sumeet returns exactly at the moment the cistern becomes completely full.
However, due to a malfunction, pipe C starts instantly when the cistern is \(\frac{1}{3}\) full instead. All active pipes run continuously and simultaneously, and the cistern level always stays between 0% and 100%.
When Sumeet returns at the originally planned time and stops all pipes, what percentage of the cistern is filled? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
एक टंकी प्रारंभ में खाली है। भरने वाले पाइप A और B इसे क्रमशः \(\frac{1}{12}\) और \(\frac{1}{8}\) प्रति घंटा की दर से भरते हैं, जबकि निकालने वाला पाइप C इसे \(\frac{1}{8}\) प्रति घंटा की दर से खाली करता है। सुमीत समय शून्य पर पाइप A और B खोलता है। उसकी मूल योजना में पाइप C तब तुरंत चालू होता है जब टंकी 50% तक भर जाती है, और सुमीत ठीक उस क्षण लौटता है जब टंकी पूरी भर जाती है।
परंतु खराबी के कारण पाइप C तब चालू होता है जब टंकी \(\frac{1}{3}\) भरी होती है। सभी सक्रिय पाइप लगातार और एक साथ चलते हैं, तथा टंकी का स्तर सदैव 0% से 100% के बीच रहता है।
जब सुमीत मूल योजना के समय पर लौटकर सभी पाइप बंद करता है, तो टंकी का कितना प्रतिशत भरा होता है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
A + B \(= \frac{1}{12} + \frac{1}{8} = \frac{5}{24}\) per hour
Original plan: 50% in \(\frac{1}{2} \div \frac{5}{24} = 2.4\) h; with C on, net \(= \frac{5}{24} - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{1}{12}\) per hour, so another 6 h; total 8.4 h
New: \(\frac{1}{3}\) filled in 1.6 h, then net \(\frac{1}{12}\) per hour for 6.8 h\(\Rightarrow \frac{1}{3} + \frac{6.8}{12}\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} + 0.5667 = 0.9 \Rightarrow \boxed{90\%}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 90%.
solution.hi:
A + B \(= \frac{1}{12} + \frac{1}{8} = \frac{5}{24}\) प्रति घंटा
मूल योजना: 50% भरने में \(\frac{1}{2} \div \frac{5}{24} = 2.4\) घंटे; C चालू होने पर शुद्ध दर \(= \frac{5}{24} - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{1}{12}\) प्रति घंटा, अतः 6 घंटे और; कुल 8.4 घंटे
नई स्थिति: 1.6 घंटे में \(\frac{1}{3}\) भरता है, फिर 6.8 घंटे \(\frac{1}{12}\) प्रति घंटा \(\Rightarrow \frac{1}{3} + \frac{6.8}{12}\)
\(= \frac{1}{3} + 0.5667 = 0.9 \Rightarrow \boxed{90\%}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 90% है।

question.en: Pipe X can fill a tank in 20 hours and Pipe Y can empty the same tank in 30 hours. If both pipes are opened together in an empty tank, how much time will it take to fill the tank completely? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: पाइप X एक टंकी को 20 घंटे में भर सकता है और पाइप Y उसी टंकी को 30 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि खाली टंकी में दोनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाएँ, तो टंकी पूरी भरने में कितना समय लगेगा? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Net rate \(= \frac{1}{20} - \frac{1}{30} = \frac{1}{60}\) per hour
Time \(= \boxed{60\ \text{hours}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 60 hours.
solution.hi:
शुद्ध दर \(= \frac{1}{20} - \frac{1}{30} = \frac{1}{60}\) प्रति घंटा
समय \(= \boxed{60\ \text{घंटे}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 60 घंटे है।

question.en: A server's storage drive is at 0% capacity. A malicious script begins flooding it with junk data at a rate that would completely fill the drive in 6 hours. 3 hours since the attack starts, the IT team activates Scrubber A, which by itself can delete a full drive of data in 15 hours. 2 hours after the activation of A, they also turn on Scrubber B, which can delete a full drive in 5 hours. If the script runs continuously, at what exact time will the drive return to being 100% empty, if the attack started at 12:00 PM (noon)? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक सर्वर की स्टोरेज ड्राइव 0% भरी हुई है। एक दुर्भावनापूर्ण स्क्रिप्ट इसमें इस दर से जंक डेटा भरना शुरू करती है कि ड्राइव 6 घंटे में पूरी भर जाए। हमला शुरू होने के 3 घंटे बाद, IT टीम स्क्रबर A को चालू करती है, जो अकेले एक पूरी ड्राइव का डेटा 15 घंटे में हटा सकता है। A के चालू होने के 2 घंटे बाद, वे स्क्रबर B को भी चालू करते हैं, जो एक पूरी ड्राइव 5 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि स्क्रिप्ट लगातार चलती रहे और हमला दोपहर 12:00 PM पर शुरू हुआ हो, तो ड्राइव ठीक किस समय फिर से 100% खाली होगी? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Capacity = LCM(6, 15, 5) = 30 units
Script = +5/hr, A = −2/hr, B = −6/hr
12 PM–3 PM: \(5 \times 3 = 15\) units
3 PM–5 PM: \((5 - 2) \times 2 = 6\) → 21 units
After 5 PM: net = \(5 - 2 - 6 = -3\)/hr → time = \(\frac{21}{3} = 7\) hr
Drive empty at 5 PM + 7 hr = \(\boxed{12:00}\) AM (midnight)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 12:00 AM (midnight).
solution.hi:
क्षमता = LCM(6, 15, 5) = 30 इकाई
स्क्रिप्ट = +5/घंटा, A = −2/घंटा, B = −6/घंटा
12 PM–3 PM: \(5 \times 3 = 15\) इकाई
3 PM–5 PM: \((5 - 2) \times 2 = 6\) → 21 इकाई
5 PM के बाद: शुद्ध दर = \(5 - 2 - 6 = -3\)/घंटा → समय = \(\frac{21}{3} = 7\) घंटे
ड्राइव खाली होगी 5 PM + 7 घंटे = \(\boxed{12:00}\) AM (मध्यरात्रि)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 12:00 AM (मध्यरात्रि) है।

question.en: Pipe X can fill a tank in 16 minutes and pipe Y can fill it in in 24 minutes. A drainpipe Z can empty it in x minutes. All the three pipes are opened simultaneously at a particular point of time and after 8 minutes, pipe Z is closed. The tank becomes exactly full 4 minutes later. Find the time taken by pipe Z to empty the entirely filled tank alone. [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: पाइप X एक टंकी को 16 मिनट में और पाइप Y उसे 24 मिनट में भर सकता है। एक निकास पाइप Z उसे x मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। तीनों पाइप एक निश्चित समय पर एक साथ खोले जाते हैं और 8 मिनट बाद पाइप Z बंद कर दिया जाता है। इसके 4 मिनट बाद टंकी ठीक पूरी भर जाती है। पूरी भरी टंकी को अकेले खाली करने में पाइप Z द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Tank = LCM(16, 24) = 48 units → X = 3/min, Y = 2/min
X and Y run 12 minutes: \(5 \times 12 = 60\) units
Z removed 60 − 48 = 12 units in 8 minutes → 1.5/min
Z alone = \(\frac{48}{1.5} = \boxed{32}\) minutes

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 32 minutes.
solution.hi:
टंकी = LCM(16, 24) = 48 इकाई → X = 3/मिनट, Y = 2/मिनट
X और Y 12 मिनट चले: \(5 \times 12 = 60\) इकाई
Z ने 8 मिनट में 60 − 48 = 12 इकाई निकालीं → 1.5/मिनट
Z अकेले = \(\frac{48}{1.5} = \boxed{32}\) मिनट

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 32 मिनट है।

question.en: Pipe P can fill a pool in 6 hours, but due to a drainage pipe Q, it takes 9 hours to fill the pool. In how many hours can the drainage pipe Q alone empty the full pool? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: पाइप P एक पूल को 6 घंटे में भर सकता है, लेकिन निकास पाइप Q के कारण पूल भरने में 9 घंटे लगते हैं। निकास पाइप Q अकेले भरे हुए पूल को कितने घंटों में खाली कर सकता है? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Pool = LCM(6, 9) = 18 units
P = 3/hr, P − Q = 2/hr → Q = 1/hr
Q alone = \(\frac{18}{1} = \boxed{18}\) hours

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 18 hours.
solution.hi:
पूल = LCM(6, 9) = 18 इकाई
P = 3/घंटा, P − Q = 2/घंटा → Q = 1/घंटा
Q अकेले = \(\frac{18}{1} = \boxed{18}\) घंटे

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 18 घंटे है।

question.en: A tank, which can normally be filled in 15 hours, takes 5 additional hours to fill due to a leak at the bottom. If the tank is completely full, how long will the leak alone take to empty it? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक टंकी, जो सामान्यतः 15 घंटे में भर जाती है, तली में रिसाव के कारण भरने में 5 घंटे अधिक लेती है। यदि टंकी पूरी भरी हो, तो अकेला रिसाव उसे कितने समय में खाली करेगा? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Tank = LCM(15, 20) = 60 units
Pipe = 4/hr, Pipe − Leak = 3/hr → Leak = 1/hr
Leak alone = \(\frac{60}{1} = \boxed{60}\) hours

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 60 hours.
solution.hi:
टंकी = LCM(15, 20) = 60 इकाई
पाइप = 4/घंटा, पाइप − रिसाव = 3/घंटा → रिसाव = 1/घंटा
अकेला रिसाव = \(\frac{60}{1} = \boxed{60}\) घंटे

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 60 घंटे है।

question.en: A tank can be filled in 15 hours under normal conditions. However, due to a leak at the bottom, it takes 20 hours to fill completely. If the tank is already full, how long will the leak alone take to empty it? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सामान्य परिस्थितियों में एक टंकी 15 घंटे में भर सकती है। लेकिन तल में एक रिसाव के कारण इसे पूरी तरह भरने में 20 घंटे लगते हैं। यदि टंकी पहले से भरी हुई है, तो अकेला रिसाव इसे खाली करने में कितना समय लेगा? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Capacity = LCM(15, 20) = 60 units
Inlet = \(\frac{60}{15} = 4\) units/h, inlet with leak = \(\frac{60}{20} = 3\) units/h
Leak = \(4 - 3 = 1\) unit/h
Time to empty a full tank = \(\frac{60}{1} = \boxed{60}\) hours

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 60 hours.
solution.hi:
क्षमता = LCM(15, 20) = 60 इकाई
भरने वाला पाइप = \(\frac{60}{15} = 4\) इकाई/घंटा, रिसाव सहित = \(\frac{60}{20} = 3\) इकाई/घंटा
रिसाव = \(4 - 3 = 1\) इकाई/घंटा
भरी टंकी खाली होने का समय = \(\frac{60}{1} = \boxed{60}\) घंटे

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 60 घंटे है।

question.en: Two pipes, A and B, can fill a tank in 1 and 3 hours, respectively. If both pipes are opened together, how long will it take to fill the tank? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: दो पाइप A और B एक टंकी को क्रमशः 1 और 3 घंटे में भर सकते हैं। यदि दोनों पाइप एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी भरने में कितना समय लगेगा? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Combined rate per hour = \(1 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{4}{3}\)
Time = \(\frac{3}{4}\) hour = \(\frac{3}{4} \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{45}\) minutes

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 45 minutes.
solution.hi:
प्रति घंटे संयुक्त दर = \(1 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{4}{3}\)
समय = \(\frac{3}{4}\) घंटा = \(\frac{3}{4} \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{45}\) मिनट

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 45 मिनट है।

question.en: A water tank has three pipes attached to it. Pipe 1 and Pipe 2 are inlet pipes that fill the tank in 5/2 hours and 10/3 hours respectively. Pipe 3 is an outlet pipe that empties the full tank in 5 hours. If all three pipes are opened together, how long will it take to fill the empty tank? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक पानी की टंकी से तीन पाइप जुड़े हैं। पाइप 1 और पाइप 2 भरने वाले पाइप हैं जो टंकी को क्रमशः 5/2 घंटे और 10/3 घंटे में भरते हैं। पाइप 3 निकास पाइप है जो भरी टंकी को 5 घंटे में खाली करता है। यदि तीनों पाइप एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो खाली टंकी भरने में कितना समय लगेगा? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Rates: pipe 1 = \(\frac{2}{5}\), pipe 2 = \(\frac{3}{10}\), outlet = \(-\frac{1}{5}\)
Net rate = \(\frac{2}{5} + \frac{3}{10} - \frac{1}{5} = \frac{4 + 3 - 2}{10} = \frac{5}{10} = \frac{1}{2}\)
Time = \(\boxed{2}\) hours

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2 hours.

question.en: An inlet pipe is attached to an empty tank which can fill the tank in exactly 1 hour at the rate of 2 cm/sec. The inlet pipe has a cross section of square shape with side 4 cm. An outlet pipe with a circular cross section is also attached to the tank and it can empty the tank at the rate of 7 cm/sec. When both these pipes function simultaneously, the tank gets exactly filled after 3 hrs 12 mins. Find the radius of the cross-section of the outlet pipe. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक खाली टैंक से जुड़ा एक प्रवेश पाइप उस टैंक को 2 cm/सेकंड की दर से ठीक 1 घंटे में भर सकता है। प्रवेश पाइप का अनुप्रस्थ काट 4 cm भुजा वाला वर्गाकार है। टैंक से एक वृत्तीय अनुप्रस्थ काट वाला निकास पाइप भी जुड़ा है जो 7 cm/सेकंड की दर से टैंक को खाली कर सकता है। जब दोनों पाइप एक साथ कार्य करते हैं, तो टैंक ठीक 3 घंटे 12 मिनट में भर जाता है। निकास पाइप के अनुप्रस्थ काट की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Inlet rate \(= 16 \times 2 = 32\) cm³/s, so tank capacity \(= 32 \times 3600 = 115200\) cm³
Time with both pipes \(= 3\) hr \(12\) min \(= 11520\) s
Net rate \(= \frac{115200}{11520} = 10\) cm³/s
Outlet rate \(= 32 - 10 = 22\) cm³/s, i.e. \(7 \times \pi r^2 = 22\)
\(\pi r^2 = \frac{22}{7} \Rightarrow r^2 = 1 \Rightarrow r = \boxed{1}\) cm

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 1 cm.
solution.hi:
प्रवेश दर \(= 16 \times 2 = 32\) cm³/सेकंड, अतः टैंक की क्षमता \(= 32 \times 3600 = 115200\) cm³
दोनों पाइपों के साथ समय \(= 3\) घंटे \(12\) मिनट \(= 11520\) सेकंड
शुद्ध दर \(= \frac{115200}{11520} = 10\) cm³/सेकंड
निकास दर \(= 32 - 10 = 22\) cm³/सेकंड, अर्थात् \(7 \times \pi r^2 = 22\)
\(\pi r^2 = \frac{22}{7} \Rightarrow r^2 = 1 \Rightarrow r = \boxed{1}\) cm

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 1 cm है।

solution.en:
\((x+2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\) and \((x-2)^2 = x^2 - 4x + 4\)
Difference \(= (x^2 + 4x + 4) - (x^2 - 4x + 4) = 8x\)
\(= \boxed{8x}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 8x.

question.en: If x = 1.5 and y = 0.5, find the value of \(\frac{x^3 - y^3}{x^2 + xy + y^2} + \frac{x^3 + y^3}{x^2 - xy + y^2}\). [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि x = 1.5 और y = 0.5 है, तो \(\frac{x^3 - y^3}{x^2 + xy + y^2} + \frac{x^3 + y^3}{x^2 - xy + y^2}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x^3 - y^3}{x^2 + xy + y^2} = x - y = 1.5 - 0.5 = 1\)
\(\frac{x^3 + y^3}{x^2 - xy + y^2} = x + y = 1.5 + 0.5 = 2\)
Sum \(= 1 + 2 = \boxed{3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 3.

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 3\sqrt{2}\), then find the value of \(\frac{x}{x^2 - 1}\). [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 3\sqrt{2}\) है, तो \(\frac{x}{x^2 - 1}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x}{x^2 - 1} = \frac{1}{x - \frac{1}{x}}\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 - 4 = 18 - 4 = 14\)
\(x - \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{14}\), so the value \(= \boxed{\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\).
solution.hi:
\(\frac{x}{x^2 - 1} = \frac{1}{x - \frac{1}{x}}\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 - 4 = 18 - 4 = 14\)
\(x - \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{14}\), अतः मान \(= \boxed{\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{14}}\) है।

question.en: If \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{x}{49}} = \frac{8}{7}\), find the value of x. [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{x}{49}} = \frac{8}{7}\) है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Squaring both sides: \(1 + \frac{x}{49} = \frac{64}{49}\)
\(\frac{x}{49} = \frac{64}{49} - 1 = \frac{15}{49}\)
\(x = \boxed{15}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 15.

question.en: If \(x\left(7 - \frac{3}{x}\right) = \frac{7}{x}\), then find the value of \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\). [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(x\left(7 - \frac{3}{x}\right) = \frac{7}{x}\) है, तो \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(7x - 3 = \frac{7}{x} \Rightarrow 7x - \frac{7}{x} = 3 \Rightarrow x - \frac{1}{x} = \frac{3}{7}\)
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 + 2 = \frac{9}{49} + 2\)
\(= \frac{9 + 98}{49} = \boxed{\frac{107}{49}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{107}{49}\).
solution.hi:
\(7x - 3 = \frac{7}{x} \Rightarrow 7x - \frac{7}{x} = 3 \Rightarrow x - \frac{1}{x} = \frac{3}{7}\)
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 + 2 = \frac{9}{49} + 2\)
\(= \frac{9 + 98}{49} = \boxed{\frac{107}{49}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{107}{49}\) है।

question.en: If the expression 64x² + kxy + 81y² is a perfect square, what are the possible values of k? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि व्यंजक 64x² + kxy + 81y² पूर्ण वर्ग है, तो k के संभावित मान क्या हैं? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
For a perfect square, \(kxy = \pm 2\sqrt{64x^2} \cdot \sqrt{81y^2}\)
\(k = \pm 2 \times 8 \times 9\)
\(k = \boxed{\pm 144}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): ±144.
solution.hi:
पूर्ण वर्ग के लिए \(kxy = \pm 2\sqrt{64x^2} \cdot \sqrt{81y^2}\)

\(k = \boxed{\pm 144}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): ±144 है।

question.en: What term must be added to the expression 4a² + 20ab to make it a perfect square trinomial? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: व्यंजक 4a² + 20ab में कौन-सा पद जोड़ा जाए कि वह पूर्ण वर्ग त्रिपद बन जाए? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(4a^2 + 20ab + k = (2a + 5b)^2\)
Since \(2(2a)(5b) = 20ab\), the missing term is \((5b)^2\)
\(= \boxed{25b^2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 25b².

question.en: If a² + b² = 89 and ab = 20, find the value of |a − b|. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि a² + b² = 89 और ab = 20 है, तो |a − b| का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((a - b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\)
\(= 89 - 40 = 49\)
\(|a - b| = \boxed{7}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 7.

question.en:
Simplify the following radical expression completely:

\(\frac{\sqrt{2} + 1}{\sqrt{2} - 1}\) [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित करणी व्यंजक को पूर्ण रूप से सरलीकृत कीजिए:

\(\frac{\sqrt{2} + 1}{\sqrt{2} - 1}\) [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Multiply numerator and denominator by \((\sqrt{2} + 1)\)
\(= \frac{(\sqrt{2} + 1)^2}{2 - 1} = 2 + 2\sqrt{2} + 1\)
\(= \boxed{3 + 2\sqrt{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(3 + 2\sqrt{2}\).

question.en: A student was asked to multiply a number by 5/9, but instead, he divided it by 5/9. If his answer was 56 more than the correct answer, find the number. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: एक विद्यार्थी से किसी संख्या को 5/9 से गुणा करने को कहा गया, परंतु उसने उसे 5/9 से भाग दे दिया। यदि उसका उत्तर सही उत्तर से 56 अधिक था, तो संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let the number be \(x\)
\(\frac{9x}{5} - \frac{5x}{9} = 56 \Rightarrow \frac{81x - 25x}{45} = 56\)
\(\frac{56x}{45} = 56 \Rightarrow x = \boxed{45}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 45.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए संख्या \(x\) है
\(\frac{9x}{5} - \frac{5x}{9} = 56 \Rightarrow \frac{81x - 25x}{45} = 56\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 45 है।

question.en: The product (x − 1)(x + 1)(x² + 1)(x⁴ + 1) simplifies to which of the following expressions? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: गुणनफल (x − 1)(x + 1)(x² + 1)(x⁴ + 1) निम्नलिखित में से किस व्यंजक में सरल होता है? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((x - 1)(x + 1) = x^2 - 1\), then \((x^2 - 1)(x^2 + 1) = x^4 - 1\)
Finally \((x^4 - 1)(x^4 + 1) = x^8 - 1\)
\(= \boxed{x^8 - 1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): x⁸ − 1.

question.en: If x = 5 + 2√6, what is the value of x² + 1/x²? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि x = 5 + 2√6 है, तो x² + 1/x² का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{1}{x} = 5 - 2\sqrt{6}\), so \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 10\)
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 100 - 2\)
\(= \boxed{98}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 98.

question.en: Two real numbers together produce a total of 9. The total of their squared values is 45. Determine the multiplication outcome of the two numbers. [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: दो वास्तविक संख्याओं का योग 9 है। उनके वर्गों का योग 45 है। दोनों संख्याओं का गुणनफल ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(a + b = 9\), \(a^2 + b^2 = 45\)
\(ab = \frac{(a+b)^2 - (a^2+b^2)}{2} = \frac{81 - 45}{2}\)
\(ab = \boxed{18}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 18.

question.en: Simplify (3x − 4y)² + (3x + 4y)². [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सरलीकृत कीजिए: (3x − 4y)² + (3x + 4y)²। [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\((a-b)^2 + (a+b)^2 = 2(a^2 + b^2)\)
\(= 2(9x^2 + 16y^2)\)
\(= \boxed{18x^2 + 32y^2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 18x² + 32y².

question.en: Simplify the expression (a + b)³ − (a − b)³. [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: व्यंजक (a + b)³ − (a − b)³ को सरलीकृत कीजिए। [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\((a+b)^3 - (a-b)^3 = 2\left[3a^2b + b^3\right]\)
\(= 6a^2b + 2b^3\)
\(= \boxed{6a^2b + 2b^3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 6a²b + 2b³.
solution.hi:

question.en: Given \(x = \frac{1}{2 - \sqrt{3}}\), find the value of \(x - \frac{1}{x}\). [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: दिया गया है \(x = \frac{1}{2 - \sqrt{3}}\), तो \(x - \frac{1}{x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(x = \frac{2 + \sqrt{3}}{(2)^2 - 3} = 2 + \sqrt{3}\), so \(\frac{1}{x} = 2 - \sqrt{3}\)
\(x - \frac{1}{x} = (2 + \sqrt{3}) - (2 - \sqrt{3})\)
\(= \boxed{2\sqrt{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(2\sqrt{3}\).

question.en: If a² + b² = 57 and ab = 16, what is the absolute value of a − b? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि a² + b² = 57 और ab = 16 है, तो |a − b| का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((a - b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab = 57 - 32 = 25\)
\(|a - b| = \sqrt{25}\)
\(= \boxed{5}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 5.

question.en: If \(x = \sqrt{\frac{6 + \sqrt{35}}{6 - \sqrt{35}}}\), then what is the value of \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\)? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(x = \sqrt{\frac{6 + \sqrt{35}}{6 - \sqrt{35}}}\) है, तो \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(x^2 = \frac{6 + \sqrt{35}}{6 - \sqrt{35}}\) and \(\frac{1}{x^2} = \frac{6 - \sqrt{35}}{6 + \sqrt{35}}\)
These are reciprocals, so put \(y = x^2\): \(y + \frac{1}{y} = \frac{(6 + \sqrt{35})^2 + (6 - \sqrt{35})^2}{36 - 35}\)
\(= 2(36 + 35) = 142\)
\(= \boxed{142}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 142.

question.en: Find the value of k, if x = 1, y = 2 is a solution of the equation 2x + 3y = k. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए, यदि x = 1, y = 2 समीकरण 2x + 3y = k का हल है। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Substitute \(x = 1\), \(y = 2\)
\(k = 2(1) + 3(2) = 2 + 6\)
\(k = \boxed{8}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 8.

question.en: Determine the number to be added to 144p² − 72p so that it becomes a perfect square. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: 144p² − 72p में कौन-सी संख्या जोड़ी जाए कि वह पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाए? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(144p^2 - 72p = (12p)^2 - 2(12p)(3)\)
Add \(3^2\) to complete the square: \((12p - 3)^2\)
Number \(= \boxed{9}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 9.

question.en: If \(x = \sqrt{\frac{10 + 3\sqrt{11}}{10 - 3\sqrt{11}}}\), then what is the value of \(x + \frac{1}{x}\)? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x = \sqrt{\frac{10 + 3\sqrt{11}}{10 - 3\sqrt{11}}}\) है, तो \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Rationalise: \(\frac{10 + 3\sqrt{11}}{10 - 3\sqrt{11}} = \frac{(10 + 3\sqrt{11})^2}{100 - 99} = (10 + 3\sqrt{11})^2\)
So \(x = 10 + 3\sqrt{11}\) and \(\frac{1}{x} = 10 - 3\sqrt{11}\)
\(x + \frac{1}{x} = \boxed{20}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 20.

question.en: If a + b + c = 31 and ab + bc + ca = 37, find the value of a² + b² + c². [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि a + b + c = 31 और ab + bc + ca = 37 है, तो a² + b² + c² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = (a + b + c)^2 - 2(ab + bc + ca)\)
\(= 961 - 74\)
\(= \boxed{887}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 887.

question.en: If x = 109 and y = 98, evaluate the expression x² - y² + 2x - 2y without using direct multiplication. [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि x = 109 और y = 98 है, तो सीधे गुणा किए बिना व्यंजक x² - y² + 2x - 2y का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(x^2 - y^2 + 2x - 2y = (x - y)(x + y) + 2(x - y)\)
\(= (x - y)(x + y + 2) = 11 \times 209\)
\(= \boxed{2299}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2299.

question.en: If \(p + q + r = 0\) and \(pq + qr + rp = -18\), then find the value of \(p^2 + q^2 + r^2\). [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(p + q + r = 0\) और \(pq + qr + rp = -18\) है, तो \(p^2 + q^2 + r^2\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(p^2 + q^2 + r^2 = (p + q + r)^2 - 2(pq + qr + rp)\)
\(= 0 - 2(-18)\)
\(= \boxed{36}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 36.

question.en: If A = (3a + 5b)² and B = (3a − 5b)², which of the following expressions is exactly equal to A − B? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि A = (3a + 5b)² और B = (3a − 5b)² है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यंजक A − B के ठीक बराबर है? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((x + y)^2 - (x - y)^2 = 4xy\) with \(x = 3a\), \(y = 5b\)
\(A - B = 4 \times 3a \times 5b\)
\(= \boxed{60ab}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 60ab.
solution.hi:
\((x + y)^2 - (x - y)^2 = 4xy\), जहाँ \(x = 3a\), \(y = 5b\)
\(A - B = 4 \times 3a \times 5b\)
\(= \boxed{60ab}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 60ab है।

question.en: Factorise: a² + b² + 2ab. [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): (a + b)².

question.en: If x − 1/x = 2, find the value of x⁴ + 1/x⁴. [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि x − 1/x = 2 है, तो x⁴ + 1/x⁴ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 4 + 2 = 6\)
\(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 6^2 - 2\)
\(= \boxed{34}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 34.

question.en:
Find the solution of following simultaneous equation
\(2x + y = 5\)
\(x - y = 4\) [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित युगपत समीकरणों का हल ज्ञात कीजिए
\(2x + y = 5\)
\(x - y = 4\) [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Adding the two equations: \(3x = 9 \Rightarrow x = 3\)
\(y = x - 4 = -1\)
\(\boxed{X = 3,\ Y = -1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): X=3,Y=-1.
solution.hi:
दोनों समीकरण जोड़ने पर: \(3x = 9 \Rightarrow x = 3\)
\(y = x - 4 = -1\)
\(\boxed{X = 3,\ Y = -1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): X=3,Y=-1 है।

question.en: If a + b = 19 and ab = 90, then find (a−b)². [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि a + b = 19 और ab = 90 है, तो (a−b)² ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((a - b)^2 = (a + b)^2 - 4ab\)
\(= 361 - 360\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1.

question.en: If x = \(\sqrt{\frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{2-\sqrt{3}}}\) then what is the value of x² + x − 9? [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि x = \(\sqrt{\frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{2-\sqrt{3}}}\) है, तो x² + x − 9 का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{2-\sqrt{3}} = (2+\sqrt{3})^2 \Rightarrow x = 2 + \sqrt{3}\)
\(x^2 = 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\)
\(x^2 + x - 9 = (7 + 4\sqrt{3}) + (2 + \sqrt{3}) - 9 = \boxed{5\sqrt{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(5\sqrt{3}\).

question.en: If x + \(\frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{17}\), then find the value of \(\frac{x^4 - 1}{x^2}\). [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि x + \(\frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{17}\) है, तो \(\frac{x^4 - 1}{x^2}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x^4 - 1}{x^2} = x^2 - \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = 17 - 4 = 13 \Rightarrow x - \frac{1}{x} = \pm\sqrt{13}\)
\(= \pm\sqrt{17} \times \sqrt{13} = \boxed{\pm\sqrt{221}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\pm\sqrt{221}\).
solution.hi:
\(\frac{x^4 - 1}{x^2} = x^2 - \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = 17 - 4 = 13 \Rightarrow x - \frac{1}{x} = \pm\sqrt{13}\)
\(= \pm\sqrt{17} \times \sqrt{13} = \boxed{\pm\sqrt{221}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\pm\sqrt{221}\) है।

question.en: If u + v = 17 and uv = 39, find the value of u² + v². [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

\(= 289 - 78\)
\(= \boxed{211}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 211.

question.en: If x + \(\frac{1}{x} = 12\), then find the value of \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} + x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\). [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

question.en: What is the value of 999² − 998²? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: 999² − 998² का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\)
\(= (1997)(1)\)
\(= \boxed{1997}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1997.

question.en: If y + \(\frac{1}{y} = 17\), find the value of \(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3}\). [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि y + \(\frac{1}{y} = 17\) है, तो \(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3} = 17^3 - 3(17)\)
\(= 4913 - 51\)
\(= \boxed{4862}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 4862.

question.en: If a + b = 22 and ab = 85, evaluate a² + b². [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि a + b = 22 और ab = 85 है, तो a² + b² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(a^2 + b^2 = (a + b)^2 - 2ab\)
\(= 484 - 170\)
\(= \boxed{314}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 314.

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{7+X} + \sqrt{7-X}}{\sqrt{7+X} - \sqrt{7-X}} = 5\), then what is the value of X? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{7+X} + \sqrt{7-X}}{\sqrt{7+X} - \sqrt{7-X}} = 5\) है, तो X का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Using componendo–dividendo: \(\frac{2\sqrt{7+X}}{2\sqrt{7-X}} = \frac{6}{4}\)
\(\frac{7+X}{7-X} = \frac{9}{4}\)
\(28 + 4X = 63 - 9X \Rightarrow X = \frac{35}{13}\): \(\boxed{\frac{35}{13}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{35}{13}\).

question.en: In the expansion of the trinomial square (2x − 3y + 4z)², what is the sum of the coefficients of the xy and yz terms? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: त्रिपद वर्ग (2x − 3y + 4z)² के प्रसार में xy और yz पदों के गुणांकों का योग क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Cross terms: \(2(2x)(-3y) = -12xy\), \(2(-3y)(4z) = -24yz\)
Sum \(= -12 + (-24)\)
\(= \boxed{-36}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): −36.

question.en: Find the value of \((8a + 5b)^2 - (8a - 5b)^2\). [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((x+y)^2 - (x-y)^2 = 4xy\) with \(x = 8a\), \(y = 5b\)
\(= 4 \times 8a \times 5b\)
\(= \boxed{160ab}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 160ab.

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 160ab है।

question.en: For what value of x is the statement \(\left(\frac{x}{21}\right)\left(\frac{x}{84}\right) = 1\) true? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: x के किस मान के लिए कथन \(\left(\frac{x}{21}\right)\left(\frac{x}{84}\right) = 1\) सत्य है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x^2}{1764} = 1\)
\(x^2 = 1764\)
\(x = \boxed{42}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 42.

question.en: If 3x = 2y, find the value of \(\frac{y^2 - x^2}{y^2 + 2xy + x^2}\). [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि 3x = 2y है, तो \(\frac{y^2 - x^2}{y^2 + 2xy + x^2}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let \(x = 2k\), \(y = 3k\)
\(\frac{9k^2 - 4k^2}{9k^2 + 12k^2 + 4k^2} = \frac{5k^2}{25k^2}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{1}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{1}{5}\).

question.en: If x = \(\sqrt{\frac{\sqrt{5}+2}{\sqrt{5}-2}}\) then what is the value of x² − 2√5x + 8? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि x = \(\sqrt{\frac{\sqrt{5}+2}{\sqrt{5}-2}}\) है, तो x² − 2√5x + 8 का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\sqrt{5}+2}{\sqrt{5}-2} = (\sqrt{5}+2)^2 \Rightarrow x = \sqrt{5} + 2\)
\(x^2 = 9 + 4\sqrt{5}\)
\(x^2 - 2\sqrt{5}x + 8 = 9 + 4\sqrt{5} - 10 - 4\sqrt{5} + 8 = \boxed{7}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 7.

question.en: Given that \(p + q + r = 0\) (where \(p, q, r \neq 0\)), what is the value of the expression \(\frac{p^2}{qr} + \frac{q^2}{rp} + \frac{r^2}{pq}\)? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(p + q + r = 0\) है (जहाँ \(p, q, r \neq 0\)), तो व्यंजक \(\frac{p^2}{qr} + \frac{q^2}{rp} + \frac{r^2}{pq}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Take LCM: \(\frac{p^3 + q^3 + r^3}{pqr}\)
Since \(p + q + r = 0\), \(p^3 + q^3 + r^3 = 3pqr\)
\(= \boxed{3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 3.

question.en: If \(x = 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\), what is the value of \(\left(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^2\)? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x = 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\) है, तो \(\left(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^2\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(x = 7 + 4\sqrt{3} = (2 + \sqrt{3})^2 \Rightarrow \sqrt{x} = 2 + \sqrt{3}\)
\(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = 2 - \sqrt{3}\)
\(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = 2\sqrt{3}\)
\((2\sqrt{3})^2 = \boxed{12}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 12.

question.en: If \(x = \sqrt{\frac{7 + 4\sqrt{3}}{7 - 4\sqrt{3}}}\), then what is the value of \(x^2 - 14x + 2\)? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x = \sqrt{\frac{7 + 4\sqrt{3}}{7 - 4\sqrt{3}}}\) है, तो \(x^2 - 14x + 2\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(x = \sqrt{\frac{(2 + \sqrt{3})^2}{(2 - \sqrt{3})^2}} = \frac{2 + \sqrt{3}}{2 - \sqrt{3}} = (2 + \sqrt{3})^2 = 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\)
\(\frac{1}{x} = 7 - 4\sqrt{3} \Rightarrow x + \frac{1}{x} = 14\)
\(x^2 + 1 = 14x \Rightarrow x^2 - 14x + 1 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 14x + 2 = 0 + 1 = \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1.

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 6\), find the value of \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5}\). [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 6\) है, तो \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 6^2 - 2 = 34\)
\(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} = 6^3 - 3 \times 6 = 198\)
\(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5} = \left(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\right)\left(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3}\right) - \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)\)
\(= 34 \times 198 - 6 = 6732 - 6 = \boxed{6726}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 6726.

question.en: If \(x - \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{5}\), what is the value of \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\)? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x - \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{5}\) है, तो \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 + 2\)
\(= (\sqrt{5})^2 + 2 = \boxed{7}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 7.

question.en: If \(x = 2 + \sqrt{3}\), what is the value of \(x + \frac{1}{x}\)? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x = 2 + \sqrt{3}\) है, तो \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{2 + \sqrt{3}} = 2 - \sqrt{3}\)
\(x + \frac{1}{x} = (2 + \sqrt{3}) + (2 - \sqrt{3}) = \boxed{4}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 4.

question.en: If \(y + \frac{1}{y} = 18\), find the value of \(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3}\). [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(y + \frac{1}{y} = 18\) है, तो \(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(y^3 + \frac{1}{y^3} = \left(y + \frac{1}{y}\right)^3 - 3\left(y + \frac{1}{y}\right)\)
\(= 18^3 - 3 \times 18 = 5832 - 54 = \boxed{5778}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 5778.

question.en: If \(2x = 0.5y\), then find \(\frac{y^2 - x^2}{y^2 + 2xy + x^2}\). [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(2x = 0.5y \Rightarrow y = 4x\)
\(\frac{y^2 - x^2}{(y + x)^2} = \frac{y - x}{y + x} = \frac{4x - x}{4x + x}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{3}{5}\).

question.en: If \(a + b + c = 17\) and \(ab + bc + ca = 21\), what is the value of \(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\)? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(a + b + c = 17\) और \(ab + bc + ca = 21\) है, तो \(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a + b + c)^2 - 3(ab + bc + ca)]\)
\(= 17 \times (289 - 63) = 17 \times 226\)
\(= \boxed{3842}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 3842.

question.en: If \(a + b = 17\) and \(ab = 60\), then find the value of \((a - b)^4\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(a + b = 17\) और \(ab = 60\) है, तो \((a - b)^4\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((a - b)^2 = (a + b)^2 - 4ab = 289 - 240 = 49\)
\((a - b)^4 = 49^2 = \boxed{2401}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 2401.

question.en: If \(x \neq 0\) and \(x - \frac{1}{x} = 2\), what is the value of \(x^6 + \frac{1}{x^6}\)? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x \neq 0\) और \(x - \frac{1}{x} = 2\) है, तो \(x^6 + \frac{1}{x^6}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]

question.en: If \(x = \sqrt{\frac{5 + 2\sqrt{6}}{5 - 2\sqrt{6}}}\), then what is the value of \(x^2 - 10x + 5\)? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(x = \sqrt{\frac{5 + 2\sqrt{6}}{5 - 2\sqrt{6}}}\) है, तो \(x^2 - 10x + 5\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

\(x = \frac{\sqrt{3} + \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{3} - \sqrt{2}} = (\sqrt{3} + \sqrt{2})^2 = 5 + 2\sqrt{6}\)

question.en: A square garden has side \((6x + 5y)\) meters. A square pond inside it has side \((2x + y)\) meters. Find the area of the garden excluding the pond in square meters, where \(x, y \gt 0\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वर्गाकार बगीचे की भुजा \((6x + 5y)\) मीटर है। इसके अंदर एक वर्गाकार तालाब की भुजा \((2x + y)\) मीटर है। तालाब को छोड़कर बगीचे का क्षेत्रफल वर्ग मीटर में ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ \(x, y \gt 0\)। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Area = \((6x + 5y)^2 - (2x + y)^2\)
\(= (6x + 5y + 2x + y)(6x + 5y - 2x - y) = (8x + 6y)(4x + 4y)\)
\(= \boxed{8(x + y)(4x + 3y)}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(8(x + y)(4x + 3y)\).

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{13}\), then find the value of \(\frac{3x}{x^2 - 1}\). [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{13}\) है, तो \(\frac{3x}{x^2 - 1}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

\(\frac{3x}{x^2 - 1} = \frac{3}{x - \frac{1}{x}} = \frac{3}{\pm 3}\)
\(= \boxed{\pm 1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): ±1.

question.en: The square of a positive number exceeds the number itself by 182. Find the number. [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:

\(x = \boxed{14}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 14.

question.en: If \(x = \frac{\sqrt{3} + \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{3} - \sqrt{2}}\), then find the value of \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\). [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

question.en: If m − n = 15 and mn = 26, find the value of (m + n)². [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]

question.en: Pranita is an animal-rights activist and houses certain number of dogs, cats and birds in her farm. The total number of heads of all these three species in the farm counts to 79. If the number of birds is 250% of the number of cats and the total number of legs of the three species in the farm (combined) is 236, what is the ratio of the number of cats, birds and dogs respectively? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: प्रणिता एक पशु-अधिकार कार्यकर्ता है और अपने फार्म में कुछ कुत्ते, बिल्लियाँ और पक्षी रखती है। फार्म में इन तीनों प्रजातियों के सिरों की कुल संख्या 79 है। यदि पक्षियों की संख्या बिल्लियों की संख्या का 250% है और फार्म में तीनों प्रजातियों के पैरों की कुल संख्या 236 है, तो बिल्लियों, पक्षियों और कुत्तों की संख्या का क्रमशः अनुपात क्या है? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Cats = c, Birds = 2.5c, Dogs = 79 − 3.5c
Legs: \(4c + 2(2.5c) + 4(79 - 3.5c) = 236 \Rightarrow 316 - 5c = 236\)
c = 16, birds = 40, dogs = 23
Cats : Birds : Dogs = \(\boxed{16 : 40 : 23}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 16:40:23.

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{5}\), then find the value of \(x^2 - \frac{1}{x^2}\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = \sqrt{5}\) है, तो \(x^2 - \frac{1}{x^2}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = 5 - 4 = 1 \Rightarrow x - \frac{1}{x} = \pm 1\)
\(x^2 - \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)\)
\(= \sqrt{5} \times (\pm 1) = \boxed{\pm\sqrt{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\pm\sqrt{5}\).

question.en: Given that \(m - n = 7\) and \(mn = 18\), find the value of \((m + n)^2\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: दिया गया है कि \(m - n = 7\) और \(mn = 18\) है, तो \((m + n)^2\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((m + n)^2 = (m - n)^2 + 4mn\)
\(= 49 + 72 = \boxed{121}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 121.

question.en: Let \(x = \sqrt{5} + \sqrt{3}\) and \(y = \sqrt{5} - \sqrt{3}\). What is the value of \(\frac{x^2 + y^2}{xy}\)? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: मान लीजिए \(x = \sqrt{5} + \sqrt{3}\) और \(y = \sqrt{5} - \sqrt{3}\) है। \(\frac{x^2 + y^2}{xy}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(x + y = 2\sqrt{5}\), \(xy = 5 - 3 = 2\)
\(x^2 + y^2 = (x + y)^2 - 2xy = 20 - 4 = 16\)
\(\frac{x^2 + y^2}{xy} = \frac{16}{2} = \boxed{8}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 8.

question.en: If \(x + y + z = 7\), \(xy + yz + zx = 14\) and \(xyz = 8\), what is the value of \(x^3 + y^3 + z^3\)? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x + y + z = 7\), \(xy + yz + zx = 14\) और \(xyz = 8\) है, तो \(x^3 + y^3 + z^3\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z)\left[(x + y + z)^2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)\right]\)
\(= 7\left[49 - 3 \times 14\right] = 7 \times 7 = 49\)
\(x^3 + y^3 + z^3 = 49 + 3 \times 8\)
\(= \boxed{73}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 73.

question.en: If \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{x}{121}} = \frac{12}{11}\), find the value of x. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(\sqrt{1 + \frac{x}{121}} = \frac{12}{11}\) है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Squaring both sides: \(1 + \frac{x}{121} = \frac{144}{121}\)
\(\frac{x}{121} = \frac{144 - 121}{121} = \frac{23}{121}\)
\(x = \boxed{23}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 23.

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 23\), then find the value of \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} + x + \frac{1}{x}\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 23\) है, तो \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} + x + \frac{1}{x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 - 2 = 529 - 2 = 527\)
Expression = \(527 + 23\)
\(= \boxed{550}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 550.

question.en: If p + q + r = 24 and pq + qr + rp = 65, then find the value of p² + q² + r². [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि p + q + r = 24 और pq + qr + rp = 65 है, तो p² + q² + r² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(p^2 + q^2 + r^2 = (p + q + r)^2 - 2(pq + qr + rp)\)
\(= 24^2 - 2 \times 65 = 576 - 130\)
\(= \boxed{446}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 446.

question.en: If \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 62\), what is the positive value of \(x + \frac{1}{x}\)? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 62\) है, तो \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) का धनात्मक मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} + 2\)
\(= 62 + 2 = 64\)
\(x + \frac{1}{x} = \boxed{8}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 8.

question.en: Given (a + b)² = 25 and (a - b)² = 9, find a² - b². [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि (a + b)² = 25 और (a - b)² = 9 है, तो a² - b² ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(a^2 - b^2 = (a + b)(a - b)\)
\((a^2 - b^2)^2 = (a + b)^2(a - b)^2 = 25 \times 9 = 225\)
\(a^2 - b^2 = \sqrt{225} = \boxed{15}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 15.

question.en: If (x + y)³ = 27 and x - y = 1, find the value of xy. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि (x + y)³ = 27 और x - y = 1 है, तो xy का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(x + y = 3\) and \(x - y = 1\)
\((x + y)^2 - (x - y)^2 = 4xy\)
\(9 - 1 = 4xy \Rightarrow xy = \frac{8}{4} = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2.

question.en: The sum of seven consecutive natural numbers is K. If the next three natural numbers are also included, the new sum becomes K + 93. What is the largest of the original seven numbers? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: सात क्रमागत प्राकृत संख्याओं का योग K है। यदि अगली तीन प्राकृत संख्याएँ भी शामिल कर ली जाएँ, तो नया योग K + 93 हो जाता है। मूल सात संख्याओं में सबसे बड़ी संख्या क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let the seven numbers be \(a, a+1, \ldots, a+6\), so the largest is \(a + 6\)
The next three are \(a+7, a+8, a+9\)
\(a+7 + a+8 + a+9 = 93 \Rightarrow 3a + 24 = 93 \Rightarrow a = 23\)
Largest = \(23 + 6 = \boxed{29}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 29.

अगली तीन \(a+7, a+8, a+9\) हैं
\(a+7 + a+8 + a+9 = 93 \Rightarrow 3a + 24 = 93 \Rightarrow a = 23\)
सबसे बड़ी = \(23 + 6 = \boxed{29}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 29 है।

question.en: If (x + y)²= 121 and (x - y)² = 9, what is the exact numerical value of the product xy? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि (x + y)²= 121 और (x - y)² = 9 है, तो गुणनफल xy का ठीक संख्यात्मक मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((x + y)^2 - (x - y)^2 = 4xy\)
\(121 - 9 = 4xy \Rightarrow 4xy = 112\)
\(xy = \boxed{28}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 28.

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{10+y} + \sqrt{10-y}}{\sqrt{10+y} - \sqrt{10-y}} = 4\),then find the value of y. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{10+y} + \sqrt{10-y}}{\sqrt{10+y} - \sqrt{10-y}} = 4\) है, तो y का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let \(\sqrt{10+y} = u\) and \(\sqrt{10-y} = v\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 4 \Rightarrow u+v = 4u-4v \Rightarrow 5v = 3u \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = \frac{5}{3}\)
Squaring: \(\frac{10+y}{10-y} = \frac{25}{9}\)
\(90 + 9y = 250 - 25y \Rightarrow 34y = 160\)
\(y = \boxed{\frac{80}{17}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{80}{17}\).

question.en: Solve for X: \(\frac{\sqrt{a+x} + \sqrt{a-x}}{\sqrt{a+x} - \sqrt{a-x}} = k\) [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: X के लिए हल कीजिए: \(\frac{\sqrt{a+x} + \sqrt{a-x}}{\sqrt{a+x} - \sqrt{a-x}} = k\) [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let \(u = \sqrt{a+x}\) and \(v = \sqrt{a-x}\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = k \Rightarrow u+v = ku-kv \Rightarrow u(k-1) = v(k+1)\)
\(\frac{u}{v} = \frac{k+1}{k-1} \Rightarrow \frac{a+x}{a-x} = \frac{(k+1)^2}{(k-1)^2}\)
\((a+x)(k-1)^2 = (a-x)(k+1)^2\)
\(x\left[(k-1)^2 + (k+1)^2\right] = a\left[(k+1)^2 - (k-1)^2\right] = 4ak\)
\(x = \boxed{\frac{2ak}{k^2+1}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{2ak}{k^2+1}\).
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए \(u = \sqrt{a+x}\) और \(v = \sqrt{a-x}\)
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = k \Rightarrow u+v = ku-kv \Rightarrow u(k-1) = v(k+1)\)
\(\frac{u}{v} = \frac{k+1}{k-1} \Rightarrow \frac{a+x}{a-x} = \frac{(k+1)^2}{(k-1)^2}\)

\(x = \boxed{\frac{2ak}{k^2+1}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{2ak}{k^2+1}\) है।

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{x+1} + \sqrt{x-1}}{\sqrt{x+1} - \sqrt{x-1}} = 3\), then find the value of x. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{x+1} + \sqrt{x-1}}{\sqrt{x+1} - \sqrt{x-1}} = 3\) है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let \(u = \sqrt{x+1}\), \(v = \sqrt{x-1}\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 3 \Rightarrow u+v = 3u-3v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = 2\)
So \(\frac{x+1}{x-1} = 4\)
\(x + 1 = 4x - 4 \Rightarrow 3x = 5\)
\(x = \boxed{\frac{5}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{5}{3}\).

question.en: If x² + y² = 29 and x + y = 7, what is the value of (x - y)²? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि x² + y² = 29 और x + y = 7 है, तो (x - y)² का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(2xy = (x + y)^2 - (x^2 + y^2) = 49 - 29 = 20\)
\((x - y)^2 = x^2 + y^2 - 2xy\)
\(= 29 - 20 = \boxed{9}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 9.

question.en: If \(X = \sqrt{\frac{4+\sqrt{15}}{4-\sqrt{15}}}\), then what is the value of \(X + \frac{1}{X}\)? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(X = \sqrt{\frac{4+\sqrt{15}}{4-\sqrt{15}}}\) है, तो \(X + \frac{1}{X}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((4 + \sqrt{15})(4 - \sqrt{15}) = 16 - 15 = 1\)
\(X = \sqrt{\frac{(4+\sqrt{15})^2}{1}} = 4 + \sqrt{15}\)
Then \(\frac{1}{X} = \frac{1}{4+\sqrt{15}} = 4 - \sqrt{15}\)
\(X + \frac{1}{X} = (4 + \sqrt{15}) + (4 - \sqrt{15}) = \boxed{8}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 8.

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 11\), where x ≠ 0, what is the value of \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3}\)? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^3 - 3\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)\)
\(= 11^3 - 3 \times 11 = 1331 - 33\)
\(= \boxed{1298}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1298.

question.en: If \(a + b + c = 0\) and \(abc = 24\), what is the value of \((a + b)(b + c)(c + a)\)? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(a + b + c = 0\) और \(abc = 24\) है, तो \((a + b)(b + c)(c + a)\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
From \(a + b + c = 0\): \(a + b = -c\), \(b + c = -a\), \(c + a = -b\)
\((a + b)(b + c)(c + a) = (-c)(-a)(-b) = -abc\)
\(= -24\), i.e. \(\boxed{-24}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): −24.

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{12+q}+\sqrt{12-q}}{\sqrt{12+q}-\sqrt{12-q}} = 3\), then find the value of q. [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{12+q}+\sqrt{12-q}}{\sqrt{12+q}-\sqrt{12-q}} = 3\) है, तो q का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let \(u = \sqrt{12+q}\), \(v = \sqrt{12-q}\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 3 \Rightarrow u+v = 3u-3v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = 2\)
\(\frac{12+q}{12-q} = 4 \Rightarrow 12 + q = 48 - 4q\)
\(5q = 36 \Rightarrow q = \boxed{\frac{36}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{36}{5}\).

question.en: Find the value of \(\sqrt{17 - 2\sqrt{72}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{17-2\sqrt{72}}}\). [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: \(\sqrt{17 - 2\sqrt{72}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{17-2\sqrt{72}}}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(2\sqrt{72} = 12\sqrt{2}\), and \((3 - 2\sqrt{2})^2 = 17 - 12\sqrt{2}\)
So \(\sqrt{17 - 12\sqrt{2}} = 3 - 2\sqrt{2}\)
\(\frac{1}{3 - 2\sqrt{2}} = 3 + 2\sqrt{2}\)
Expression = \((3 - 2\sqrt{2}) - (3 + 2\sqrt{2}) = \boxed{-4\sqrt{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(-4\sqrt{2}\).

question.en: Simplify the expression: \(\sqrt{16 + 6\sqrt{2} + 6\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{10}}\) [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: व्यंजक को सरल कीजिए: \(\sqrt{16 + 6\sqrt{2} + 6\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{10}}\) [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Try \((\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5} + 3)^2\):
\(= 2 + 5 + 9 + 2\sqrt{10} + 6\sqrt{2} + 6\sqrt{5}\)
\(= 16 + 6\sqrt{2} + 6\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{10}\)
So the square root is \(\boxed{\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5} + 3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{5} + 3\).

question.en: If (a+b)² = 196 and (a−b)² = 36, find ab. [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि (a+b)² = 196 और (a−b)² = 36 है, तो ab ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:

\(196 - 36 = 160 = 4ab\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 40.

question.en: What is the value of (x + 2)³ − (x − 2)³? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

question.en: Find the value of (3x + 2y)² − (3x − 2y)². [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: (3x + 2y)² − (3x − 2y)² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\((a + b)^2 - (a - b)^2 = 4ab\) with \(a = 3x\), \(b = 2y\)
\(= 4 \times 3x \times 2y = \boxed{24xy}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 24xy.
solution.hi:
\((a + b)^2 - (a - b)^2 = 4ab\), जहाँ \(a = 3x\), \(b = 2y\)
\(= 4 \times 3x \times 2y = \boxed{24xy}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 24xy है।

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{3+z}+\sqrt{3-z}}{\sqrt{3+z}-\sqrt{3-z}} = 2\), then find the value of z. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{3+z}+\sqrt{3-z}}{\sqrt{3+z}-\sqrt{3-z}} = 2\) है, तो z का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let \(u = \sqrt{3+z}\), \(v = \sqrt{3-z}\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 2 \Rightarrow u+v = 2u-2v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = 3\)
\(\frac{3+z}{3-z} = 9 \Rightarrow 3 + z = 27 - 9z\)
\(10z = 24 \Rightarrow z = \boxed{\frac{12}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(\frac{12}{5}\).
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए \(u = \sqrt{3+z}\), \(v = \sqrt{3-z}\)
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 2 \Rightarrow u+v = 2u-2v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = 3\)
\(\frac{3+z}{3-z} = 9 \Rightarrow 3 + z = 27 - 9z\)
\(10z = 24 \Rightarrow z = \boxed{\frac{12}{5}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): \(\frac{12}{5}\) है।

question.en: If \(\frac{\sqrt{8+p}+\sqrt{8-p}}{\sqrt{8+p}-\sqrt{8-p}} = 7\), find the value of p. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\sqrt{8+p}+\sqrt{8-p}}{\sqrt{8+p}-\sqrt{8-p}} = 7\) है, तो p का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let \(u = \sqrt{8+p}\), \(v = \sqrt{8-p}\).
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 7 \Rightarrow u+v = 7u-7v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = \frac{4}{3}\)
\(\frac{8+p}{8-p} = \frac{16}{9} \Rightarrow 72 + 9p = 128 - 16p\)
\(25p = 56 \Rightarrow p = \boxed{\frac{56}{25}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{56}{25}\).
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए \(u = \sqrt{8+p}\), \(v = \sqrt{8-p}\)
\(\frac{u+v}{u-v} = 7 \Rightarrow u+v = 7u-7v \Rightarrow \frac{u}{v} = \frac{4}{3}\)
\(\frac{8+p}{8-p} = \frac{16}{9} \Rightarrow 72 + 9p = 128 - 16p\)

question.en: The square of a positive number exceeds twice the number by 8. What is the number? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: किसी धनात्मक संख्या का वर्ग उस संख्या के दोगुने से 8 अधिक है। वह संख्या क्या है? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let the number be \(x > 0\): \(x^2 = 2x + 8\)
\(x^2 - 2x - 8 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 4)(x + 2) = 0\)
Taking the positive root, \(x = \boxed{4}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 4.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए संख्या \(x > 0\) है: \(x^2 = 2x + 8\)
\(x^2 - 2x - 8 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 4)(x + 2) = 0\)
धनात्मक मूल लेने पर, \(x = \boxed{4}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 4 है।

question.en: If p + q + r = 12 and pq + qr + rp = 47, what is the value of p² + q² + r²? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि p + q + r = 12 और pq + qr + rp = 47 है, तो p² + q² + r² का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\((p + q + r)^2 = p^2 + q^2 + r^2 + 2(pq + qr + rp)\)
\(144 = p^2 + q^2 + r^2 + 94\)
\(p^2 + q^2 + r^2 = \boxed{50}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 50.

question.en: If \(X = \frac{\sqrt{7}+\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{5}}\), then find the value of \(X + \frac{1}{X}\). [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(X = \frac{\sqrt{7}+\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{7}-\sqrt{5}}\) है, तो \(X + \frac{1}{X}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Rationalising: \(X = \frac{(\sqrt{7} + \sqrt{5})^2}{7 - 5} = \frac{12 + 2\sqrt{35}}{2} = 6 + \sqrt{35}\)
Then \(\frac{1}{X} = 6 - \sqrt{35}\)
\(X + \frac{1}{X} = 12\), i.e. \(\boxed{12}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 12.

question.en: Which of the following is identically equal to (m + n)³ + (m − n)³? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा (m + n)³ + (m − n)³ के तत्समक रूप से बराबर है? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\((a + b)^3 + (a - b)^3 = 2a^3 + 6ab^2\) with \(a = m\), \(b = n\)
\(= 2m^3 + 6mn^2\)
\(= \boxed{2m(m^2 + 3n^2)}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(2m(m^2 + 3n^2)\).

question.en: What is the value of x if (2x − y)² = 25 and y = 5? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि (2x − y)² = 25 और y = 5 है, तो x का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Put \(y = 5\): \((2x - 5)^2 = 25\)
Taking the positive root, \(2x - 5 = 5 \Rightarrow 2x = 10\)
\(x = \boxed{5}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 5.
solution.hi:
\(y = 5\) रखिए: \((2x - 5)^2 = 25\)
धनात्मक मूल लेने पर, \(2x - 5 = 5 \Rightarrow 2x = 10\)
\(x = \boxed{5}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 5 है।

question.en: If \(x = 10 + 3\sqrt{11}\), what is the value of \(\left(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^2\)? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(x = 10 + 3\sqrt{11}\) है, तो \(\left(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^2\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{10 + 3\sqrt{11}} = \frac{10 - 3\sqrt{11}}{100 - 99} = 10 - 3\sqrt{11}\)
\(x + \frac{1}{x} = (10 + 3\sqrt{11}) + (10 - 3\sqrt{11}) = 20\)
\(\left(\sqrt{x} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\right)^2 = x + \frac{1}{x} - 2 = 20 - 2\)
\(= \boxed{18}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 18.

question.en: Using an algebraic identity, find the value of \(\frac{105 \times 105 - 95 \times 95}{10}\). [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: बीजगणितीय सर्वसमिका का प्रयोग करते हुए \(\frac{105 \times 105 - 95 \times 95}{10}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(105^2 - 95^2 = (105 + 95)(105 - 95) = 200 \times 10\)
Value \(= \frac{2000}{10} = \boxed{200}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 200.

question.en: If a − b = 13 and a² − b² = 65, what is the value of 2a + 2b? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि a − b = 13 और a² − b² = 65 है, तो 2a + 2b का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b) = 65\)
\(13(a + b) = 65 \Rightarrow a + b = 5\)
\(2a + 2b = 2(a + b) = \boxed{10}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 10.

question.en: If x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz + 6, and let L = x − y − z, M = y − z − x, N = z − x − y, then find the value of L³ + M³ + N³ − 3LMN. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz + 6 है, और L = x − y − z, M = y − z − x, N = z − x − y लीजिए, तो L³ + M³ + N³ − 3LMN का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Put s = x + y + z, then L = 2x − s, M = 2y − s, N = 2z − s
So L + M + N = −s, and \(L^2 + M^2 + N^2 - LM - MN - NL = 2[(x-y)^2 + (y-z)^2 + (z-x)^2]\)
The given condition \(x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz = 6\) gives \(s[(x-y)^2 + (y-z)^2 + (z-x)^2] = 12\)
Therefore \(L^3 + M^3 + N^3 - 3LMN = -2 \times 12 = \boxed{-24}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): −24.

question.en: Factorise: x³ + 8 [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: गुणनखंड कीजिए: x³ + 8 [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(a^3 + b^3 = (a + b)(a^2 - ab + b^2)\) with \(a = x\), \(b = 2\)
\(x^3 + 8 = \boxed{(x + 2)(x^2 - 2x + 4)}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): (x + 2)(x² − 2x + 4).

question.en: What is the exact value of the expression (8.35)² − (1.45)²? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: व्यंजक (8.35)² − (1.45)² का सटीक मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

question.en: For what value of \(x\) is the statement \(\left(\frac{x}{12}\right)\left(\frac{x}{48}\right) = 1\) true? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: \(x\) के किस मान के लिए कथन \(\left(\frac{x}{12}\right)\left(\frac{x}{48}\right) = 1\) सत्य है? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x}{12} \times \frac{x}{48} = 1 \Rightarrow \frac{x^2}{576} = 1\)
\(x^2 = 576 \Rightarrow x = 24\) (positive value)
\(x = \boxed{24}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 24.
solution.hi:
\(\frac{x}{12} \times \frac{x}{48} = 1 \Rightarrow \frac{x^2}{576} = 1\)
\(x^2 = 576 \Rightarrow x = 24\) (धनात्मक मान)
\(x = \boxed{24}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 24 है।

question.en: If \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 5\), then find the value of \(\frac{x^2 - 1}{x}\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(x + \frac{1}{x} = 5\) है, तो \(\frac{x^2 - 1}{x}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{x^2 - 1}{x} = x - \frac{1}{x}\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 - 4 = 25 - 4 = 21\)
\(x - \frac{1}{x} = \boxed{\pm\sqrt{21}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\pm\sqrt{21}\).
solution.hi:
\(\frac{x^2 - 1}{x} = x - \frac{1}{x}\)
\(\left(x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = \left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 - 4 = 25 - 4 = 21\)
\(x - \frac{1}{x} = \boxed{\pm\sqrt{21}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\pm\sqrt{21}\) है।

question.en: If \(p - q = 13\) and \(pq = 27\), find \((p + q)^2\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((p + q)^2 = (p - q)^2 + 4pq\)
\(= 169 + 108\)
\(= \boxed{277}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 277.

question.en:
Expand the following expression completely:

\((\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2})^3\) [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित व्यंजक का पूर्ण रूप से विस्तार कीजिए:

\((\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2})^3\) [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\((a + b)^3 = a^3 + b^3 + 3ab(a + b)\) with \(a = \sqrt{5}, b = \sqrt{2}\)
\(= 5\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{2} + 3\sqrt{10}(\sqrt{5} + \sqrt{2})\)
\(= 5\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{2} + 3(5\sqrt{2} + 2\sqrt{5}) = 5\sqrt{5} + 2\sqrt{2} + 15\sqrt{2} + 6\sqrt{5}\)
\(= \boxed{11\sqrt{5} + 17\sqrt{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(11\sqrt{5} + 17\sqrt{2}\).

question.en: If \(a + b + c = 0\) and \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 42\), what is the value of \((a + b)^4 + (b + c)^4 + (c + a)^4\)? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

A designer is creating a square glass panel whose side length is (3 + √7) metres. Before ordering the glass, the designer needs to calculate the exact area of the panel. What is the area in simplified surd form? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: एक डिज़ाइनर एक वर्गाकार काँच का पैनल बना रहा है जिसकी भुजा की लंबाई (3 + √7) मीटर है। काँच मँगवाने से पहले डिज़ाइनर को पैनल का ठीक क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात करना है। सरलतम करणी रूप में क्षेत्रफल क्या है? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Area \(= (3 + \sqrt{7})^2 = 9 + 2 \times 3 \times \sqrt{7} + 7\)
\(= 16 + 6\sqrt{7}\)
\(= \boxed{16 + 6\sqrt{7}\ \text{m}^2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(16 + 6\sqrt{7}\) m².
solution.hi:
क्षेत्रफल \(= (3 + \sqrt{7})^2 = 9 + 2 \times 3 \times \sqrt{7} + 7\)
\(= 16 + 6\sqrt{7}\)
\(= \boxed{16 + 6\sqrt{7}\ \text{m}^2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(16 + 6\sqrt{7}\) m² है।

question.en: The sum of cubes of first n natural number is 1296. Find the value of n [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: प्रथम n प्राकृत संख्याओं के घनों का योग 1296 है। n का मान ज्ञात कीजिए [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\left[\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right]^2 = 1296\)
\(\frac{n(n+1)}{2} = 36 \Rightarrow n(n+1) = 72\)
\(n = \boxed{8}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 8.
solution.hi:
\(\left[\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right]^2 = 1296\)
\(\frac{n(n+1)}{2} = 36 \Rightarrow n(n+1) = 72\)
\(n = \boxed{8}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 8 है।

question.en: Pranay and Manisha are creating arithmetic sequences. They construct an arithmetic progression where the ratio of the first term to the common difference is 1:2. If they calculate the ratio of the sum of the first 4 terms (S₄) to the sum of the first 9 terms (S₉), what will be this ratio in its simplest form? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: प्रणय और मनीषा समांतर श्रेढ़ियाँ बना रहे हैं। वे एक ऐसी समांतर श्रेढ़ी बनाते हैं जिसमें प्रथम पद और सार्व अंतर का अनुपात 1:2 है। यदि वे प्रथम 4 पदों के योग (S₄) और प्रथम 9 पदों के योग (S₉) के अनुपात की गणना करें, तो यह अनुपात सरलतम रूप में क्या होगा? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Let \(a = k\), \(d = 2k\)
\(S_4 = \frac{4}{2}[2k + 3(2k)] = 2(8k) = 16k\)
\(S_9 = \frac{9}{2}[2k + 8(2k)] = \frac{9}{2}(18k) = 81k\)
Ratio \(= \boxed{16 : 81}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 16:81.

question.en: The angles of a quadrilateral are in arithmetic progression. If the smallest angle measures 15°, find the largest angle in degrees. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक चतुर्भुज के कोण समांतर श्रेढ़ी में हैं। यदि सबसे छोटा कोण 15° है, तो सबसे बड़ा कोण डिग्री में ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Angles: \(15, 15+d, 15+2d, 15+3d\)
Sum = \(60 + 6d = 360 \Rightarrow d = 50\)
Largest = \(15 + 3 \times 50 = \boxed{165^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 165°.

question.en: Find the sum of cubes of first 10 odd natural numbers. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: प्रथम 10 विषम प्राकृत संख्याओं के घनों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Sum of cubes of the first \(n\) odd numbers \(= n^2(2n^2 - 1)\)
For \(n = 10\): \(= 100 \times (200 - 1) = 100 \times 199\)
\(= \boxed{19900}\)
Check: \(1^3 + 3^3 + \dots + 19^3 = 19900\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 19900.

question.en: Which of the following sets has cardinality strictly between |N| and |R| under the assumption that the Continuum Hypothesis (CH) holds? [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस समुच्चय की गणनसंख्या (cardinality) सतत परिकल्पना (CH) मानने पर |N| और |R| के बीच स्थित है? [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]

1.en: The set of all algebraic numbers.

2.en: The set of all functions from N to {0, 1}.
2.hi: N से {0, 1} तक के सभी फलनों का समुच्चय।

4.en: No such set exists under CH.
4.hi: CH के अंतर्गत ऐसा कोई समुच्चय नहीं है।

solution.en:
Algebraic numbers are countable, and \(2^{\aleph_0}\) (functions N → {0,1}) and the power set of Q both have the cardinality of R
CH states there is nothing strictly between \(\aleph_0\) and \(2^{\aleph_0}\)
\(\boxed{\text{No such set exists under CH.}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): No such set exists under CH.
solution.hi:
बीजगणितीय संख्याएँ गणनीय हैं, और \(2^{\aleph_0}\) (N → {0,1} फलन) तथा Q का घात समुच्चय दोनों की गणनसंख्या R के बराबर है
CH कहती है कि \(\aleph_0\) और \(2^{\aleph_0}\) के बीच कुछ भी नहीं है
\(\boxed{\text{CH के अंतर्गत ऐसा कोई समुच्चय नहीं है।}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): CH के अंतर्गत ऐसा कोई समुच्चय नहीं है। है।

question.en: Which of the following is a correct statement about the Cantor set C ⊂ [0, 1]? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: कैंटर समुच्चय C ⊂ [0, 1] के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]

1.en: C is countable and has measure 1
1.hi: C गणनीय है और इसका माप 1 है

2.en: C is uncountable and has measure 0
2.hi: C अगणनीय है और इसका माप 0 है

3.en: C is countable and has measure 0
3.hi: C गणनीय है और इसका माप 0 है

4.en: C is uncountable and has measure 1/3
4.hi: C अगणनीय है और इसका माप 1/3 है

solution.en:
The Cantor set is uncountable (it has the cardinality of the continuum) yet has total length (measure) 0
\(\boxed{\text{C is uncountable and has measure 0}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): C is uncountable and has measure 0.
solution.hi:
कैंटर समुच्चय अगणनीय है (इसकी गणनसंख्या सांतत्य के बराबर है), फिर भी इसका कुल माप 0 है
\(\boxed{\text{C अगणनीय है और इसका माप 0 है}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): C अगणनीय है और इसका माप 0 है है।

question.en: Let A = {all finite subsets of ℕ} and B = {all infinite subsets of ℕ}. Which is correct? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: मान लीजिए A = {ℕ के सभी परिमित उपसमुच्चय} और B = {ℕ के सभी अपरिमित उपसमुच्चय}। कौन-सा सही है? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Finite subsets of ℕ can be listed size by size (countable union of countable sets) → \(|A| = \aleph_0\)
All subsets of ℕ: \(2^{\aleph_0}\) (uncountable). B = all subsets minus A
Removing a countable set from an uncountable set leaves \(2^{\aleph_0}\) → \(|B| = 2^{\aleph_0}\)
\(\boxed{|A| = \aleph_0,\ |B| = 2^{\aleph_0}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(|A| = \aleph_0,\ |B| = 2^{\aleph_0}\).
solution.hi:
ℕ के परिमित उपसमुच्चयों को आकार के क्रम से सूचीबद्ध किया जा सकता है (गणनीय समुच्चयों का गणनीय संघ) → \(|A| = \aleph_0\)
ℕ के सभी उपसमुच्चय: \(2^{\aleph_0}\) (अगणनीय). B = सभी उपसमुच्चय − A
अगणनीय समुच्चय से गणनीय समुच्चय हटाने पर \(2^{\aleph_0}\) ही बचता है → \(|B| = 2^{\aleph_0}\)
\(\boxed{|A| = \aleph_0,\ |B| = 2^{\aleph_0}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): \(|A| = \aleph_0,\ |B| = 2^{\aleph_0}\) है।

question.en: Let f : Q → Q be a field automorphism. How many such automorphisms exist? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: मान लीजिए f : Q → Q एक क्षेत्र स्वाकारित्व (field automorphism) है। ऐसे कितने स्वाकारित्व होते हैं? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Any automorphism of Q fixes 1, hence fixes every integer
It also fixes every fraction, since \(f\left(\frac{m}{n}\right) = \frac{f(m)}{f(n)} = \frac{m}{n}\)
So every element of Q is fixed
Only the identity map works: \(\boxed{\text{Exactly 1 (the identity)}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Exactly 1 (the identity).
solution.hi:
Q का कोई भी स्वाकारित्व 1 को स्थिर रखता है, अतः हर पूर्णांक को स्थिर रखता है
यह हर भिन्न को भी स्थिर रखता है, क्योंकि \(f\left(\frac{m}{n}\right) = \frac{f(m)}{f(n)} = \frac{m}{n}\)
इसलिए Q का प्रत्येक अवयव स्थिर है
केवल तत्समक प्रतिचित्रण संभव है: \(\boxed{\text{ठीक 1 (तत्समक)}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): ठीक 1 (तत्समक) है।

question.en: The set of computable real numbers is: [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: गणना-योग्य वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय है: [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

3.en: A countable dense subfield of R

4.en: An uncountable proper subset of R

solution.en:
Every algorithm is a finite string, so only countably many real numbers can be computed
The computable numbers contain all rationals, hence they are dense in R and form a subfield
So they form \(\boxed{\text{A countable dense subfield of R}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): A countable dense subfield of R.
solution.hi:
प्रत्येक कलन विधि एक परिमित शब्दमाला है, अतः केवल गणनीय रूप से अनेक वास्तविक संख्याओं की गणना संभव है
गणना-योग्य संख्याओं में सभी परिमेय संख्याएँ सम्मिलित हैं, अतः ये R में सघन हैं और एक उपक्षेत्र बनाती हैं
अतः ये \(\boxed{\text{R का गणनीय सघन उपक्षेत्र}}\) हैं

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): R का गणनीय सघन उपक्षेत्र है।

question.en: If Q is dense in R and R \ Q (the irrationals) is also dense in R, which conclusion follows directly from the density of the irrationals in R? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि Q, R में सघन है और R \ Q (अपरिमेय संख्याएँ) भी R में सघन है, तो R में अपरिमेय संख्याओं की सघनता से सीधे कौन-सा निष्कर्ष निकलता है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

1.en: Between any two irrationals there is no rational.
1.hi: किन्हीं दो अपरिमेय संख्याओं के बीच कोई परिमेय संख्या नहीं होती।

2.en: Every open interval in R contains uncountably many irrationals and countably many rational numbers.
2.hi: R के प्रत्येक खुले अंतराल में अगणनीय रूप से अनेक अपरिमेय और गणनीय रूप से अनेक परिमेय संख्याएँ होती हैं।

3.en: The closure of R \ Q in R is R itself.
3.hi: R में R \ Q का संवृत (closure) स्वयं R है।

4.en: Q and R \ Q have the same cardinality.
4.hi: Q और R \ Q की गणन-संख्या (cardinality) समान है।

solution.en:
A set is dense in R exactly when its closure is the whole of R.
Since R \ Q is given to be dense in R, its closure in R is R itself:
\(\overline{\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q}} = \mathbb{R}\)
So the answer is \(\boxed{\text{The closure of } \mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Q} \text{ in } \mathbb{R} \text{ is } \mathbb{R} \text{ itself}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): The closure of R \ Q in R is R itself.
solution.hi:
कोई समुच्चय R में तब सघन होता है जब उसका संवृत (closure) पूरा R हो।
चूँकि R \ Q को R में सघन दिया गया है, R में इसका संवृत स्वयं R है:
