\(\theta = \boxed{60°}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 60° है।

question.en: If tan θ = √5, find the value of \(\frac{\csc^2\theta + \sec^2\theta}{\csc^2\theta - \sec^2\theta}\). [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि tan θ = √5 है, तो \(\frac{\csc^2\theta + \sec^2\theta}{\csc^2\theta - \sec^2\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\csc^2\theta = 1 + \cot^2\theta = 1 + \frac{1}{5} = \frac{6}{5}\), \(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta = 6\)
\(= \frac{\frac{6}{5} + 6}{\frac{6}{5} - 6} = \frac{36/5}{-24/5}\)
\(= \boxed{-\frac{3}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(-\frac{3}{2}\).

question.en: The hour hand of a clock moves from 3:00 to 7:00. What angle does it sweep in radians? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: घड़ी की घंटे वाली सुई 3:00 से 7:00 तक घूमती है। यह कितने रेडियन कोण घूमती है? [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
4 hours out of 12 \(= \frac{4}{12}\) of a full turn
\(= \frac{1}{3} \times 2\pi = \boxed{\frac{2\pi}{3}\ \text{radians}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) radians.
solution.hi:
12 में से 4 घंटे \(= \frac{4}{12}\) पूर्ण चक्कर का
\(= \frac{1}{3} \times 2\pi = \boxed{\frac{2\pi}{3}\ \text{रेडियन}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) रेडियन है।

question.en: In a triangle ABC, right-angled at B, if \(\tan A = \frac{5}{2}\), find the value of \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\). [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: त्रिभुज ABC में, B पर समकोण है, यदि \(\tan A = \frac{5}{2}\) है, तो \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan A = \frac{5}{2}\) with \(\angle B = 90°\), so \(\angle A + \angle C = 90°\): \(\cos C = \sin A\), \(\sin C = \cos A\)
\(= \frac{\sin A(\sin A + \cos A)}{\sin A(\cos A - \sin A)} = \frac{\sin A + \cos A}{\cos A - \sin A}\)
Divide by \(\cos A\): \(= \frac{\tan A + 1}{1 - \tan A} = \frac{2.5 + 1}{1 - 2.5} = \frac{3.5}{-1.5}\)
\(= \boxed{-\frac{7}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(-\frac{7}{3}\).
solution.hi:
\(\tan A = \frac{5}{2}\) और \(\angle B = 90°\), अतः \(\angle A + \angle C = 90°\): \(\cos C = \sin A\), \(\sin C = \cos A\)
\(= \frac{\sin A(\sin A + \cos A)}{\sin A(\cos A - \sin A)} = \frac{\sin A + \cos A}{\cos A - \sin A}\)
\(\cos A\) से भाग देने पर: \(= \frac{\tan A + 1}{1 - \tan A} = \frac{2.5 + 1}{1 - 2.5} = \frac{3.5}{-1.5}\)
\(= \boxed{-\frac{7}{3}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(-\frac{7}{3}\) है।

question.en: If θ = 2π/3 radians, find the quadrant in which θ lies. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि θ = 2π/3 रेडियन है, तो θ किस चतुर्थांश में स्थित है? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3} = 120°\)
\(90° < 120° < 180°\)
So θ lies in quadrant \(\boxed{II}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): II.
solution.hi:
\(\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3} = 120°\)
\(90° < 120° < 180°\)
अतः θ \(\boxed{II}\) चतुर्थांश में है

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): II है।

question.en: If 20 sin θ + 21 cos θ = 29, find the value of sin θ. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि 20 sin θ + 21 cos θ = 29 है, तो sin θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Here \(\sqrt{20^2 + 21^2} = 29\), so \(\sin\theta = \frac{20}{29}\) and \(\cos\theta = \frac{21}{29}\)
Check: \(20\left(\frac{20}{29}\right) + 21\left(\frac{21}{29}\right) = \frac{400 + 441}{29} = 29\) ✓
\(\sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{20}{29}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{20}{29}\).

question.en: If two angles of a triangle are \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) radians and 45°, find the third angle in degrees. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि किसी त्रिभुज के दो कोण \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) रेडियन और 45° हैं, तो तीसरा कोण डिग्री में ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\pi}{3} = 60°\)
Third angle \(= 180° - 60° - 45°\)
\(= \boxed{75°}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 75°.

question.en: If \(\sin A = \frac{4}{5}\) and \(\cos B = \frac{5}{13}\), where A and B are acute angles, then what is the value of sin A cos B? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\sin A = \frac{4}{5}\) और \(\cos B = \frac{5}{13}\) हैं, जहाँ A और B न्यून कोण हैं, तो sin A cos B का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sin A\cos B = \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{5}{13}\)
\(= \frac{20}{65}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{20}{65}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{20}{65}\).
solution.hi:
\(\sin A\cos B = \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{5}{13}\)
\(= \frac{20}{65}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{20}{65}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{20}{65}\) है।

question.en: In triangle PQR, right-angled at Q, if \(\tan P = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), find sin R. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: त्रिभुज PQR में, Q पर समकोण है, यदि \(\tan P = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) है, तो sin R ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan P = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \Rightarrow P = 30°\), so \(R = 90° - 30° = 60°\)
\(\sin R = \sin 60°\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).
solution.hi:
\(\tan P = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \Rightarrow P = 30°\), अतः \(R = 90° - 30° = 60°\)
\(\sin R = \sin 60°\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) है।

question.en: If cot A = 7, then find the value of \(\frac{5\cos A + 4\sin A}{\cos^3 A + 7\sin^3 A + 6\sin A}\). [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि cot A = 7 है, तो \(\frac{5\cos A + 4\sin A}{\cos^3 A + 7\sin^3 A + 6\sin A}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
With \(\cot A = 7\), take \(\cos A = 7k\), \(\sin A = k\) where \(k = \frac{1}{\sqrt{50}}\)
\(\cos^3A + 7\sin^3A = k^3(343 + 7) = 350k^3 = 7k = \cos A\)
So the expression becomes \(\frac{5\cos A + 4\sin A}{\cos A + 6\sin A}\)
\(= \frac{35k + 4k}{7k + 6k} = \frac{39}{13} = \boxed{3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 3.
solution.hi:
\(\cot A = 7\) के लिए \(\cos A = 7k\), \(\sin A = k\) लीजिए, जहाँ \(k = \frac{1}{\sqrt{50}}\)
\(\cos^3A + 7\sin^3A = k^3(343 + 7) = 350k^3 = 7k = \cos A\)
अतः व्यंजक बन जाता है \(\frac{5\cos A + 4\sin A}{\cos A + 6\sin A}\)
\(= \frac{35k + 4k}{7k + 6k} = \frac{39}{13} = \boxed{3}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 3 है।

question.en: In a right triangle ABC with ∠B = 90°, sin²A + sin²C = ? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: समकोण त्रिभुज ABC में, जहाँ ∠B = 90° है, sin²A + sin²C = ? [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(A + C = 90° \Rightarrow C = 90° - A\), so \(\sin C = \cos A\)
\(\sin^2A + \sin^2C = \sin^2A + \cos^2A\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 1.
solution.hi:
\(A + C = 90° \Rightarrow C = 90° - A\), अतः \(\sin C = \cos A\)
\(\sin^2A + \sin^2C = \sin^2A + \cos^2A\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 1 है।

question.en: Solve for acute θ: sin(θ + 15°) = cos(θ − 15°) [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: न्यून θ के लिए हल कीजिए: sin(θ + 15°) = cos(θ − 15°) [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin(\theta + 15°) = \cos(\theta - 15°) = \sin(90° - \theta + 15°)\)
\(\theta + 15° = 105° - \theta \Rightarrow 2\theta = 90°\)
\(\theta = \boxed{45°}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 45°.

\(\theta + 15° = 105° - \theta \Rightarrow 2\theta = 90°\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 45° है।

question.en: If secθ = 13/12, then find the value of tan²θ. [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि secθ = 13/12 है, तो tan²θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta - 1 = \frac{169}{144} - 1\)
\(= \frac{25}{144}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{25}{144}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 25/144.

question.en: If 0° < θ < 90°, find the value of \(\sqrt{\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta}} - \tan\theta\). [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि 0° < θ < 90° है, तो \(\sqrt{\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta}} - \tan\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{1-\sin^2\theta}} = \frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta\)
So the expression \(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta - \tan\theta = \boxed{\sec\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): secθ.
solution.hi:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1+\sin\theta}{1-\sin\theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1+\sin\theta)^2}{1-\sin^2\theta}} = \frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta\)
अतः व्यंजक \(= \sec\theta + \tan\theta - \tan\theta = \boxed{\sec\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): secθ है।

question.en: If \(\sqrt{5}\sin\theta = 1\), find the value of \(\frac{2\tan\theta + \sqrt{5}\sin\theta}{\sqrt{5}\cos\theta - 2\tan\theta}\). [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\sqrt{5}\sin\theta = 1\) है, तो \(\frac{2\tan\theta + \sqrt{5}\sin\theta}{\sqrt{5}\cos\theta - 2\tan\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\), \(\tan\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
Numerator \(= 2\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 1 = 2\); denominator \(= 2 - 1 = 1\)
\(= \frac{2}{1} = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\), \(\tan\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
अंश \(= 2\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + 1 = 2\); हर \(= 2 - 1 = 1\)
\(= \frac{2}{1} = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 2 है।

question.en: Evaluate: \(\frac{\sec 73°}{\text{cosec}\,17°} - 1\) [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: \(\frac{\sec 73°}{\text{cosec}\,17°} - 1\) [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\text{cosec}\,17° = \sec(90° - 17°) = \sec 73°\)
So the fraction \(= 1\)
\(1 - 1 = \boxed{0}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 0.

question.en: If sinθ + cosθ = √2, then what is the value of sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि sinθ + cosθ = √2 है, तो sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Squaring: \(1 + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = 2 \Rightarrow \sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
\(\sin^4\theta + \cos^4\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\)
\(= 1 - 2\left(\frac{1}{4}\right) = \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1/2.

question.en: If \(\tan\theta = \frac{1}{2}\), find the value of \(\frac{\text{cosec}^2\theta + \sec^2\theta}{\text{cosec}^2\theta - \sec^2\theta}\). [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\tan\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) है, तो \(\frac{\text{cosec}^2\theta + \sec^2\theta}{\text{cosec}^2\theta - \sec^2\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{5}{4}\), \(\text{cosec}^2\theta = 1 + 4 = 5\)
\(\frac{5 + \frac{5}{4}}{5 - \frac{5}{4}} = \frac{25/4}{15/4}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{5}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{5}{3}\).

question.en: If the difference between two complementary angles is \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) radians, what are the two angles in degrees? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि दो पूरक कोणों का अंतर \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) रेडियन है, तो वे दोनों कोण डिग्री में क्या हैं? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\pi}{6}\) rad \(= 30°\); also \(x + y = 90°\)
\(x - y = 30° \Rightarrow x = 60°\), \(y = 30°\)
\(\boxed{60°\ \text{and}\ 30°}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 60° and 30°.

question.en: If tanθ = 0, then sec²θ equals? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि tanθ = 0 है, तो sec²θ किसके बराबर है? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta = 1 + 0\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 1.

question.en: In a mechanical system designed to dampen vibrations, two rotating components operate at angles whose tangent values sum to 3 and multiply to 2. To determine the resulting vibration amplitude during phase overlap, the sine of the sum of these angles is required. If two angles have tangent values such that their sum is 3 and product is 2, find the sine of the sum of the two angles. [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: कंपन को कम करने के लिए बनाए गए एक यांत्रिक तंत्र में, दो घूर्णनशील घटक ऐसे कोणों पर कार्य करते हैं जिनके स्पर्शज्या (tan) मानों का योग 3 और गुणनफल 2 है। फेज ओवरलैप के दौरान परिणामी कंपन आयाम ज्ञात करने के लिए इन कोणों के योग की ज्या (sine) आवश्यक है। यदि दो कोणों के tan मानों का योग 3 और गुणनफल 2 है, तो उन दोनों कोणों के योग की ज्या ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan(A+B) = \frac{3}{1 - 2} = -3\)
So \(\sin(A+B) = \frac{-3}{\sqrt{10}} \approx -0.9487\)
\(= \boxed{-0.9487}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): (-0.9487).

question.en: In a virtual reality simulation, a character's movement follows a smooth arc defined by an angle θ relative to a reference axis. During one animation frame, developers notice that the sum of sine and cosine of the angle θ is equal to 1. To fine-tune motion rendering, the graphics engine estimates rotational energy using the sum of the cubes of sine and cosine of θ. What is the value of sin³θ + cos³θ, given that sinθ + cosθ = 1? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: एक वर्चुअल रियलिटी सिमुलेशन में, किसी पात्र की गति संदर्भ अक्ष के सापेक्ष कोण θ द्वारा परिभाषित एक चिकने चाप पर होती है। एक एनिमेशन फ्रेम के दौरान डेवलपर्स देखते हैं कि कोण θ की ज्या और कोज्या का योग 1 के बराबर है। मोशन रेंडरिंग को बेहतर बनाने के लिए ग्राफ़िक्स इंजन θ की ज्या और कोज्या के घनों के योग से घूर्णन ऊर्जा का अनुमान लगाता है। यदि sinθ + cosθ = 1 है, तो sin³θ + cos³θ का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let \(s = \sin\theta\), \(c = \cos\theta\) with \(s + c = 1\)
Squaring: \(1 + 2sc = 1 \Rightarrow sc = 0\)
\(s^3 + c^3 = (s + c)^3 - 3sc(s + c) = 1 - 0 = \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1.

question.en: If cosθ = \(\frac{5}{13}\) and θ is an acute angle, find 4(cosecθ − cotθ). [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि cosθ = \(\frac{5}{13}\) और θ न्यून कोण है, तो 4(cosecθ − cotθ) ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{12}{13}\)
\(\text{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{13}{12} - \frac{5}{12} = \frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\)
\(4 \times \frac{2}{3} = \boxed{\frac{8}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(\frac{8}{3}\).

question.en: If tanθ = \(\frac{3}{4}\) and θ is an acute angle, find cosecθ − cotθ. [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 1]

\(3 - 4 - 5\) triangle: \(\text{cosec}\theta = \frac{5}{3}\), \(\cot\theta = \frac{4}{3}\)

\(= \boxed{\frac{1}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(\frac{1}{3}\).

question.en: If secθ + tanθ = 5, find the value of sinθ. [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि secθ + tanθ = 5 है, तो sinθ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{k^2 - 1}{k^2 + 1}\) with \(k = 5\)
\(= \frac{25 - 1}{25 + 1} = \frac{24}{26}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{12}{13}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{12}{13}\).

question.en: In a right triangle ABC with ∠C = 90°, if sin A = 0.6, find tan B. [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: समकोण त्रिभुज ABC में जहाँ ∠C = 90° है, यदि sin A = 0.6 है, तो tan B ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin A = \frac{3}{5} \Rightarrow BC : CA : AB = 3 : 4 : 5\)
\(\tan B = \frac{AC}{BC}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{4}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{4}{3}\).

question.en: If cosθ = 4/5, find tan²θ + sec²θ. [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 3]

question.en: What is the value of \(\frac{8\cos^2 30° + 4\sin^2 45° - 3\text{cosec}^2 60°}{2\tan^2 60° - 6\text{cosec} 30°}\)? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: \(\frac{8\cos^2 30° + 4\sin^2 45° - 3\text{cosec}^2 60°}{2\tan^2 60° - 6\text{cosec} 30°}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Numerator \(= 8\left(\frac{3}{4}\right) + 4\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) - 3\left(\frac{4}{3}\right) = 6 + 2 - 4 = 4\)
Denominator \(= 2(3) - 6(2) = 6 - 12 = -6\)
\(\frac{4}{-6} = \boxed{\frac{-2}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{-2}{3}\).

question.en: If tanA = m and A is an acute angle, what is the value of cosA? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि tanA = m और A न्यून कोण है, तो cosA का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A = 1 + m^2\)
\(\cos A = \frac{1}{\sec A}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+m^2}}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+m^2}}\).

question.en: If 3 sinθ − 4 cosθ = 0, where 0° < θ < 90°, find \(\frac{3\sin\theta + \cos\theta}{3\sin\theta + 2\cos\theta}\). [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 2]

\(\frac{12k + 3k}{12k + 6k} = \frac{15}{18}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{5}{6}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{5}{6}\).

question.en: In triangle ABC, right-angled at B, if tan A = \(\frac{1}{3}\), find the value of \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\). [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: त्रिभुज ABC में, जो B पर समकोण है, यदि tan A = \(\frac{1}{3}\) है, तो \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan A = \frac{1}{3} \Rightarrow \sin A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\), \(\cos A = \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\)
\(C = 90° - A\), so \(\cos C = \sin A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\), \(\sin C = \cos A = \frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\)
\(\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\left(\frac{4}{\sqrt{10}}\right)}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{10}}\right)} = \frac{4}{2} = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2.

question.en: If \(\cosec\theta - \cot\theta = p\), find the value of \(\frac{p^2 - 1}{p^2 + 1}\). [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\cosec\theta - \cot\theta = p\) है, तो \(\frac{p^2 - 1}{p^2 + 1}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(p = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \Rightarrow p^2 = \frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{1 - \cos^2\theta} = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}\)
\(\frac{p^2 - 1}{p^2 + 1} = \frac{(1 - \cos\theta) - (1 + \cos\theta)}{(1 - \cos\theta) + (1 + \cos\theta)} = \frac{-2\cos\theta}{2}\)
\(= \boxed{-\cos\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(-\cos\theta\).
solution.hi:
\(p = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} \Rightarrow p^2 = \frac{(1 - \cos\theta)^2}{1 - \cos^2\theta} = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}\)

\(= \boxed{-\cos\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(-\cos\theta\) है।

question.en: Solve for acute \(\theta\): \(\tan(\theta + 24^\circ) = \cot(\theta - 12^\circ)\) [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

\((\theta + 24^\circ) + (\theta - 12^\circ) = 90^\circ\)
\(2\theta = 78^\circ \Rightarrow \theta = \boxed{39^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 39°.

question.en: In a right triangle XYZ with \(\angle Y = 90^\circ\), if \(\angle X = 2\angle Z\), find cos X. [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 1]

question.en: If the minute hand of a clock rotates through an angle of \(\frac{7\pi}{6}\) radians. How many minutes does this represent? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि घड़ी की मिनट की सुई \(\frac{7\pi}{6}\) रेडियन के कोण से घूमती है, तो यह कितने मिनट को दर्शाता है? [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Minute hand turns \(2\pi\) radians in 60 minutes
Time = \(\frac{7\pi/6}{2\pi} \times 60 = \frac{7}{12} \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{35}\) minutes

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 35 minutes.
solution.hi:
मिनट की सुई 60 मिनट में \(2\pi\) रेडियन घूमती है
समय = \(\frac{7\pi/6}{2\pi} \times 60 = \frac{7}{12} \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{35}\) मिनट

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 35 मिनट है।

question.en: If tanθ = 3/4, find the value of (1 + sinθ)(1 − sinθ). [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि tanθ = 3/4 है, तो (1 + sinθ)(1 − sinθ) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) → P = 3, B = 4, H = 5 → \(\cos\theta = \frac{4}{5}\)
\((1 + \sin\theta)(1 - \sin\theta) = 1 - \sin^2\theta = \cos^2\theta\)
\(= \left(\frac{4}{5}\right)^2 = \boxed{\frac{16}{25}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 16/25.
solution.hi:
\(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) → लंब = 3, आधार = 4, कर्ण = 5 → \(\cos\theta = \frac{4}{5}\)
\((1 + \sin\theta)(1 - \sin\theta) = 1 - \sin^2\theta = \cos^2\theta\)
\(= \left(\frac{4}{5}\right)^2 = \boxed{\frac{16}{25}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 16/25 है।

question.en: If \(0^\circ \lt \theta \lt 90^\circ\), find the value of \(1 + \sqrt{\frac{\tan\theta + \sin\theta}{\tan\theta - \sin\theta}}\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(0^\circ \lt \theta \lt 90^\circ\) है, तो \(1 + \sqrt{\frac{\tan\theta + \sin\theta}{\tan\theta - \sin\theta}}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\tan\theta + \sin\theta}{\tan\theta - \sin\theta} = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{1 - \cos\theta} = \frac{(1 + \cos\theta)^2}{\sin^2\theta}\)
\(\sqrt{\ \ } = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cosec\theta + \cot\theta\)
Value = \(\boxed{1 + \cosec\theta + \cot\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(1 + \cosec\theta + \cot\theta\).
solution.hi:
\(\frac{\tan\theta + \sin\theta}{\tan\theta - \sin\theta} = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{1 - \cos\theta} = \frac{(1 + \cos\theta)^2}{\sin^2\theta}\)
\(\sqrt{\ \ } = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cosec\theta + \cot\theta\)
मान = \(\boxed{1 + \cosec\theta + \cot\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(1 + \cosec\theta + \cot\theta\) है।

question.en: If \(\cos^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) and \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 90^\circ\), how many distinct values of \(\theta\) satisfy this equation? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\cos^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) और \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 90^\circ\) है, तो \(\theta\) के कितने भिन्न मान इस समीकरण को संतुष्ट करते हैं? [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\cos\theta = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); in 0° to 90°, cos θ ≥ 0 → \(\cos\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)
\(\theta = 45^\circ\) only
Number of values = \(\boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 1.
solution.hi:
\(\cos\theta = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\); 0° से 90° में cos θ ≥ 0 → \(\cos\theta = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)
केवल \(\theta = 45^\circ\)
मानों की संख्या = \(\boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 1 है।

question.en: Evaluate: \(\tan 42^\circ \tan 48^\circ - \cot 48^\circ \cot 42^\circ\) [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: \(\tan 42^\circ \tan 48^\circ - \cot 48^\circ \cot 42^\circ\) [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan 48^\circ = \cot 42^\circ\) → \(\tan 42^\circ \tan 48^\circ = 1\)
\(\cot 48^\circ = \tan 42^\circ\) → \(\cot 48^\circ \cot 42^\circ = 1\)
Value = 1 − 1 = \(\boxed{0}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 0.
solution.hi:
\(\tan 48^\circ = \cot 42^\circ\) → \(\tan 42^\circ \tan 48^\circ = 1\)
\(\cot 48^\circ = \tan 42^\circ\) → \(\cot 48^\circ \cot 42^\circ = 1\)
मान = 1 − 1 = \(\boxed{0}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 0 है।

question.en: If \(3\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta = 5\), find the value of \(\sin\theta\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(3\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta = 5\) है, तो \(\sin\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((3\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta)^2 + (3\cos\theta - 4\sin\theta)^2 = 9 + 16 = 25\)
\(25 + (3\cos\theta - 4\sin\theta)^2 = 25 \Rightarrow 3\cos\theta = 4\sin\theta\)
\(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{3}{5}\).
solution.hi:
\((3\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta)^2 + (3\cos\theta - 4\sin\theta)^2 = 9 + 16 = 25\)
\(25 + (3\cos\theta - 4\sin\theta)^2 = 25 \Rightarrow 3\cos\theta = 4\sin\theta\)
\(\tan\theta = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{3}{5}\) है।

question.en: If \(5\sin\theta + 12\cos\theta = 13\), then find the value of \(\sin\theta\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(5\sin\theta + 12\cos\theta = 13\) है, तो \(\sin\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\((5\sin\theta + 12\cos\theta)^2 + (5\cos\theta - 12\sin\theta)^2 = 25 + 144 = 169\)
\(169 + (5\cos\theta - 12\sin\theta)^2 = 169 \Rightarrow 5\cos\theta = 12\sin\theta\)
\(\tan\theta = \frac{5}{12} \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{5}{13}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{5}{13}\).
solution.hi:
\((5\sin\theta + 12\cos\theta)^2 + (5\cos\theta - 12\sin\theta)^2 = 25 + 144 = 169\)
\(169 + (5\cos\theta - 12\sin\theta)^2 = 169 \Rightarrow 5\cos\theta = 12\sin\theta\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): \(\frac{5}{13}\) है।

question.en: In a triangle ABC, right-angled at B, if \(\cot A = 2\), find the value of \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\). [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: B पर समकोण वाले एक त्रिभुज ABC में, यदि \(\cot A = 2\) है, तो \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
AB = 2, BC = 1, AC = \(\sqrt{5}\)
\(\sin A = \cos C = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos A = \sin C = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\)
Value = \(\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \times \frac{3}{\sqrt{5}}}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}} = \frac{3/5}{1/5} = \boxed{3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 3.
solution.hi:
AB = 2, BC = 1, AC = \(\sqrt{5}\)
\(\sin A = \cos C = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos A = \sin C = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\)
मान = \(\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \times \frac{3}{\sqrt{5}}}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}} = \frac{3/5}{1/5} = \boxed{3}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 3 है।

question.en: If \(\tan\alpha\) and \(\tan\beta\) are roots of \(x^2 - px + q = 0\), find \(\cos^2(\alpha + \beta)\). [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\tan\alpha\) और \(\tan\beta\), \(x^2 - px + q = 0\) के मूल हैं, तो \(\cos^2(\alpha + \beta)\) ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan\alpha + \tan\beta = p,\ \tan\alpha\tan\beta = q\) → \(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{p}{1 - q}\)
\(\cos^2(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2(\alpha + \beta)} = \frac{1}{1 + \frac{p^2}{(1 - q)^2}}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{(1 - q)^2}{p^2 + (1 - q)^2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(\frac{(1 - q)^2}{p^2 + (1 - q)^2}\).
solution.hi:
\(\tan\alpha + \tan\beta = p,\ \tan\alpha\tan\beta = q\) → \(\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{p}{1 - q}\)
\(\cos^2(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{1}{1 + \tan^2(\alpha + \beta)} = \frac{1}{1 + \frac{p^2}{(1 - q)^2}}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{(1 - q)^2}{p^2 + (1 - q)^2}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): \(\frac{(1 - q)^2}{p^2 + (1 - q)^2}\) है।

question.en: If \(\sqrt{13}\sin\theta = 2\), find the value of \(\frac{3\tan\theta + \sqrt{13}\sin\theta}{\sqrt{13}\cos\theta - 3\tan\theta}\). [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\sqrt{13}\sin\theta = 2\) है, तो \(\frac{3\tan\theta + \sqrt{13}\sin\theta}{\sqrt{13}\cos\theta - 3\tan\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{2}{\sqrt{13}} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}},\ \tan\theta = \frac{2}{3}\)
Numerator = \(3 \times \frac{2}{3} + 2 = 4\); Denominator = \(3 - 3 \times \frac{2}{3} = 1\)
Value = \(\boxed{4}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 4.
solution.hi:
\(\sin\theta = \frac{2}{\sqrt{13}} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}},\ \tan\theta = \frac{2}{3}\)
अंश = \(3 \times \frac{2}{3} + 2 = 4\); हर = \(3 - 3 \times \frac{2}{3} = 1\)
मान = \(\boxed{4}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 4 है।

question.en: Solve for acute \(\theta\): \(\cos 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\) [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: न्यून कोण \(\theta\) के लिए हल कीजिए: \(\cos 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\) [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\cos 3\theta = \sin 2\theta \Rightarrow 3\theta + 2\theta = 90^\circ\)
\(5\theta = 90^\circ\)
\(\theta = \boxed{18^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 18°.
solution.hi:
\(\cos 3\theta = \sin 2\theta \Rightarrow 3\theta + 2\theta = 90^\circ\)
\(5\theta = 90^\circ\)
\(\theta = \boxed{18^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 18° है।

question.en: Evaluate: \(\cos^2 10^\circ + \cos^2 20^\circ + \cos^2 30^\circ + \cos^2 40^\circ + \cos^2 50^\circ + \cos^2 60^\circ + \cos^2 70^\circ + \cos^2 80^\circ\) [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: \(\cos^2 10^\circ + \cos^2 20^\circ + \cos^2 30^\circ + \cos^2 40^\circ + \cos^2 50^\circ + \cos^2 60^\circ + \cos^2 70^\circ + \cos^2 80^\circ\) [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\cos^2 80^\circ = \sin^2 10^\circ\), so \(\cos^2 10^\circ + \cos^2 80^\circ = 1\)
Pairs (10°, 80°), (20°, 70°), (30°, 60°), (40°, 50°) each give 1
Sum = \(\boxed{4}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 4.

question.en: If sec²A + tan²A = 10, then find sec⁴A − tan⁴A. [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि sec²A + tan²A = 10 है, तो sec⁴A − tan⁴A ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sec^4 A - \tan^4 A = (\sec^2 A + \tan^2 A)(\sec^2 A - \tan^2 A)\)
\(\sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1\)
Value = \(10 \times 1 = \boxed{10}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 10.
solution.hi:
\(\sec^4 A - \tan^4 A = (\sec^2 A + \tan^2 A)(\sec^2 A - \tan^2 A)\)
\(\sec^2 A - \tan^2 A = 1\)
मान = \(10 \times 1 = \boxed{10}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 10 है।

question.en: If sinA = 3/5, and A is acute, find the value of sin²A + cos²A + tan²A. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि sinA = 3/5 है, और A न्यून कोण है, तो sin²A + cos²A + tan²A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1\)
\(\sin A = \frac{3}{5} \Rightarrow \cos A = \frac{4}{5},\ \tan A = \frac{3}{4}\)
Value = \(1 + \frac{9}{16} = \boxed{\frac{25}{16}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 25/16.
solution.hi:
\(\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A = 1\)
\(\sin A = \frac{3}{5} \Rightarrow \cos A = \frac{4}{5},\ \tan A = \frac{3}{4}\)
मान = \(1 + \frac{9}{16} = \boxed{\frac{25}{16}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 25/16 है।

question.en: If \(\tan\theta = 2\), find the value of \(\frac{\sec^2\theta - \cosec^2\theta}{\sec^2\theta + \cosec^2\theta}\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\tan\theta = 2\) है, तो \(\frac{\sec^2\theta - \cosec^2\theta}{\sec^2\theta + \cosec^2\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sec^2\theta = 1 + 4 = 5,\ \cosec^2\theta = 1 + \frac{1}{4} = \frac{5}{4}\)
Value = \(\frac{5 - \frac{5}{4}}{5 + \frac{5}{4}} = \frac{15/4}{25/4}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{3}{5}\).

question.en: If \(\frac{(7\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta)}{(9\sin\theta - 2\cos\theta)} = \frac{5}{4}\), then the value of \(\frac{(\tan^2\theta + 5)}{(\tan^2\theta - 5)}\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{(7\sin\theta + 4\cos\theta)}{(9\sin\theta - 2\cos\theta)} = \frac{5}{4}\) है, तो \(\frac{(\tan^2\theta + 5)}{(\tan^2\theta - 5)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Divide numerator and denominator by \(\cos\theta\):
\(\frac{7\tan\theta + 4}{9\tan\theta - 2} = \frac{5}{4}\)
\(28\tan\theta + 16 = 45\tan\theta - 10\)
\(17\tan\theta = 26 \Rightarrow \tan\theta = \frac{26}{17}\)
\(\tan^2\theta = \frac{676}{289}\)
\(\frac{\tan^2\theta + 5}{\tan^2\theta - 5} = \frac{676 + 1445}{676 - 1445} = \frac{2121}{-769} = \boxed{-\frac{2121}{769}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(-\frac{2121}{769}\).
solution.hi:
अंश और हर दोनों को \(\cos\theta\) से भाग दीजिए:
\(\frac{7\tan\theta + 4}{9\tan\theta - 2} = \frac{5}{4}\)
\(28\tan\theta + 16 = 45\tan\theta - 10\)
\(17\tan\theta = 26 \Rightarrow \tan\theta = \frac{26}{17}\)
\(\tan^2\theta = \frac{676}{289}\)
\(\frac{\tan^2\theta + 5}{\tan^2\theta - 5} = \frac{676 + 1445}{676 - 1445} = \frac{2121}{-769} = \boxed{-\frac{2121}{769}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(-\frac{2121}{769}\) है।

question.en: In a triangle ABC, right-angled at B, if cot A = \(\frac{1}{2}\), find the value of \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\). [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: त्रिभुज ABC में, B पर समकोण है, यदि cot A = \(\frac{1}{2}\) है, तो \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\cot A = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \tan A = 2\), so \(\sin A = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\)
\(C = 90^\circ - A \Rightarrow \sin C = \cos A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos C = \sin A = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\)
Expression = \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)} = \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\right)}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} - \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\right)}\)
\(= \frac{3}{-1} = \boxed{-3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): -3.
solution.hi:
\(\cot A = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \tan A = 2\), अतः \(\sin A = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\)
\(C = 90^\circ - A \Rightarrow \sin C = \cos A = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}},\ \cos C = \sin A = \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\)
व्यंजक = \(\frac{\sin A(\cos C + \cos A)}{\cos C(\sin C - \sin A)} = \frac{\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\right)}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} - \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\right)}\)
\(= \frac{3}{-1} = \boxed{-3}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): -3 है।

question.en: Convert π radians to degrees. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: π रेडियन को डिग्री में बदलिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\pi\) radians = \(180^\circ\)
\(\pi \times \frac{180}{\pi} = \boxed{180^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 180º.
solution.hi:
\(\pi\) रेडियन = \(180^\circ\)
\(\pi \times \frac{180}{\pi} = \boxed{180^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 180º है।

question.en: If cosec θ + cot θ = \(\frac{5}{2}\), find the value of tan θ. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि cosec θ + cot θ = \(\frac{5}{2}\) है, तो tan θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\text{cosec}\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cot\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{5}{2}\)
So \(\tan\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{2}{5}\)
\(\tan\theta = \frac{2\tan\frac{\theta}{2}}{1 - \tan^2\frac{\theta}{2}} = \frac{\frac{4}{5}}{1 - \frac{4}{25}}\)
\(= \frac{\frac{4}{5}}{\frac{21}{25}} = \boxed{\frac{20}{21}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{20}{21}\).
solution.hi:
\(\text{cosec}\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \cot\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{5}{2}\)
अतः \(\tan\frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{2}{5}\)
\(\tan\theta = \frac{2\tan\frac{\theta}{2}}{1 - \tan^2\frac{\theta}{2}} = \frac{\frac{4}{5}}{1 - \frac{4}{25}}\)
\(= \frac{\frac{4}{5}}{\frac{21}{25}} = \boxed{\frac{20}{21}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{20}{21}\) है।

question.en: If cosA = \(\frac{1}{2}\) and sinB = \(\frac{1}{2}\), where A and B are acute angles, then find the value of A – B. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि cosA = \(\frac{1}{2}\) और sinB = \(\frac{1}{2}\) है, जहाँ A और B न्यून कोण हैं, तो A – B का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\cos A = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow A = 60^\circ\)
\(\sin B = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow B = 30^\circ\)
\(A - B = 60^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{30^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 30°.
solution.hi:
\(\cos A = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow A = 60^\circ\)
\(\sin B = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow B = 30^\circ\)
\(A - B = 60^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{30^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 30° है।

question.en: If tan A = cot B and cos A = sin(90º–2B) for acute angles, find A and B. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि न्यून कोणों के लिए tan A = cot B और cos A = sin(90º–2B) है, तो A और B ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan A = \cot B = \tan(90^\circ - B) \Rightarrow A + B = 90^\circ\)
\(\cos A = \sin(90^\circ - 2B) = \cos 2B \Rightarrow A = 2B\)
\(2B + B = 90^\circ \Rightarrow B = 30^\circ,\ A = 60^\circ\)
\(\boxed{A = 60^\circ,\ B = 30^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): A=60º, B=30º.

question.en: Convert 3π radians to degrees. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:

\(= 3 \times 180^\circ = \boxed{540^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 540°.

question.en: If tanθ + cotθ = 2, then what is the value of tan²θ + cot²θ? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि tanθ + cotθ = 2 है, तो tan²θ + cot²θ का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\tan^2\theta + \cot^2\theta = (\tan\theta + \cot\theta)^2 - 2\tan\theta\cot\theta\)
\(= 2^2 - 2(1)\)
\(= \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 2.

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 2 है।

question.en: If \(sec^2X + cosec^2X = 4\), what is the value of sinX cosX? (Assume X is an acute angle.) [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(sec^2X + cosec^2X = 4\) है, तो sinX cosX का मान क्या है? (मान लीजिए X न्यून कोण है।) [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{1}{\cos^2 X} + \frac{1}{\sin^2 X} = \frac{\sin^2 X + \cos^2 X}{\sin^2 X\cos^2 X} = 4\)
\(\sin^2 X\cos^2 X = \frac{1}{4}\)
\(\sin X\cos X = \frac{1}{2}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{1}{2}\).

question.en: If the radii of two circles are in the ratio 2:3 and arcs of equal length on them subtend angles \(\theta_1\) and \(\theta_2\) at their centers, find \(\frac{\theta_1}{\theta_2}\). [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

Arc length = \(r\theta\), and both arcs are equal

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{3}{2}\).

question.en: A machine rotates at 30π radians per second. Find the number of revolutions it makes in one minute. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Angle turned in 1 minute = \(30\pi \times 60 = 1800\pi\) radians

Revolutions = \(\frac{1800\pi}{2\pi} = \boxed{900}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 900.

question.en: If sinθ = \(\frac{8}{17}\) and θ is an acute angle, find the value of 6(cosecθ – cotθ). [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\cos\theta = \sqrt{1 - \frac{64}{289}} = \frac{15}{17}\)
\(\text{cosec}\theta = \frac{17}{8}\), \(\cot\theta = \frac{15}{8}\)
\(6\left(\frac{17}{8} - \frac{15}{8}\right) = 6 \times \frac{2}{8}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{3}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{3}{2}\).

question.en: If \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta\) for an acute angle θ, then what is the value of \(\cos\theta - \sin\theta\)? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि न्यून कोण θ के लिए \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta\) है, तो \(\cos\theta - \sin\theta\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta \Rightarrow \sin\theta = (\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos\theta\)
So \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2} - 1\), which gives \(\theta = 22.5^\circ\)
\(\cos\theta - \sin\theta = \cos\theta - (\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos\theta = (2 - \sqrt{2})\cos\theta\)
And \(\sqrt{2}\sin\theta = \sqrt{2}(\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos\theta = (2 - \sqrt{2})\cos\theta\)
\(= \boxed{\sqrt{2}\sin\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\sqrt{2}\sin\theta\).
solution.hi:
\(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta \Rightarrow \sin\theta = (\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos\theta\)
अतः \(\tan\theta = \sqrt{2} - 1\), जिससे \(\theta = 22.5^\circ\)
\(\cos\theta - \sin\theta = \cos\theta - (\sqrt{2} - 1)\cos\theta = (2 - \sqrt{2})\cos\theta\)
और \((2 - \sqrt{2})\cos\theta = \sqrt{2}\sin\theta\)
\(= \boxed{\sqrt{2}\sin\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\sqrt{2}\sin\theta\) है।

\(= \boxed{A^2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): A².

question.en: If A and B are acute angles such that tanA · tanB = 1, what is the value of A + B? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि A और B न्यून कोण हैं और tanA · tanB = 1 है, तो A + B का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

Both angles are acute, so \(A = 90^\circ - B\)
\(A + B = \boxed{90^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 90°.

question.en: A wheel rotates through \(4\frac{2}{3}\) revolutions. Express this total rotation in degrees. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

question.en: If cosec θ + cot θ = 3, find the value of sin θ. [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि cosec θ + cot θ = 3 है, तो sin θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\csc\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = 3\)
Also, \(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{1 + \cos\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\)
Adding: \(2\csc\theta = 3 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{10}{3} \Rightarrow \csc\theta = \frac{5}{3}\)
\(\sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{3}{5}\).
solution.hi:
\(\csc\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1 + \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = 3\)
साथ ही, \(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{1 + \cos\theta} = \frac{1}{3}\)
जोड़ने पर: \(2\csc\theta = 3 + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{10}{3} \Rightarrow \csc\theta = \frac{5}{3}\)
\(\sin\theta = \boxed{\frac{3}{5}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{3}{5}\) है।

question.en: If 5 cot θ = 12, find the value of \(\frac{5\cos\theta - \sin\theta}{5\cos\theta + \sin\theta}\). [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि 5 cot θ = 12 है, तो \(\frac{5\cos\theta - \sin\theta}{5\cos\theta + \sin\theta}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(5\cot\theta = 12 \Rightarrow \cot\theta = \frac{12}{5}\)
Divide numerator and denominator by \(\sin\theta\):
\(\frac{5\cot\theta - 1}{5\cot\theta + 1} = \frac{12 - 1}{12 + 1} = \boxed{\frac{11}{13}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{11}{13}\).
solution.hi:
\(5\cot\theta = 12 \Rightarrow \cot\theta = \frac{12}{5}\)
अंश और हर दोनों को \(\sin\theta\) से भाग दीजिए:
\(\frac{5\cot\theta - 1}{5\cot\theta + 1} = \frac{12 - 1}{12 + 1} = \boxed{\frac{11}{13}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{11}{13}\) है।

question.en: If \(\cos\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\), find the value of \(\sin^2\theta + \sin^4\theta\). [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\cos\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\) है, तो \(\sin^2\theta + \sin^4\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\cos\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta = \sin^2\theta\)
\(\sin^2\theta + \sin^4\theta = \cos\theta + \cos^2\theta\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 1.
solution.hi:
\(\cos\theta = 1 - \cos^2\theta = \sin^2\theta\)
\(\sin^2\theta + \sin^4\theta = \cos\theta + \cos^2\theta\)
\(= \boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 1 है।

question.en: If sinθ + cosecθ = 2, what is the value of \(\sin^n\theta + \csc^n\theta\) for any positive integer n? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि sinθ + cosecθ = 2 है, तो किसी भी धनात्मक पूर्णांक n के लिए \(\sin^n\theta + \csc^n\theta\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let \(\sin\theta = t > 0\). Then \(t + \frac{1}{t} = 2 \Rightarrow t^2 - 2t + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow (t - 1)^2 = 0\)
So \(\sin\theta = 1\) and \(\csc\theta = 1\)
\(\sin^n\theta + \csc^n\theta = 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 2.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए \(\sin\theta = t > 0\), तब \(t + \frac{1}{t} = 2 \Rightarrow t^2 - 2t + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow (t - 1)^2 = 0\)
अतः \(\sin\theta = 1\) और \(\csc\theta = 1\)
\(\sin^n\theta + \csc^n\theta = 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 2 है।

question.en: A mechanical arm in a robotic assembly line rotates through an angle of 3π/4 radians during a precise welding operation. What is the measure of this rotation angle in degrees? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: रोबोटिक असेंबली लाइन में एक यांत्रिक भुजा एक सटीक वेल्डिंग कार्य के दौरान 3π/4 रेडियन के कोण से घूमती है। इस घूर्णन कोण का माप डिग्री में क्या है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) radians \(= \frac{3\pi}{4} \times \frac{180^\circ}{\pi}\)
\(= 3 \times 45^\circ = \boxed{135^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 135°.
solution.hi:
\(\frac{3\pi}{4}\) रेडियन \(= \frac{3\pi}{4} \times \frac{180^\circ}{\pi}\)
\(= 3 \times 45^\circ = \boxed{135^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 135° है।

question.en: Simplify: \(\frac{\sin 75^\circ - \sin 15^\circ}{\cos 15^\circ - \cos 75^\circ}\) [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: सरल कीजिए: \(\frac{\sin 75^\circ - \sin 15^\circ}{\cos 15^\circ - \cos 75^\circ}\) [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\sin 75^\circ - \sin 15^\circ = 2\cos 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ\)
\(\cos 15^\circ - \cos 75^\circ = -2\sin 45^\circ \sin(-30^\circ) = 2\sin 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ\)
Since \(\cos 45^\circ = \sin 45^\circ\), the ratio is \(\frac{2\cos 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ}{2\sin 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ} = \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 1.
solution.hi:
\(\sin 75^\circ - \sin 15^\circ = 2\cos 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ\)
\(\cos 15^\circ - \cos 75^\circ = -2\sin 45^\circ \sin(-30^\circ) = 2\sin 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ\)
चूँकि \(\cos 45^\circ = \sin 45^\circ\), अनुपात = \(\frac{2\cos 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ}{2\sin 45^\circ \sin 30^\circ} = \boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 1 है।

question.en: If tanA + cotA = 2, then tan²A + cot²A = ? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि tanA + cotA = 2 है, तो tan²A + cot²A = ? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan^2A + \cot^2A = (\tan A + \cot A)^2 - 2\tan A\cot A\)
Since \(\tan A \cdot \cot A = 1\):
\(= 2^2 - 2 = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\tan^2A + \cot^2A = (\tan A + \cot A)^2 - 2\tan A\cot A\)
चूँकि \(\tan A \cdot \cot A = 1\):
\(= 2^2 - 2 = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 2 है।

question.en: What is the value of \(\sin^2 10^\circ + \sin^2 20^\circ + \sin^2 30^\circ + \cdots + \sin^2 80^\circ\)? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: \(\sin^2 10^\circ + \sin^2 20^\circ + \sin^2 30^\circ + \cdots + \sin^2 80^\circ\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Pair the terms as \((10^\circ, 80^\circ), (20^\circ, 70^\circ), (30^\circ, 60^\circ), (40^\circ, 50^\circ)\).
\(\sin^2\theta + \sin^2(90^\circ - \theta) = \sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\)
There are 4 such pairs, so the sum is \(4 \times 1 = \boxed{4}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 4.
solution.hi:
पदों को \((10^\circ, 80^\circ), (20^\circ, 70^\circ), (30^\circ, 60^\circ), (40^\circ, 50^\circ)\) के जोड़ों में बाँटिए।
\(\sin^2\theta + \sin^2(90^\circ - \theta) = \sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\)
ऐसे 4 जोड़े हैं, अतः योग \(4 \times 1 = \boxed{4}\) है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 4 है।

question.en: If tanθ = 1, find sec²θ. [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि tanθ = 1 है, तो sec²θ ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta\)
\(= 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\sec^2\theta = 1 + \tan^2\theta\)
\(= 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 2 है।

question.en: Convert 210° to radians [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: 210° को रेडियन में बदलिए [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(210^\circ = 210 \times \frac{\pi}{180}\)
\(= \frac{7\pi}{6}\)
So the answer is \(\boxed{\frac{7\pi}{6}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 7π/6.
solution.hi:
\(210^\circ = 210 \times \frac{\pi}{180}\)
\(= \frac{7\pi}{6}\)
अतः उत्तर है \(\boxed{\frac{7\pi}{6}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 7π/6 है।

question.en: If \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{7}{5}\), find the value of \(\sin\theta \cdot \cos\theta\). [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि \(\sin\theta + \cos\theta = \frac{7}{5}\) है, तो \(\sin\theta \cdot \cos\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Squaring: \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{49}{25}\)
\(1 + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{49}{25}\)
\(2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{24}{25} \Rightarrow \sin\theta\cos\theta = \boxed{\frac{12}{25}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{12}{25}\).
solution.hi:
वर्ग करने पर: \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{49}{25}\)
\(1 + 2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{49}{25}\)
\(2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{24}{25} \Rightarrow \sin\theta\cos\theta = \boxed{\frac{12}{25}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{12}{25}\) है।

question.en: What is the value of \(25\sec^2\theta - 25\tan^2\theta + 16\csc^2\theta - 16\cot^2\theta\) for an acute angle θ? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: न्यून कोण θ के लिए \(25\sec^2\theta - 25\tan^2\theta + 16\csc^2\theta - 16\cot^2\theta\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Group the terms: \(25(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta) + 16(\csc^2\theta - \cot^2\theta)\)
Using the identities, each bracket equals 1:
\(= 25 + 16 = \boxed{41}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 41.
solution.hi:
पदों को समूहित कीजिए: \(25(\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta) + 16(\csc^2\theta - \cot^2\theta)\)
सर्वसमिकाओं का उपयोग करने पर प्रत्येक कोष्ठक 1 के बराबर है:
\(= 25 + 16 = \boxed{41}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 41 है।

question.en: How many solutions does the equation sinθ = 1/2 have for 0° ≤ θ ≤ 90°? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: समीकरण sinθ = 1/2 के 0° ≤ θ ≤ 90° के लिए कितने हल हैं? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
In the interval \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 90^\circ\), \(\sin\theta\) increases steadily from 0 to 1.
So \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) occurs exactly once, at \(\theta = 30^\circ\).
Number of solutions = \(\boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 1.
solution.hi:
अंतराल \(0^\circ \le \theta \le 90^\circ\) में \(\sin\theta\) 0 से 1 तक लगातार बढ़ता है।
अतः \(\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\) ठीक एक बार होता है, \(\theta = 30^\circ\) पर।
हलों की संख्या = \(\boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 1 है।

question.en: Evaluate: \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos(90^\circ-\theta)} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin(90^\circ-\theta)}\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: मूल्यांकन कीजिए: \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos(90^\circ-\theta)} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin(90^\circ-\theta)}\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\cos(90^\circ - \theta) = \sin\theta\) and \(\sin(90^\circ - \theta) = \cos\theta\)
Expression = \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\sin\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\cos(90^\circ - \theta) = \sin\theta\) और \(\sin(90^\circ - \theta) = \cos\theta\)
व्यंजक = \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\sin\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= 1 + 1 = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 2 है।

question.en: If \(\tan\theta_1 \cdot \tan\theta_2 = 2\), then find the value of \(\frac{\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}{\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2)}\). [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\tan\theta_1 \cdot \tan\theta_2 = 2\) है, तो \(\frac{\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}{\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2)}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2\):
\(\frac{\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}{\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2)} = \frac{1 + \tan\theta_1\tan\theta_2}{1 - \tan\theta_1\tan\theta_2}\)
\(= \frac{1 + 2}{1 - 2} = \boxed{-3}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): -3.
solution.hi:
अंश और हर दोनों को \(\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2\) से भाग देने पर:
\(\frac{\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}{\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2)} = \frac{1 + \tan\theta_1\tan\theta_2}{1 - \tan\theta_1\tan\theta_2}\)
\(= \frac{1 + 2}{1 - 2} = \boxed{-3}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): -3 है।

question.en: The angles of a pentagon are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 : 5. What is the second largest angle in radians? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक पंचभुज के कोण 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं। रेडियन में दूसरा सबसे बड़ा कोण क्या है? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Sum of the interior angles of a pentagon = \((5 - 2) \times 180^\circ = 540^\circ\)
\(x + 2x + 3x + 4x + 5x = 15x = 540^\circ \Rightarrow x = 36^\circ\)
Second largest angle = \(4x = 144^\circ\)
In radians: \(144 \times \frac{\pi}{180} = \boxed{\frac{4\pi}{5}}\) radians

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{4\pi}{5}\) radians.
solution.hi:
पंचभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग = \((5 - 2) \times 180^\circ = 540^\circ\)
\(x + 2x + 3x + 4x + 5x = 15x = 540^\circ \Rightarrow x = 36^\circ\)
दूसरा सबसे बड़ा कोण = \(4x = 144^\circ\)
रेडियन में: \(144 \times \frac{\pi}{180} = \boxed{\frac{4\pi}{5}}\) रेडियन

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{4\pi}{5}\) रेडियन है।

question.en: In a right triangle ABC with ∠B = 90°, simplify: \(\frac{\sin A+\cos C}{\sin C+\cos A}\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: ∠B = 90° वाले समकोण त्रिभुज ABC में सरल कीजिए: \(\frac{\sin A+\cos C}{\sin C+\cos A}\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(A + C = 90^\circ\), so \(\cos C = \sin A\) and \(\sin C = \cos A\)
Expression = \(\frac{\sin A + \sin A}{\cos A + \cos A} = \frac{2\sin A}{2\cos A}\)
\(= \boxed{\tan A}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): tan A.
solution.hi:
\(A + C = 90^\circ\), अतः \(\cos C = \sin A\) और \(\sin C = \cos A\)
व्यंजक = \(\frac{\sin A + \sin A}{\cos A + \cos A} = \frac{2\sin A}{2\cos A}\)
\(= \boxed{\tan A}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): tan A है।

question.en: Simplify: \(\frac{\tan A+\cot A}{\sec A \cdot \csc A}\). [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सरल कीजिए: \(\frac{\tan A+\cot A}{\sec A \cdot \csc A}\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2A + \cos^2A}{\sin A\cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A\cos A}\)
\(\sec A \cdot \csc A = \frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{\sin A\cos A}\)
Expression \(= \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 1.
solution.hi:
\(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2A + \cos^2A}{\sin A\cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A\cos A}\)
\(\sec A \cdot \csc A = \frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{\sin A\cos A}\)
व्यंजक \(= \boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 1 है।

question.en: If \(k \cdot \tan 45^\circ \cdot \sin 60^\circ \cdot \cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sec^2 45^\circ \cdot \cot 30^\circ}{\csc 60^\circ \cdot \tan 60^\circ}\), then find the value of k. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(k \cdot \tan 45^\circ \cdot \sin 60^\circ \cdot \cos 30^\circ = \frac{\sec^2 45^\circ \cdot \cot 30^\circ}{\csc 60^\circ \cdot \tan 60^\circ}\) है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
LHS = \(k \times 1 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{3k}{4}\)
RHS = \(\frac{2 \times \sqrt{3}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \sqrt{3}} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{2} = \sqrt{3}\)
\(\frac{3k}{4} = \sqrt{3} \Rightarrow k = \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{3} = \boxed{\frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}\).
solution.hi:
बायाँ पक्ष = \(k \times 1 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{3k}{4}\)
दायाँ पक्ष = \(\frac{2 \times \sqrt{3}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \sqrt{3}} = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{2} = \sqrt{3}\)
\(\frac{3k}{4} = \sqrt{3} \Rightarrow k = \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{3} = \boxed{\frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}\) है।

question.en: Find the value of \(\left(\frac{\cos\theta}{1+\sin\theta} + \frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\right)\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta+\cot\theta}\right)\). [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: \(\left(\frac{\cos\theta}{1+\sin\theta} + \frac{1+\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\right)\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta+\cot\theta}\right)\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
First bracket \(= \frac{\cos^2\theta + (1 + \sin\theta)^2}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{\cos^2\theta + 1 + 2\sin\theta + \sin^2\theta}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{2(1 + \sin\theta)}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{2}{\cos\theta}\)
Also \(\tan\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}\), so the second bracket is \(\sin\theta\cos\theta\)
Expression \(= \frac{2}{\cos\theta} \times \sin\theta\cos\theta = \boxed{2\sin\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(2\sin\theta\).
solution.hi:
पहला कोष्ठक \(= \frac{\cos^2\theta + (1 + \sin\theta)^2}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{\cos^2\theta + 1 + 2\sin\theta + \sin^2\theta}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{2(1 + \sin\theta)}{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{2}{\cos\theta}\)
साथ ही \(\tan\theta + \cot\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}\), अतः दूसरा कोष्ठक \(\sin\theta\cos\theta\) है
व्यंजक \(= \frac{2}{\cos\theta} \times \sin\theta\cos\theta = \boxed{2\sin\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(2\sin\theta\) है।

question.en: Simplify: \(\sin\theta \cdot \sec(90^\circ-\theta) - \cos\theta \cdot \csc(90^\circ-\theta) + \tan\theta \cdot \cot(90^\circ-\theta)\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सरल कीजिए: \(\sin\theta \cdot \sec(90^\circ-\theta) - \cos\theta \cdot \csc(90^\circ-\theta) + \tan\theta \cdot \cot(90^\circ-\theta)\) [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sec(90^\circ - \theta) = \csc\theta\), \(\csc(90^\circ - \theta) = \sec\theta\), \(\cot(90^\circ - \theta) = \tan\theta\)
Expression = \(\sin\theta\csc\theta - \cos\theta\sec\theta + \tan\theta\tan\theta\)
\(= 1 - 1 + \tan^2\theta = \boxed{\tan^2\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\tan^2\theta\).
solution.hi:
\(\sec(90^\circ - \theta) = \csc\theta\), \(\csc(90^\circ - \theta) = \sec\theta\), \(\cot(90^\circ - \theta) = \tan\theta\)
व्यंजक = \(\sin\theta\csc\theta - \cos\theta\sec\theta + \tan\theta\tan\theta\)
\(= 1 - 1 + \tan^2\theta = \boxed{\tan^2\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\tan^2\theta\) है।

question.en: If cosec A + cot A = 7, find the value of tan A. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि cosec A + cot A = 7 है, तो tan A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\csc A + \cot A = \frac{1 + \cos A}{\sin A} = \cot\frac{A}{2} = 7\)
So \(\tan\frac{A}{2} = \frac{1}{7}\)
\(\tan A = \frac{2\tan(A/2)}{1 - \tan^2(A/2)} = \frac{2/7}{1 - 1/49} = \frac{2/7}{48/49}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{7}{24}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{7}{24}\).
solution.hi:
\(\csc A + \cot A = \frac{1 + \cos A}{\sin A} = \cot\frac{A}{2} = 7\)
अतः \(\tan\frac{A}{2} = \frac{1}{7}\)
\(\tan A = \frac{2\tan(A/2)}{1 - \tan^2(A/2)} = \frac{2/7}{1 - 1/49} = \frac{2/7}{48/49}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{7}{24}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{7}{24}\) है।

question.en: A clock shows 4:20. What is the angle in radians between the hour hand and the minute hand? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक घड़ी में 4:20 बजे हैं। घंटे की सुई और मिनट की सुई के बीच रेडियन में कोण क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Minute hand: \(20 \times 6^\circ = 120^\circ\)
Hour hand: \(4 \times 30^\circ + 20 \times 0.5^\circ = 130^\circ\)
Difference \(= 10^\circ = 10 \times \frac{\pi}{180}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{\pi}{18}}\) radians

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(\frac{\pi}{18}\) radians.
solution.hi:
मिनट की सुई: \(20 \times 6^\circ = 120^\circ\)
घंटे की सुई: \(4 \times 30^\circ + 20 \times 0.5^\circ = 130^\circ\)
अंतर \(= 10^\circ = 10 \times \frac{\pi}{180}\)
\(= \boxed{\frac{\pi}{18}}\) रेडियन

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(\frac{\pi}{18}\) रेडियन है।

question.en: In a right triangle ABC with ∠B = 90°, sin A = ? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: समकोण त्रिभुज ABC में, जहाँ ∠B = 90° है, sin A = ? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\sin A = \frac{BC}{AC}\) and \(\cos C = \frac{BC}{AC}\)
Hence \(\sin A = \boxed{\cos C}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): cos C.
solution.hi:
\(\sin A = \frac{BC}{AC}\) और \(\cos C = \frac{BC}{AC}\)
अतः \(\sin A = \boxed{\cos C}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): cos C है।

question.en: A fan rotates at 120π radians per second. Find the number of revolutions in one minute. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक पंखा 120π रेडियन प्रति सेकंड की गति से घूमता है। एक मिनट में चक्करों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Revolutions per second \(= \frac{120\pi}{2\pi} = 60\)
Revolutions per minute \(= 60 \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{3600}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 3600.
solution.hi:
प्रति सेकंड चक्कर \(= \frac{120\pi}{2\pi} = 60\)
प्रति मिनट चक्कर \(= 60 \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{3600}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 3600 है।

question.en: If secθ = 13/12 and θ is an acute angle, find the value of cosecθ − cotθ. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि secθ = 13/12 है और θ एक न्यून कोण है, तो cosecθ − cotθ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{12}{13}\), so \(\sin\theta = \sqrt{1 - \frac{144}{169}} = \frac{5}{13}\)
\(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{13}{5} - \frac{12}{5} = \frac{1}{5}\)
Hence \(\boxed{\frac{1}{5}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): \(\frac{1}{5}\).
solution.hi:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{12}{13}\), अतः \(\sin\theta = \sqrt{1 - \frac{144}{169}} = \frac{5}{13}\)
\(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{13}{5} - \frac{12}{5} = \frac{1}{5}\)
इसलिए \(\boxed{\frac{1}{5}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): \(\frac{1}{5}\) है।

question.en: If tanA = 2tanB and both A and B are acute angles, what is the value of \(\frac{\tan A}{\tan B}\)? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि tanA = 2tanB है और A तथा B दोनों न्यून कोण हैं, तो \(\frac{\tan A}{\tan B}\) का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\tan A = 2\tan B\)
Dividing both sides by \(\tan B\) (non-zero as B is acute):
\(\frac{\tan A}{\tan B} = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\tan A = 2\tan B\)
दोनों पक्षों को \(\tan B\) से भाग देने पर (B न्यून है, अतः शून्य नहीं):
\(\frac{\tan A}{\tan B} = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 2 है।

question.en: Evaluate: tan 3° · tan 15° · tan 27° · tan 39° · tan 45° · tan 51° · tan 63° · tan 75° · tan 87° [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: tan 3° · tan 15° · tan 27° · tan 39° · tan 45° · tan 51° · tan 63° · tan 75° · tan 87° [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Pair the terms: \(\tan 3^\circ\tan 87^\circ = \tan 3^\circ\cot 3^\circ = 1\)
Similarly \(\tan 15^\circ\tan 75^\circ = 1\), \(\tan 27^\circ\tan 63^\circ = 1\), \(\tan 39^\circ\tan 51^\circ = 1\), and \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\)
Product \(= 1 \times 1 \times 1 \times 1 \times 1 = \boxed{1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 1.
solution.hi:
पदों को जोड़े में लिखिए: \(\tan 3^\circ\tan 87^\circ = \tan 3^\circ\cot 3^\circ = 1\)
इसी प्रकार \(\tan 15^\circ\tan 75^\circ = 1\), \(\tan 27^\circ\tan 63^\circ = 1\), \(\tan 39^\circ\tan 51^\circ = 1\), और \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\)
गुणनफल \(= 1 \times 1 \times 1 \times 1 \times 1 = \boxed{1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 1 है।

question.en: Simplify: \(\frac{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\) [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सरल कीजिए: \(\frac{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\) [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\sin\theta + \cos\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= \tan\theta + 1\)
Hence \(\boxed{\tan\theta + 1}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): tanθ + 1.
solution.hi:
\(\frac{\sin\theta + \cos\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{\cos\theta}\)
\(= \tan\theta + 1\)
इसलिए \(\boxed{\tan\theta + 1}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): tanθ + 1 है।

question.en: If \(\frac{\cos\theta}{1-\sin\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{1+\sin\theta} = 4\), then what is the value of θ (in degrees) where 0° < θ < 90°? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(\frac{\cos\theta}{1-\sin\theta} + \frac{\cos\theta}{1+\sin\theta} = 4\) है, तो θ का मान (डिग्री में) क्या है, जहाँ 0° < θ < 90° है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\frac{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta) + \cos\theta(1 - \sin\theta)}{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \frac{2\cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta} = \frac{2}{\cos\theta}\)
\(\frac{2}{\cos\theta} = 4 \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
\(\theta = \boxed{60^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 60°.
solution.hi:
\(\frac{\cos\theta(1 + \sin\theta) + \cos\theta(1 - \sin\theta)}{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \frac{2\cos\theta}{\cos^2\theta} = \frac{2}{\cos\theta}\)
\(\frac{2}{\cos\theta} = 4 \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
\(\theta = \boxed{60^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 60° है।

question.en: If cotθ = 1, what is cosec²θ? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि cotθ = 1 है, तो cosec²θ क्या है? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\csc^2\theta = 1 + \cot^2\theta\)
\(= 1 + 1\)
\(= \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\csc^2\theta = 1 + \cot^2\theta\)
\(= 1 + 1\)
\(= \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 2 है।

question.en: A wheel rotates at 50π radians per second. How many revolutions does it make in one minute? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक पहिया 50π रेडियन प्रति सेकंड की दर से घूमता है। यह एक मिनट में कितने चक्कर लगाएगा? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Revolutions per second \(= \frac{50\pi}{2\pi} = 25\)
Revolutions per minute \(= 25 \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{1500}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 1500.
solution.hi:
प्रति सेकंड चक्कर \(= \frac{50\pi}{2\pi} = 25\)
प्रति मिनट चक्कर \(= 25 \times 60\)
\(= \boxed{1500}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 1500 है।

question.en: If secθ = 17/15 and θ is an acute angle, find 2(cosecθ − cotθ). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि secθ = 17/15 है और θ एक न्यून कोण है, तो 2(cosecθ − cotθ) ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{15}{17}\), so \(\sin\theta = \frac{8}{17}\)
\(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{17}{8} - \frac{15}{8} = \frac{2}{8} = \frac{1}{4}\)
\(2(\csc\theta - \cot\theta) = \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{1}{2}\).
solution.hi:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{15}{17}\), अतः \(\sin\theta = \frac{8}{17}\)
\(\csc\theta - \cot\theta = \frac{17}{8} - \frac{15}{8} = \frac{2}{8} = \frac{1}{4}\)
\(2(\csc\theta - \cot\theta) = \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): \(\frac{1}{2}\) है।

question.en: If 2sinθ − 1 = 0, what is the value of the acute angle θ? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: यदि 2sinθ − 1 = 0 है, तो न्यून कोण θ का मान क्या है? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(2\sin\theta = 1 \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
For an acute angle, \(\theta = \boxed{30^\circ}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): 30°.
solution.hi:
\(2\sin\theta = 1 \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}\)
न्यून कोण के लिए, \(\theta = \boxed{30^\circ}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): 30° है।

question.en: Evaluate: tan 30° tan 60° − sec 30° cosec 60° + sin² 30° + sin² 60° [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: tan 30° tan 60° − sec 30° cosec 60° + sin² 30° + sin² 60° [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan 30^\circ\tan 60^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \times \sqrt{3} = 1\)
\(\sec 30^\circ\csc 60^\circ = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4}{3}\)
\(\sin^2 30^\circ + \sin^2 60^\circ = \frac{1}{4} + \frac{3}{4} = 1\)
Expression \(= 1 - \frac{4}{3} + 1 = \boxed{\frac{2}{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(\frac{2}{3}\).
solution.hi:
\(\tan 30^\circ\tan 60^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \times \sqrt{3} = 1\)
\(\sec 30^\circ\csc 60^\circ = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4}{3}\)
\(\sin^2 30^\circ + \sin^2 60^\circ = \frac{1}{4} + \frac{3}{4} = 1\)
व्यंजक \(= 1 - \frac{4}{3} + 1 = \boxed{\frac{2}{3}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): \(\frac{2}{3}\) है।

question.en: If \(A + B = C\), find the value of \(\tan A \tan B \tan C + \tan A + \tan B\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(A + B = C\) है, तो \(\tan A \tan B \tan C + \tan A + \tan B\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Since \(A + B = C\), \(\tan(A + B) = \tan C\)
\(\frac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A\tan B} = \tan C\)
\(\tan A + \tan B = \tan C - \tan A\tan B\tan C\)
So \(\tan A\tan B\tan C + \tan A + \tan B = \boxed{\tan C}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): tan C.
solution.hi:
चूँकि \(A + B = C\), अतः \(\tan(A + B) = \tan C\)
\(\frac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A\tan B} = \tan C\)
\(\tan A + \tan B = \tan C - \tan A\tan B\tan C\)
अतः \(\tan A\tan B\tan C + \tan A + \tan B = \boxed{\tan C}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): tan C है।

question.en: If \(\tan A + \cot B = 2\) and \(A + B = 90°\), find A. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: यदि \(\tan A + \cot B = 2\) और \(A + B = 90°\) है, तो A ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Since \(A + B = 90°\), \(\cot B = \tan A\)
\(2\tan A = 2 \Rightarrow \tan A = 1\)
\(A = \boxed{45°}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 45°.
solution.hi:
चूँकि \(A + B = 90°\), अतः \(\cot B = \tan A\)
\(2\tan A = 2 \Rightarrow \tan A = 1\)
\(A = \boxed{45°}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 45° है।

question.en: Simplify: \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}}\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: सरलीकृत कीजिए: \(\sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}}\) [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}}\)
\(= \frac{1 + \sin A}{\cos A} = \sec A + \tan A\)
\(= \boxed{\sec A + \tan A}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): sec A + tan A.
solution.hi:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1 + \sin A}{1 - \sin A}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin A)^2}{1 - \sin^2 A}}\)
\(= \frac{1 + \sin A}{\cos A} = \sec A + \tan A\)
\(= \boxed{\sec A + \tan A}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): sec A + tan A है।

question.en: If \(0° < \theta < 90°\), find the value of \(\sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}} + \cot\theta\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(0° < \theta < 90°\) है, तो \(\sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}} + \cot\theta\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}} = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \text{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta\)
Adding \(\cot\theta\): \(\text{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta + \cot\theta\)
\(= \boxed{\text{cosec}\theta}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): cosecθ.
solution.hi:
\(\sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\theta}{1 + \cos\theta}} = \frac{1 - \cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \text{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta\)
\(\cot\theta\) जोड़ने पर: \(\text{cosec}\theta - \cot\theta + \cot\theta\)
\(= \boxed{\text{cosec}\theta}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): cosecθ है।

question.en: If \(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y}\), then find the value of \(\frac{x\cos\theta - y\sin\theta}{x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta} - \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + y^2} + 2\). [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: यदि \(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y}\) है, तो \(\frac{x\cos\theta - y\sin\theta}{x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta} - \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + y^2} + 2\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}},\ \sin\theta = \frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}\)
Numerator \(= \frac{x^2 - y^2}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\), denominator \(= \frac{x^2 + y^2}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\), so the first term \(= \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + y^2}\)
The two terms cancel and the value \(= 0 + 2 = \boxed{2}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 2.
solution.hi:
\(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y} \Rightarrow \cos\theta = \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}},\ \sin\theta = \frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}}\)
अंश \(= \frac{x^2 - y^2}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\), हर \(= \frac{x^2 + y^2}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}\), अतः पहला पद \(= \frac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2 + y^2}\)
दोनों पद कट जाते हैं और मान \(= 0 + 2 = \boxed{2}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): 2 है।

question.en: Solve for acute θ: sin(θ + 30°) = cos(θ - 18°) [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: न्यून कोण θ के लिए हल कीजिए: sin(θ + 30°) = cos(θ - 18°) [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\sin(\theta + 30°) = \cos(90° - \theta - 30°) = \cos(60° - \theta)\)
\(\cos(60° - \theta) = \cos(\theta - 18°) \Rightarrow 60° - \theta = \theta - 18°\)
\(2\theta = 78° \Rightarrow \theta = \boxed{39°}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): 39°.
solution.hi:
\(\sin(\theta + 30°) = \cos(90° - \theta - 30°) = \cos(60° - \theta)\)
\(\cos(60° - \theta) = \cos(\theta - 18°) \Rightarrow 60° - \theta = \theta - 18°\)
\(2\theta = 78° \Rightarrow \theta = \boxed{39°}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): 39° है।

question.en: From a point on the ground, the angle of elevation of the top of a tower is 30°. After walking 40 m towards the tower, the angle of elevation becomes 60°. Find the height of the tower. [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: भूमि पर स्थित एक बिंदु से एक मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° है। मीनार की ओर 40 m चलने पर उन्नयन कोण 60° हो जाता है। मीनार की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Let the height be \(h\) and the nearer distance be \(x\)
\(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow h = x\sqrt{3}\); \(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{x + 40}\)
\(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{x\sqrt{3}}{x + 40} \Rightarrow x + 40 = 3x \Rightarrow x = 20\)
\(h = 20\sqrt{3}\) m \(= \boxed{20\sqrt{3}\ \text{m}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): \(20\sqrt{3}\) m.
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए ऊँचाई \(h\) और निकट की दूरी \(x\) है
\(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow h = x\sqrt{3}\); \(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{x + 40}\)
\(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{x\sqrt{3}}{x + 40} \Rightarrow x + 40 = 3x \Rightarrow x = 20\)
\(h = 20\sqrt{3}\) m \(= \boxed{20\sqrt{3}\ \text{m}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): \(20\sqrt{3}\) m है।

question.en: Two ships are sailing on the same side of a lighthouse. The angles of elevation of the top of the lighthouse from them are 30° and 45°. The lighthouse is 60 m high. Find the approximate distance between the ships. (Take √3 = 1.732) [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: दो जहाज़ एक ही दिशा में लाइटहाउस के एक ओर जा रहे हैं। उनसे लाइटहाउस के शिखर के उन्नयन कोण 30° और 45° हैं। लाइटहाउस 60 m ऊँचा है। जहाज़ों के बीच की अनुमानित दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (√3 = 1.732 लीजिए) [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Distance of the nearer ship \(= \frac{60}{\tan 45°} = 60\) m
Distance of the farther ship \(= \frac{60}{\tan 30°} = 60\sqrt{3} = 103.92\) m
Distance between them \(= 103.92 - 60 = 43.92 \approx \boxed{44\ \text{m}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 44 m.
solution.hi:
निकट के जहाज़ की दूरी \(= \frac{60}{\tan 45°} = 60\) m
दूर के जहाज़ की दूरी \(= \frac{60}{\tan 30°} = 60\sqrt{3} = 103.92\) m
उनके बीच की दूरी \(= 103.92 - 60 = 43.92 \approx \boxed{44\ \text{m}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): 44 m है।

question.en: A man observes the top of a tower at an angle of elevation of 60°. After moving 10 meters away from the tower in a straight line, the angle of elevation to the top of the tower reduces to 30°. What is the height of the tower? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 60° देखता है। मीनार से 10 मीटर सीधी दूरी पर दूर जाने पर मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण घटकर 30° हो जाता है। मीनार की ऊँचाई क्या है? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Let the height be \(h\) and the nearer distance be \(x\)
\(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow h = x\sqrt{3}\) and \(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{x + 10}\)
\(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{x\sqrt{3}}{x + 10} \Rightarrow x + 10 = 3x \Rightarrow x = 5\)
\(h = 5\sqrt{3}\) m \(= \boxed{5\sqrt{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): \(5\sqrt{3}\).
solution.hi:
मान लीजिए ऊँचाई \(h\) और निकट की दूरी \(x\) है
\(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow h = x\sqrt{3}\) तथा \(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{x + 10}\)
\(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{x\sqrt{3}}{x + 10} \Rightarrow x + 10 = 3x \Rightarrow x = 5\)
\(h = 5\sqrt{3}\) m \(= \boxed{5\sqrt{3}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): \(5\sqrt{3}\) है।

question.en: A man observes the top of a tower at an angle of 30°. After walking 10 m towards it, the angle becomes 60°. Find the approximate height of the tower. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° देखता है। उसकी ओर 10 m चलने पर कोण 60° हो जाता है। मीनार की अनुमानित ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
\(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow h = x\sqrt{3}\); \(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{x + 10}\)
\(x + 10 = 3x \Rightarrow x = 5\)
\(h = 5\sqrt{3} = 8.66 \approx \boxed{8.7\ \text{m}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 8.7 m.

question.en: The angle of elevation of the top of a tower from two points at distances a and b from the base of the tower and in the same straight line with it are 30° and 60° respectively. If the height of the tower is h, find h in terms of b. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: मीनार के आधार से a और b दूरी पर तथा उसी सीधी रेखा में स्थित दो बिंदुओं से मीनार के शिखर के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 30° और 60° हैं। यदि मीनार की ऊँचाई h है, तो h को b के पदों में ज्ञात कीजिए। [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
From the nearer point (distance b): \(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{b}\)
\(h = b\tan 60° = b\sqrt{3}\)
\(= \boxed{h = b\sqrt{3}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): \(h = b\sqrt{3}\).
solution.hi:
निकट बिंदु (दूरी b) से: \(\tan 60° = \frac{h}{b}\)
\(h = b\tan 60° = b\sqrt{3}\)
\(= \boxed{h = b\sqrt{3}}\)

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): \(h = b\sqrt{3}\) है।

question.en: A man observes the top of a tower at an angle of elevation of 30°. If the distance between the man and the tower is 100 meters, find the height of the tower [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi: एक व्यक्ति एक मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° देखता है। यदि व्यक्ति और मीनार के बीच की दूरी 100 मीटर है, तो मीनार की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
\(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{100}\)
\(h = 100 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{100\sqrt{3}}{3} = 57.7\) m
\(= \boxed{57.7\ \text{m}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): 57.7 m.
solution.hi:

question.en: The length of the shadow of a tower is 9 m when the sun's altitude is 30°. What is the height of the tower? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi: जब सूर्य की ऊँचाई 30° है तब एक मीनार की छाया की लंबाई 9 m है। मीनार की ऊँचाई क्या है? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
\(\tan 30° = \frac{h}{9}\)
\(h = 9 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = 3\sqrt{3}\)
\(= \boxed{3\sqrt{3}\ \text{m}}\)

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): 3√3 m.
solution.hi:
