question.en:
Read the eligibility criteria given for the post carefully and answer the question that follows.
Eligibility Criteria for Field Inspector:
1. Graduate in Science stream.
2. Minimum 3 years of work experience in field research.
3. Age: Not exceeding 35 years.
Case: Amit is 32 years old, has a bachelor's degree in physics, and has 4 years of experience in field research. What should be done in Amit's case? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
पद के लिए दी गई पात्रता शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़िए और आगे दिए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
क्षेत्र निरीक्षक के लिए पात्रता शर्तें:
1. विज्ञान संवर्ग में स्नातक।
2. क्षेत्र अनुसंधान में न्यूनतम 3 वर्ष का कार्य अनुभव।
3. आयु: 35 वर्ष से अधिक नहीं।
मामला: अमित 32 वर्ष का है, उसके पास भौतिक विज्ञान में स्नातक की डिग्री है और क्षेत्र अनुसंधान में 4 वर्ष का अनुभव है। अमित के मामले में क्या किया जाना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Physics is a science subject, so the graduation condition is satisfied
Experience of 4 years is more than the required 3 years and the age 32 is below 35
All three conditions are met, so Amit is eligible

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Eligible.
solution.hi:
भौतिक विज्ञान विज्ञान विषय है, अतः स्नातक की शर्त पूरी होती है
4 वर्ष का अनुभव आवश्यक 3 वर्ष से अधिक है और आयु 32 वर्ष, 35 से कम है
तीनों शर्तें पूरी हैं, अतः अमित पात्र है

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): पात्र है।

question.en:
Read the given conditions carefully and determine the appropriate outcome for the case provided.
Criteria for Admission to Executive MBA:
1. The candidate must have a bachelor's degree with at least fifty percent marks.
2. The candidate must have at least five years of managerial experience.
3. The candidate must provide two letters of recommendation from current employers.
Exception: If the candidate has ten years of experience, only one recommendation letter is required.
Case: Sunita has a bachelor's degree with 55% marks and 12 years of managerial experience. She has submitted one recommendation letter. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
दी गई शर्तों को ध्यान से पढ़िए और दिए गए मामले के लिए उपयुक्त परिणाम निर्धारित कीजिए।
कार्यकारी एमबीए में प्रवेश के मानदंड:
1. अभ्यर्थी के पास कम से कम पचास प्रतिशत अंकों के साथ स्नातक डिग्री होनी चाहिए।
2. अभ्यर्थी के पास कम से कम पाँच वर्ष का प्रबंधकीय अनुभव होना चाहिए।
3. अभ्यर्थी को वर्तमान नियोक्ताओं से दो अनुशंसा पत्र प्रदान करने होंगे।
अपवाद: यदि अभ्यर्थी के पास दस वर्ष का अनुभव है, तो केवल एक अनुशंसा पत्र आवश्यक है।
मामला: सुनीता के पास 55% अंकों के साथ स्नातक डिग्री और 12 वर्ष का प्रबंधकीय अनुभव है। उसने एक अनुशंसा पत्र जमा किया है। [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
The degree has 55% marks, which is above fifty percent ✔, and the experience of 12 years is more than five years ✔
Her experience is also above ten years, so under the exception only one recommendation letter is needed ✔
All conditions are satisfied, so she should be admitted

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Admitted.
solution.hi:
डिग्री में 55% अंक हैं, जो पचास प्रतिशत से अधिक हैं ✔, तथा 12 वर्ष का अनुभव पाँच वर्ष से अधिक है ✔
उसका अनुभव दस वर्ष से भी अधिक है, अतः अपवाद के अनुसार केवल एक अनुशंसा पत्र पर्याप्त है ✔
सभी शर्तें पूरी हैं, अतः उसे प्रवेश दिया जाए

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): प्रवेश दिया जाए है।

question.en:
Read the given situation carefully and consider all the relevant facts, conditions and constraints. Choose the option that represents the most appropriate, practical and logical decision based solely on the information provided.

A commercial airline screens applicants for the role of First Officer under these rules: The candidate must hold a valid commercial pilot license (CPL), must have logged a minimum of 200 flying hours and must pass a strict medical fitness evaluation. Akash holds a valid CPL and passed his medical fitness evaluation, but has logged only 185 flying hours.

What decision should the airline’s recruitment board take? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
दी गई स्थिति को ध्यान से पढ़ें और सभी प्रासंगिक तथ्यों, शर्तों तथा बाधाओं पर विचार करें। केवल दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर सबसे उपयुक्त, व्यावहारिक और तार्किक निर्णय दर्शाने वाला विकल्प चुनिए।

एक वाणिज्यिक एयरलाइन फ़र्स्ट ऑफ़िसर के पद के लिए इन नियमों के अंतर्गत आवेदकों की जाँच करती है: अभ्यर्थी के पास वैध वाणिज्यिक पायलट लाइसेंस (CPL) होना चाहिए, कम से कम 200 उड़ान घंटे दर्ज होने चाहिए और कठोर चिकित्सीय फिटनेस मूल्यांकन उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए। आकाश के पास वैध CPL है और उसने चिकित्सीय फिटनेस मूल्यांकन उत्तीर्ण किया है, परंतु उसके केवल 185 उड़ान घंटे दर्ज हैं।

एयरलाइन के भर्ती बोर्ड को क्या निर्णय लेना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

1.en: The candidate should be rejected for the position.
1.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए अस्वीकार कर दिया जाना चाहिए।

2.en: The candidate should be selected for the position.
2.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए चुन लिया जाना चाहिए।

3.en: The application should be referred to the Chief Pilot.
3.hi: आवेदन मुख्य पायलट को भेजा जाना चाहिए।

4.en: The data provided is inadequate to take a decision.
4.hi: निर्णय लेने के लिए दी गई जानकारी अपर्याप्त है।

solution.en:
Condition: minimum 200 flying hours.
Akash has 185 hours, so one mandatory condition is not met.
All conditions must be satisfied, therefore the application is to be rejected.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): The candidate should be rejected for the position.
solution.hi:
शर्त: कम से कम 200 उड़ान घंटे।
आकाश के पास 185 घंटे हैं, इसलिए एक अनिवार्य शर्त पूरी नहीं होती।
सभी शर्तें पूरी होना आवश्यक हैं, अतः आवेदन अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए अस्वीकार कर दिया जाना चाहिए। है।

question.en:
Read the given conditions carefully and determine the appropriate outcome for the case provided. If any exception applies, identify the authority to whom the case should be referred.
Criteria for Urban Housing Board Allotment:
(i) Must be a first-time home buyer.
(ii) Annual income must be below ₹8 Lakh.
Exceptions:
Exception (A): If the candidate is not a first-time buyer but the income is below ₹4 Lakh, refer the case to the Board Chairman.
Exception (B): If the candidate meets both criteria (i) and (ii) but is currently residing in a state-sponsored housing unit, refer the case to the Relocation Committee.
Case: The candidate is not a first-time buyer and has an annual income of ₹3 Lakh. [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
दी गई शर्तों को ध्यान से पढ़ें और प्रदान किए गए मामले के लिए उपयुक्त परिणाम निर्धारित करें। यदि कोई अपवाद लागू हो, तो वह प्राधिकरण पहचानें जिसे मामला भेजा जाना चाहिए।
शहरी आवास बोर्ड आवंटन के मानदंड:
(i) प्रथम बार घर खरीदने वाला होना चाहिए।
(ii) वार्षिक आय ₹8 लाख से कम होनी चाहिए।
अपवाद:
अपवाद (A): यदि अभ्यर्थी प्रथम बार घर खरीदने वाला नहीं है परंतु आय ₹4 लाख से कम है, तो मामला बोर्ड अध्यक्ष को भेजें।
अपवाद (B): यदि अभ्यर्थी दोनों मानदंड (i) और (ii) पूरे करता है परंतु वर्तमान में राज्य प्रायोजित आवास इकाई में निवास कर रहा है, तो मामला पुनर्वास समिति को भेजें।
मामला: अभ्यर्थी प्रथम बार घर खरीदने वाला नहीं है और उसकी वार्षिक आय ₹3 लाख है। [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 2]

2.en: Case to be referred to the Board Chairman
2.hi: मामला बोर्ड अध्यक्ष को भेजा जाए

4.en: Case to be referred to the Relocation Committee
4.hi: मामला पुनर्वास समिति को भेजा जाए

solution.en:
The candidate is not a first-time buyer, so criterion (i) fails.
His income ₹3 Lakh is below ₹4 Lakh, so Exception (A) applies.
Therefore the case goes to the Board Chairman.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Case to be referred to the Board Chairman.
solution.hi:
अभ्यर्थी प्रथम बार घर खरीदने वाला नहीं है, इसलिए मानदंड (i) पूरा नहीं होता।
उसकी आय ₹3 लाख ₹4 लाख से कम है, इसलिए अपवाद (A) लागू होता है।
अतः मामला बोर्ड अध्यक्ष को भेजा जाएगा।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): मामला बोर्ड अध्यक्ष को भेजा जाए है।

question.en:
Policy: A firm approves work-from-home (WFH) if the employee’s ratings are ≥ 4.0/5.0 for each of the last two quarters and the role is remote-eligible. However, a manager will override and deny WFH if there is an ongoing disciplinary inquiry, even when both approval criteria are met.
Employee Profile:
• Ratings: 4.2/5.0 in the previous quarter and 4.5/5.0 in the current quarter
• Role: Remote-eligible
• Disciplinary Status: No ongoing inquiry
Question: Based on the firm’s policy, what is the correct action to take regarding this employee’s WFH request? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
नीति: एक कंपनी कर्मचारी को वर्क-फ्रॉम-होम (WFH) की स्वीकृति तब देती है जब कर्मचारी की रेटिंग पिछली दोनों तिमाहियों में ≥ 4.0/5.0 हो तथा पद रिमोट-योग्य हो। किंतु यदि किसी चल रही अनुशासनात्मक जाँच हो तो प्रबंधक स्वीकृति के दोनों मानदंड पूरे होने पर भी WFH अस्वीकार कर सकता है।
कर्मचारी का विवरण:
• रेटिंग: पिछली तिमाही में 4.2/5.0 तथा वर्तमान तिमाही में 4.5/5.0
• पद: रिमोट-योग्य
• अनुशासनात्मक स्थिति: कोई चल रही जाँच नहीं
प्रश्न: कंपनी की नीति के आधार पर इस कर्मचारी के WFH अनुरोध पर सही कार्रवाई क्या है? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

3.hi: मामला मानव संसाधन विभाग को भेजें

4.en: Approve WFH for one quarter only
4.hi: केवल एक तिमाही के लिए WFH स्वीकृत करें

solution.en:
Both approval criteria are satisfied:
• Ratings — 4.2 and 4.5, both ≥ 4.0 ✓
• Role — remote-eligible ✓
• Disciplinary status — no ongoing inquiry, so there is no ground for the manager to override the approval.
Therefore the request must simply be approved.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Approve WFH.
solution.hi:
स्वीकृति के दोनों मानदंड पूरे होते हैं:
• रेटिंग — 4.2 तथा 4.5, दोनों ≥ 4.0 ✓
• पद — रिमोट-योग्य ✓
• अनुशासनात्मक स्थिति — कोई चल रही जाँच नहीं, अतः प्रबंधक के पास अस्वीकृति का कोई आधार नहीं है।
इसलिए अनुरोध सीधे स्वीकृत किया जाना चाहिए।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): WFH स्वीकृत करें।

question.en:
Read the given conditions carefully and determine the appropriate outcome for the case provided. If any exception applies, identify the authority to whom the case should be referred.
Criteria for Government Tender Eligibility:
(i) Must have state registration.
(ii) Annual turnover must be above ₹2 Crore.
Exceptions:
Exception (A): If the turnover is below ₹2 Crore but the company has received a national quality award, refer the case to the Tender Committee.
Exception (B): If the company meets criteria (i) and (ii) but is currently under blacklisting proceedings by another state department, refer the case to the Legal Compliance Bureau.
Case: The company turnover is ₹1.8 Crore, the company holds a national quality award, and possesses state registration. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
दी गई शर्तों को ध्यान से पढ़िए और दिए गए मामले के लिए उपयुक्त परिणाम निर्धारित कीजिए। यदि कोई अपवाद लागू होता है, तो उस प्राधिकरण की पहचान कीजिए जिसे मामला भेजा जाना चाहिए।
सरकारी निविदा पात्रता के मानदंड:
(i) राज्य में पंजीकरण होना चाहिए।
(ii) वार्षिक कारोबार ₹2 करोड़ से अधिक होना चाहिए।
अपवाद:
अपवाद (A): यदि कारोबार ₹2 करोड़ से कम है किंतु कंपनी को राष्ट्रीय गुणवत्ता पुरस्कार प्राप्त है, तो मामला निविदा समिति को भेजें।
अपवाद (B): यदि कंपनी मानदंड (i) और (ii) पूरा करती है किंतु किसी अन्य राज्य विभाग द्वारा ब्लैकलिस्टिंग की कार्यवाही चल रही है, तो मामला विधिक अनुपालन ब्यूरो को भेजें।
मामला: कंपनी का कारोबार ₹1.8 करोड़ है, कंपनी के पास राष्ट्रीय गुणवत्ता पुरस्कार है तथा राज्य में पंजीकरण भी है। [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

2.en: Case to be referred to the Tender Committee
2.hi: मामला निविदा समिति को भेजा जाए

4.en: Case to be referred to the Legal Compliance Bureau
4.hi: मामला विधिक अनुपालन ब्यूरो को भेजा जाए

solution.en:
Condition (i): state registration — satisfied.
Condition (ii): turnover above ₹2 Crore — the turnover is ₹1.8 Crore, so this condition is not satisfied.
Exception (B) does not apply because the company does not meet condition (ii).
Exception (A) applies exactly: turnover below ₹2 Crore, but the company holds a national quality award — so the case must be referred to the Tender Committee.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Case to be referred to the Tender Committee.
solution.hi:
शर्त (i): राज्य में पंजीकरण — पूरी होती है।
शर्त (ii): कारोबार ₹2 करोड़ से अधिक — कारोबार ₹1.8 करोड़ है, अतः यह शर्त पूरी नहीं होती।
अपवाद (B) लागू नहीं होता, क्योंकि कंपनी शर्त (ii) पूरी नहीं करती।
अपवाद (A) ठीक लागू होता है: कारोबार ₹2 करोड़ से कम है, किंतु कंपनी के पास राष्ट्रीय गुणवत्ता पुरस्कार है — अतः मामला निविदा समिति को भेजा जाना चाहिए।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): मामला निविदा समिति को भेजा जाए।

question.en:
Read the criteria given for a position along with some exceptions and then decide what decision should be taken for the case given.
The following are the requirements for recruiting Tech Corp:
A. At least 75% in class 10th and 12th.
B. At least 70% in Mechanical or Civil Engineering.
C. Age not more than 25 years as on October 09, 2017.
D. At least 60% in selection test.
E. CAD course from a reputed institute.
Exception 1: Fails C only + more than 1 year experience → Refer to Managing Director.
Exception 2: Fails E only + ready to pay ₹35,000+ + at least 75% in graduation → Refer to Chairman.
Case: Nitin has scored 63% marks in the selection test and graduated with 74% marks in Mechanical Engineering. He has completed a CAD course at NIT and was born on 17/10/1994. He got 350 marks out of 500 in class 10th and 900 marks out of 1200 in class 12th. What will be decided in his case? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
किसी पद के लिए दिए गए मानदंडों तथा कुछ अपवादों को पढ़िए और फिर दिए गए मामले में क्या निर्णय लिया जाना चाहिए, यह तय कीजिए।
टेक कॉर्प में भर्ती के लिए निम्नलिखित आवश्यकताएँ हैं:
A. कक्षा 10वीं और 12वीं में कम से कम 75%।
B. मैकेनिकल या सिविल इंजीनियरिंग में कम से कम 70%।
C. 09 अक्टूबर, 2017 को आयु 25 वर्ष से अधिक न हो।
D. चयन परीक्षा में कम से कम 60%।
E. किसी प्रतिष्ठित संस्थान से CAD कोर्स।
अपवाद 1: केवल C में असफल + 1 वर्ष से अधिक अनुभव → प्रबंध निदेशक को भेजें।
अपवाद 2: केवल E में असफल + ₹35,000+ देने को तैयार + स्नातक में कम से कम 75% → अध्यक्ष को भेजें।
मामला: नितिन ने चयन परीक्षा में 63% अंक प्राप्त किए तथा मैकेनिकल इंजीनियरिंग में 74% अंकों के साथ स्नातक किया। उन्होंने NIT से CAD कोर्स पूरा किया है और उनका जन्म 17/10/1994 को हुआ था। उन्होंने कक्षा 10वीं में 500 में से 350 अंक तथा कक्षा 12वीं में 1200 में से 900 अंक प्राप्त किए। उनके मामले में क्या निर्णय लिया जाएगा? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Check every criterion:
A. 10th → 350/500 = 70% (needs 75%) ✗ ; 12th → 900/1200 = 75% ✓
B. 74% in Mechanical Engineering ✓
C. Born 17/10/1994, so on 09/10/2017 he is 22 years 11 months — not more than 25 ✓
D. 63% in the selection test ✓
E. CAD course from NIT ✓
He fails criterion A only (10th marks). Exception 1 applies only when the candidate fails C only, and Exception 2 only when he fails E only, so neither exception applies and the candidate cannot be selected.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Candidate is not selected.
solution.hi:
प्रत्येक मानदंड की जाँच कीजिए:
A. 10वीं → 350/500 = 70% (75% चाहिए) ✗ ; 12वीं → 900/1200 = 75% ✓
B. मैकेनिकल इंजीनियरिंग में 74% ✓
C. जन्म 17/10/1994, अतः 09/10/2017 को आयु 22 वर्ष 11 माह है — 25 से अधिक नहीं ✓
D. चयन परीक्षा में 63% ✓
E. NIT से CAD कोर्स ✓
वे केवल मानदंड A (10वीं के अंक) में असफल हैं। अपवाद 1 तभी लागू होता है जब केवल C में असफलता हो और अपवाद 2 तभी जब केवल E में असफलता हो, अतः कोई अपवाद लागू नहीं होता और अभ्यर्थी चयनित नहीं हो सकता।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): अभ्यर्थी चयनित नहीं है।

question.en:
Under a tax scheme, a full rebate applies if taxable income ≤ ₹5,00,000 and returns are filed before the due date; income between ₹5,00,000–₹7,00,000 filed on time gets a 50% rebate. Filing late forfeits the rebate regardless of income.
Case: taxable income ₹4,80,000, return filed 2 days after the due date. [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
एक कर योजना के अंतर्गत, यदि कर योग्य आय ≤ ₹5,00,000 हो और रिटर्न नियत तिथि से पहले जमा किया गया हो तो पूरी छूट मिलती है; ₹5,00,000–₹7,00,000 के बीच की आय पर समय पर रिटर्न जमा करने पर 50% छूट मिलती है। देर से रिटर्न जमा करने पर आय कुछ भी हो, छूट समाप्त हो जाती है।
मामला: कर योग्य आय ₹4,80,000, रिटर्न नियत तिथि के 2 दिन बाद जमा किया गया। [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
The taxable income is ₹4,80,000, which is within ₹5,00,000, so the full rebate would normally apply.
But the return has been filed 2 days after the due date, and the scheme clearly says that filing late forfeits the rebate regardless of income.
Therefore no rebate is admissible.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): No rebate.
solution.hi:
कर योग्य आय ₹4,80,000 है, जो ₹5,00,000 के भीतर है, अतः सामान्यतः पूरी छूट लागू होती।
किंतु रिटर्न नियत तिथि के 2 दिन बाद जमा किया गया है और योजना स्पष्ट कहती है कि देर से जमा करने पर आय कुछ भी हो, छूट समाप्त हो जाती है।
इसलिए कोई छूट नहीं मिलेगी।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): कोई छूट नहीं।

question.en:
Read the criteria given for a position along with some exceptions and then decide what decision should be taken for the case given.
The following are the requirements for recruiting in Precision Cast Industries, Ludhiana:
A. At least 75% in class 10th and 12th.
B. At least 70% in Mechanical or Civil Engineering.
C. Age not more than 25 years as on October 09, 2017.
D. At least 60% in selection test.
E. CAD course from a reputed institute.
Exception 1: Fails only C + more than 1 year experience at a reputed company → Refer to Managing Director.
Exception 2: Fails only E + willing to pay ₹35,000 or more + at least 75% in graduation → Refer to Chairman.
Case: Karan scored 81% in class 10th and 78% in class 12th. He graduated with 75% in Mechanical Engineering. He scored 60% in the selection test. He has NOT completed a CAD course but is willing to pay ₹50,000. He was born on 08/10/1992 and has no work experience. What will be decided in his case? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
किसी पद के लिए दिए गए मानदंडों तथा कुछ अपवादों को पढ़िए और फिर दिए गए मामले में क्या निर्णय लिया जाना चाहिए, यह तय कीजिए।
लुधियाना की प्रिसिज़न कास्ट इंडस्ट्रीज़ में भर्ती के लिए निम्नलिखित आवश्यकताएँ हैं:
A. कक्षा 10वीं और 12वीं में कम से कम 75%।
B. मैकेनिकल या सिविल इंजीनियरिंग में कम से कम 70%।
C. 09 अक्टूबर, 2017 को आयु 25 वर्ष से अधिक न हो।
D. चयन परीक्षा में कम से कम 60%।
E. किसी प्रतिष्ठित संस्थान से CAD कोर्स।
अपवाद 1: केवल C में असफल + किसी प्रतिष्ठित कंपनी में 1 वर्ष से अधिक अनुभव → प्रबंध निदेशक को भेजें।
अपवाद 2: केवल E में असफल + ₹35,000 या अधिक देने को तैयार + स्नातक में कम से कम 75% → अध्यक्ष को भेजें।
मामला: करण ने कक्षा 10वीं में 81% तथा कक्षा 12वीं में 78% अंक प्राप्त किए। उन्होंने मैकेनिकल इंजीनियरिंग में 75% के साथ स्नातक किया। चयन परीक्षा में उन्होंने 60% अंक प्राप्त किए। उन्होंने CAD कोर्स नहीं किया है किंतु ₹50,000 देने को तैयार हैं। उनका जन्म 08/10/1992 को हुआ और उनका कोई कार्य-अनुभव नहीं है। उनके मामले में क्या निर्णय लिया जाएगा? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Check every criterion:
A. 81% in 10th and 78% in 12th — both at least 75% ✓
B. 75% in Mechanical Engineering — at least 70% ✓
C. Born 08/10/1992, so on 09/10/2017 he has just completed 25 years — not more than 25 years ✓
D. 60% in the selection test — at least 60% ✓
E. No CAD course ✗
He fails only criterion E, but he is willing to pay ₹50,000 (more than ₹35,000) and has 75% in graduation (at least 75%), so Exception 2 applies and the case must be referred to the Chairman.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Refer to the Chairman.
solution.hi:
प्रत्येक मानदंड की जाँच कीजिए:
A. 10वीं में 81% तथा 12वीं में 78% — दोनों 75% या अधिक ✓
B. मैकेनिकल इंजीनियरिंग में 75% — 70% या अधिक ✓
C. जन्म 08/10/1992, अतः 09/10/2017 को उनकी आयु 25 वर्ष पूरी है — 25 वर्ष से अधिक नहीं ✓
D. चयन परीक्षा में 60% — 60% या अधिक ✓
E. CAD कोर्स नहीं ✗
वे केवल मानदंड E में असफल हैं, किंतु वे ₹50,000 (₹35,000 से अधिक) देने को तैयार हैं और स्नातक में उनके 75% (75% या अधिक) अंक हैं, अतः अपवाद 2 लागू होता है और मामला अध्यक्ष को भेजा जाना चाहिए।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): अध्यक्ष को भेजें।

question.en:
A telecom operator automatically upgrades a customer to the premium plan if their monthly data usage exceeds 50GB in each of 3 consecutive months, provided there are no overdue payments. A customer uses 55GB, 52GB, and 48GB over three consecutive months, and has no overdue payments.
What is the customer’s upgrade status? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
एक टेलीकॉम ऑपरेटर किसी ग्राहक को स्वतः प्रीमियम प्लान में अपग्रेड करता है यदि लगातार 3 महीनों में से प्रत्येक में उसका मासिक डेटा उपयोग 50GB से अधिक हो, बशर्ते कोई बकाया भुगतान न हो। एक ग्राहक ने लगातार तीन महीनों में 55GB, 52GB तथा 48GB उपयोग किया और उसका कोई बकाया भुगतान नहीं है।
ग्राहक की अपग्रेड स्थिति क्या है? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 3]

3.en: Customer must apply manually to upgrade
3.hi: ग्राहक को अपग्रेड के लिए स्वयं आवेदन करना होगा

solution.en:
The condition is that data usage must exceed 50GB in each of three consecutive months.
Usage in the three months is 55GB ✓, 52GB ✓ and 48GB ✗ — the third month is below 50GB.
Since the condition is not fulfilled, the customer is not upgraded, even though there are no overdue payments.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Not upgraded.
solution.hi:
शर्त यह है कि लगातार तीन महीनों में से प्रत्येक में डेटा उपयोग 50GB से अधिक हो।
तीन महीनों का उपयोग 55GB ✓, 52GB ✓ तथा 48GB ✗ है — तीसरे महीने में यह 50GB से कम है।
शर्त पूरी न होने के कारण ग्राहक अपग्रेड नहीं होगा, चाहे कोई बकाया भुगतान न हो।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): अपग्रेड नहीं।

question.en:
Read the given situation carefully and consider all the relevant facts, conditions and constraints. Choose the option that represents the most appropriate, practical and logical decision based solely on the information provided.

A logistics firm promotes delivery supervisors if they have completed 2 years of service, have zero active customer complaints and have an attendance rate above 95%. Nitin has worked with the firm for 3 years, has an attendance rate of 97%, but has 1 active customer complaint registered against him last month.

What decision should be taken? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
दी गई परिस्थिति को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए तथा सभी संबंधित तथ्यों, शर्तों और प्रतिबंधों पर विचार कीजिए। वह विकल्प चुनिए जो केवल दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर सबसे उपयुक्त, व्यावहारिक तथा तार्किक निर्णय दर्शाता है।

एक लॉजिस्टिक्स कंपनी डिलीवरी सुपरवाइज़रों को पदोन्नति तब देती है जब उन्होंने 2 वर्ष की सेवा पूरी कर ली हो, उनके विरुद्ध ग्राहक शिकायत सक्रिय न हो तथा उपस्थिति दर 95% से अधिक हो। नितिन ने कंपनी के साथ 3 वर्ष कार्य किया है, उसकी उपस्थिति दर 97% है, किंतु पिछले महीने उसके विरुद्ध 1 सक्रिय ग्राहक शिकायत दर्ज हुई है।

क्या निर्णय लिया जाना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 1]

1.en: The candidate should be rejected for promotion.
1.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पदोन्नति के लिए अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।

2.en: The candidate should be selected for promotion.
2.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पदोन्नति के लिए चुना जाना चाहिए।

3.en: The application should be referred to the Director.
3.hi: आवेदन निदेशक को निर्दिष्ट किया जाना चाहिए।

4.en: The data provided is inadequate to take a decision.
4.hi: निर्णय लेने के लिए दी गई जानकारी अपर्याप्त है।

solution.en:
The conditions for promotion are cumulative: service of at least 2 years, zero active customer complaints and attendance above 95%.
Nitin satisfies the service condition (3 years) and the attendance condition (97%), but he fails the condition of having zero active complaints, because one complaint is still registered against him.
Since even one active complaint disqualifies a candidate, his application must be rejected; nothing in the data is missing and no referral to a higher authority is warranted.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): The candidate should be rejected for promotion.
solution.hi:
पदोन्नति की शर्तें संचयी हैं: कम से कम 2 वर्ष की सेवा, कोई सक्रिय ग्राहक शिकायत न होना तथा 95% से अधिक उपस्थिति।
नितिन सेवा की शर्त (3 वर्ष) तथा उपस्थिति की शर्त (97%) पूरी करता है, किंतु शून्य सक्रिय शिकायत की शर्त पूरी नहीं करता, क्योंकि उसके विरुद्ध एक शिकायत अभी सक्रिय है।
एक भी सक्रिय शिकायत अभ्यर्थी को अपात्र बना देती है, अतः उसका आवेदन अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए; जानकारी में कोई कमी नहीं है और उच्च अधिकारी को निर्दिष्ट करने का कोई कारण नहीं है।

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): अभ्यर्थी को पदोन्नति के लिए अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।

question.en:
An organisation promotes an employee to senior grade if they have ≥ 5 years in the current grade, no red flag in the last two annual reviews, and have cleared the departmental exam. Employees with ≥ 7 years but who have not cleared the exam instead get a financial upgradation only (no grade change).
Employee: 6 years in grade, no red flags, exam not cleared. [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
एक संगठन कर्मचारी को वरिष्ठ ग्रेड में पदोन्नत करता है यदि उनके पास वर्तमान ग्रेड में ≥ 5 वर्ष हैं, पिछले दो वार्षिक समीक्षाओं में कोई रेड फ्लैग नहीं है और उन्होंने विभागीय परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण की है। जिनके पास ≥ 7 वर्ष हैं परंतु परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण नहीं की, उन्हें ग्रेड परिवर्तन के बजाय केवल वित्तीय उन्नयन मिलता है।
कर्मचारी: ग्रेड में 6 वर्ष, कोई रेड फ्लैग नहीं, परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण नहीं। [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Grade promotion needs both ≥ 5 years and the departmental exam, and the exam is not cleared, so promotion is ruled out
The financial upgradation needs ≥ 7 years, but the employee has only 6 years
So the employee is neither promoted nor given an upgradation

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Not promoted, no upgradation.
solution.hi:
ग्रेड पदोन्नति के लिए ≥ 5 वर्ष तथा विभागीय परीक्षा दोनों आवश्यक हैं और परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण नहीं है, अतः पदोन्नति नहीं हो सकती
वित्तीय उन्नयन के लिए ≥ 7 वर्ष चाहिए, परंतु कर्मचारी के पास केवल 6 वर्ष हैं
अतः कर्मचारी को न पदोन्नति मिलेगी और न उन्नयन

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): पदोन्नति नहीं, कोई उन्नयन नहीं है।

question.en:
A credit card limit is automatically increased after 12 consecutive months of on-time payments with utilization below 30%. Conversely, a utilization of 30–50% with on-time payments triggers a manual review.
Scenario: A cardholder has made 12 months of on-time payments and has a utilization of 35%. What is the outcome? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
12 लगातार महीनों तक समय पर भुगतान और 30% से कम उपयोग पर क्रेडिट कार्ड की सीमा स्वतः बढ़ा दी जाती है। इसके विपरीत, समय पर भुगतान के साथ 30–50% उपयोग होने पर मैनुअल समीक्षा शुरू होती है।
परिदृश्य: एक कार्डधारक ने 12 महीने समय पर भुगतान किया है और उसका उपयोग 35% है। परिणाम क्या होगा? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Automatic increase needs utilization below 30%, but the utilization is 35%, so the automatic increase does not apply
A utilization between 30% and 50% with on-time payments triggers a manual review, which is exactly this case
So a manual review is triggered

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Manual review triggered.
solution.hi:
स्वतः वृद्धि के लिए उपयोग 30% से कम होना चाहिए, परंतु उपयोग 35% है, अतः स्वतः वृद्धि लागू नहीं होती
समय पर भुगतान के साथ 30% से 50% के बीच उपयोग मैनुअल समीक्षा शुरू करता है, और यही स्थिति यहाँ है
अतः मैनुअल समीक्षा शुरू होगी

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): मैनुअल समीक्षा शुरू होती है है।

question.en:
Question: A store's exclusive refund policy states that a store-credit refund is given for items returned within 30 days of purchase without a receipt, provided the tags are attached. A cash refund requires a receipt and a return within 15 days of purchase. No other rules apply.
Scenario: An item is returned 20 days after purchase without a receipt, but with the tags attached. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]
question.hi:
प्रश्न: एक दुकान की विशिष्ट रिफंड नीति कहती है कि बिना रसीद के खरीद के 30 दिनों के भीतर लौटाए गए सामान पर स्टोर-क्रेडिट रिफंड दिया जाता है, बशर्ते टैग लगे हों। नकद रिफंड के लिए रसीद तथा खरीद के 15 दिनों के भीतर वापसी आवश्यक है। कोई अन्य नियम लागू नहीं है।
परिदृश्य: कोई सामान खरीद के 20 दिन बाद बिना रसीद के लौटाया जाता है, परंतु टैग लगे हैं। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
A cash refund needs a receipt and a return within 15 days, and here there is no receipt and the return is on the 20th day, so no cash refund is possible
A store-credit refund needs a return within 30 days without a receipt and the tags attached, and all three conditions are met here
So a store-credit refund is given

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Store-credit refund.
solution.hi:
नकद रिफंड के लिए रसीद तथा 15 दिनों के भीतर वापसी आवश्यक है, और यहाँ रसीद नहीं है और वापसी 20वें दिन हुई है, अतः नकद रिफंड संभव नहीं
स्टोर-क्रेडिट रिफंड के लिए बिना रसीद 30 दिनों के भीतर वापसी तथा टैग लगा होना आवश्यक है, और यहाँ तीनों शर्तें पूरी होती हैं
अतः स्टोर-क्रेडिट रिफंड दिया जाएगा

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): स्टोर-क्रेडिट रिफंड है।

question.en:
Read the eligibility criteria given for the post carefully and answer the question that follows.
Eligibility Criteria for Assistant Section Officer (ASO):
1. Age: 18–27 years.
2. Physical standard: Height of at least 165 cm.
3. Must hold a valid driving license.
Case: Rohan is 25 years old, 168 cm tall, and does not possess a driving license.
What should be done in Rohan's case? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
पद के लिए दी गई पात्रता शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़िए और आगे दिए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
सहायक अनुभाग अधिकारी (ASO) के लिए पात्रता शर्तें:
1. आयु: 18–27 वर्ष।
2. शारीरिक मानक: कम से कम 165 सेमी की लंबाई।
3. वैध ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस होना आवश्यक है।
मामला: रोहन 25 वर्ष का है, 168 सेमी लंबा है और उसके पास ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस नहीं है।
रोहन के मामले में क्या किया जाना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Rohan is 25 years old, which is within the age limit of 18 to 27 years, so the age condition is satisfied
His height is 168 cm, which is more than the required 165 cm, so the height condition is also satisfied
He does not hold a driving license, which is the third requirement, so this condition fails
Hence Rohan is not eligible because he has no driving license

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Not Eligible (No driving license).
solution.hi:
रोहन 25 वर्ष का है, जो 18 से 27 वर्ष की आयु सीमा में है, अतः आयु की शर्त पूरी होती है
उसकी लंबाई 168 सेमी है, जो आवश्यक 165 सेमी से अधिक है, अतः लंबाई की शर्त भी पूरी होती है
उसके पास ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस नहीं है, जो तीसरी आवश्यकता है, अतः यह शर्त पूरी नहीं होती
इसलिए रोहन ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस न होने के कारण अपात्र है

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): अपात्र (ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस नहीं) है।

question.en:
Read the given conditions carefully and determine the appropriate outcome for the case provided. If any exception applies, identify the authority to whom the case should be referred.
Criteria for Data Center Administrator Selection:
(i) Degree in Computer Science.
(ii) 4+ years of network experience.
Exceptions:
Exception 1: If a candidate has a Degree in Computer Science and exactly 3 years of network experience, provided they hold a professional certification, the case must be referred to the Department Head.
Exception 2: If a candidate has a Degree in Computer Science and 5+ years of network experience, they are eligible for a direct promotion to Senior Administrator.
Case: The candidate holds a degree in Computer Science, has 3 years of network experience, and possesses a relevant professional certification. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
दी गई शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़िए और दिए गए मामले के लिए उपयुक्त परिणाम निर्धारित कीजिए। यदि कोई अपवाद लागू होता है, तो वह प्राधिकारी पहचानिए जिसे मामला भेजा जाना चाहिए।
डेटा सेंटर प्रशासक चयन के लिए मानदंड:
(i) कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में डिग्री।
(ii) 4+ वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव।
अपवाद:
अपवाद 1: यदि किसी अभ्यर्थी के पास कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में डिग्री और ठीक 3 वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव है, बशर्ते उसके पास पेशेवर प्रमाणन हो, तो मामला विभागाध्यक्ष को भेजा जाना चाहिए।
अपवाद 2: यदि किसी अभ्यर्थी के पास कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में डिग्री और 5+ वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव है, तो वह वरिष्ठ प्रशासक के पद पर सीधी पदोन्नति के लिए पात्र है।
मामला: अभ्यर्थी के पास कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में डिग्री है, 3 वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव है और प्रासंगिक पेशेवर प्रमाणन है। [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

2.en: Candidate is rejected as they do not meet the primary criteria of 4+ years of network experience.
2.hi: अभ्यर्थी को अस्वीकार किया जाता है क्योंकि वह 4+ वर्ष के नेटवर्क अनुभव की प्राथमिक शर्त पूरी नहीं करता।

3.en: Refer the case to the Department Head.

4.en: Candidate is eligible for direct promotion to Senior Administrator based on their experience and professional certification.
4.hi: अनुभव और पेशेवर प्रमाणन के आधार पर अभ्यर्थी वरिष्ठ प्रशासक पर सीधी पदोन्नति के लिए पात्र है।

solution.en:
The main criteria need 4 or more years of network experience, and the candidate has only 3 years, so the case does not fit the main rule
Exception 1 covers exactly a candidate with a Computer Science degree, exactly 3 years of network experience and a professional certification, and all three are present here
So the case must be referred to the Department Head, while Exception 2 needs 5 or more years and does not apply
Hence the case is referred to the Department Head

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Refer the case to the Department Head.
solution.hi:
मुख्य मानदंड के लिए 4 या अधिक वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव चाहिए और अभ्यर्थी के पास केवल 3 वर्ष हैं, अतः मामला मुख्य नियम में नहीं बैठता
अपवाद 1 ठीक उसी अभ्यर्थी के लिए है जिसके पास कंप्यूटर विज्ञान की डिग्री, ठीक 3 वर्ष का नेटवर्क अनुभव तथा पेशेवर प्रमाणन हो, और यहाँ तीनों उपस्थित हैं
अतः मामला विभागाध्यक्ष को भेजा जाना चाहिए, जबकि अपवाद 2 के लिए 5 या अधिक वर्ष चाहिए और वह लागू नहीं होता
इसलिए मामला विभागाध्यक्ष को भेजा जाएगा

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (3): मामला विभागाध्यक्ष को भेजा जाए। है।

question.en:
Read the given situation carefully and consider all the relevant facts, conditions and constraints. Choose the option that represents the most appropriate, practical and logical decision based solely on the information provided.
A corporate venture fund accelerates green tech innovations under three parameters: The technology must reduce carbon output by at least 20%, must use scalable recycled materials and must have a commercial launch plan ready. A new enterprise presents a technology that reduces carbon emissions by 25% and uses recycled materials, but has not yet formulated a commercial launch plan.
What decision should the fund managers make? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
दी गई परिस्थिति को ध्यान से पढ़िए और सभी प्रासंगिक तथ्यों, शर्तों तथा बाधाओं पर विचार कीजिए। वह विकल्प चुनिए जो केवल दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त, व्यावहारिक तथा तार्किक निर्णय दर्शाता है।
एक कॉर्पोरेट वेंचर फंड हरित प्रौद्योगिकी नवाचारों को तीन मानदंडों पर आगे बढ़ाता है: प्रौद्योगिकी को कार्बन उत्सर्जन कम से कम 20% घटाना चाहिए, मापनीय पुनर्चक्रित सामग्री का उपयोग करना चाहिए तथा वाणिज्यिक लॉन्च योजना तैयार होनी चाहिए। एक नया उद्यम ऐसी प्रौद्योगिकी प्रस्तुत करता है जो कार्बन उत्सर्जन 25% घटाती है और पुनर्चक्रित सामग्री का उपयोग करती है, परंतु उसने वाणिज्यिक लॉन्च योजना अभी तैयार नहीं की है।
फंड के प्रबंधकों को क्या निर्णय लेना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

1.en: The enterprise should be rejected for venture acceleration.
1.hi: उद्यम को वेंचर त्वरण के लिए अस्वीकार कर दिया जाना चाहिए।

2.en: The enterprise should be selected for venture acceleration.
2.hi: उद्यम को वेंचर त्वरण के लिए चुना जाना चाहिए।

3.en: The application should be referred to the Managing Partner.
3.hi: आवेदन प्रबंध भागीदार को भेजा जाना चाहिए।

4.en: The data provided is inadequate to take a decision.
4.hi: निर्णय लेने के लिए दिया गया डेटा अपर्याप्त है।

solution.en:
The fund requires all three conditions to be met, and here the carbon reduction of 25% and the use of recycled materials are satisfied
The third condition of a ready commercial launch plan is not met, and the rules say nothing about referring such cases elsewhere
So the enterprise fails one mandatory parameter and the application must be rejected
Hence the enterprise should be rejected for venture acceleration

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): The enterprise should be rejected for venture acceleration.
solution.hi:
फंड के लिए तीनों शर्तें पूरी होना आवश्यक है, और यहाँ 25% कार्बन कमी तथा पुनर्चक्रित सामग्री का उपयोग पूरा होता है
तैयार वाणिज्यिक लॉन्च योजना की तीसरी शर्त पूरी नहीं होती, और नियम ऐसे मामलों को कहीं और भेजने की बात नहीं कहते
अतः उद्यम एक अनिवार्य मानदंड में असफल है और आवेदन अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए
इसलिए उद्यम को वेंचर त्वरण के लिए अस्वीकार कर देना चाहिए

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): उद्यम को वेंचर त्वरण के लिए अस्वीकार कर दिया जाना चाहिए। है।

question.en:
Read the eligibility criteria given for the post carefully and answer the question that follows.
Eligibility Criteria for Bank Probationary Officer (PO):
1. Must be a Graduate with at least 60% aggregate.
2. Age limit: 21–30 years.
3. Must possess basic computer knowledge.
Case: Simran is 24 years old, a graduate with 58% marks, and has a computer certificate.
What should be done in Simran's case? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
पद के लिए दी गई पात्रता शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़िए और आगे दिए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।
बैंक प्रोबेशनरी ऑफ़िसर (PO) के लिए पात्रता शर्तें:
1. स्नातक होना चाहिए और न्यूनतम 60% कुल अंक होने चाहिए।
2. आयु सीमा: 21–30 वर्ष।
3. बुनियादी कंप्यूटर ज्ञान होना चाहिए।
मामला: सिमरन 24 वर्ष की है, 58% अंकों के साथ स्नातक है और उसके पास कंप्यूटर प्रमाणपत्र है।
सिमरन के मामले में क्या किया जाना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Simran is 24 years old and lies within the age limit of 21 to 30 years, so the age condition is satisfied
She holds a computer certificate, so the computer knowledge condition is also satisfied
Her graduation marks are 58%, which is below the required 60%, so the marks condition fails
Hence she is not eligible because her marks are less

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Not Eligible (Marks less).
solution.hi:
सिमरन 24 वर्ष की है और 21 से 30 वर्ष की आयु सीमा में है, अतः आयु की शर्त पूरी होती है
उसके पास कंप्यूटर प्रमाणपत्र है, अतः कंप्यूटर ज्ञान की शर्त भी पूरी होती है
उसके स्नातक अंक 58% हैं, जो आवश्यक 60% से कम हैं, अतः अंकों की शर्त पूरी नहीं होती
इसलिए वह अंक कम होने के कारण अपात्र है

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (2): अपात्र (अंक कम) है।

question.en:
Read the given conditions carefully and determine the appropriate outcome for the case provided. If any exception applies, identify the authority to whom the case should be referred.
Criteria for a manager position:
1. Age requirement: 25 to 35 years on 01.01.2026.
2. Qualification: Graduate from any institution with at least 60 percent marks.
3. Experience: 2 years of work experience in the related field.
Exception: If a candidate does not meet the qualification criteria but has 5+ years of experience, the case is referred to the HR Head.
Case: Rohan was born on 15.05.1995. He is a graduate with 55% marks and has 6 years of experience. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]
question.hi:
दी गई शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़िए और दिए गए मामले के लिए उपयुक्त परिणाम निर्धारित कीजिए। यदि कोई अपवाद लागू होता है, तो वह प्राधिकारी पहचानिए जिसे मामला भेजा जाना चाहिए।
प्रबंधक पद के लिए मानदंड:
1. आयु शर्त: 01.01.2026 को 25 से 35 वर्ष।
2. योग्यता: किसी भी संस्थान से स्नातक, न्यूनतम 60 प्रतिशत अंकों के साथ।
3. अनुभव: संबंधित क्षेत्र में 2 वर्ष का कार्य अनुभव।
अपवाद: यदि अभ्यर्थी योग्यता मानदंड पूरा नहीं करता परंतु उसके पास 5+ वर्ष का अनुभव है, तो मामला मानव संसाधन प्रमुख को भेजा जाता है।
मामला: रोहन का जन्म 15.05.1995 को हुआ। वह 55% अंकों के साथ स्नातक है और उसके पास 6 वर्ष का अनुभव है। [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

3.en: Data inadequate to make any decision

4.hi: मानव संसाधन प्रमुख को भेजा गया

solution.en:
On 01.01.2026 Rohan is 30 years old, which is within the age limit of 25 to 35 years, so the age condition is satisfied
His experience of 6 years is more than the required 2 years, so the experience condition is satisfied
His marks are 55%, which is less than the required 60%, so the qualification condition fails, but he has more than 5 years of experience and the exception covers exactly this case
Hence the case must be referred to the HR Head

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Referred to HR Head.
solution.hi:
01.01.2026 को रोहन 30 वर्ष का है, जो 25 से 35 वर्ष की आयु सीमा में है, अतः आयु की शर्त पूरी होती है
उसका 6 वर्ष का अनुभव आवश्यक 2 वर्ष से अधिक है, अतः अनुभव की शर्त पूरी होती है
उसके अंक 55% हैं, जो आवश्यक 60% से कम हैं, अतः योग्यता की शर्त पूरी नहीं होती, परंतु उसके पास 5 वर्ष से अधिक अनुभव है और अपवाद ठीक इसी स्थिति के लिए है
इसलिए मामला मानव संसाधन प्रमुख को भेजा जाना चाहिए

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (4): मानव संसाधन प्रमुख को भेजा गया है।

question.en:
Read the given situation carefully and consider all the relevant facts, conditions, and constraints. Choose the option that represents the most appropriate, practical and logical decision based solely on the information provided.
An IT company selects Systems Administrators based on the following criteria: The candidate must be a Computer Science graduate with at least 60% marks, must be at least 21 years old as of January 1, 2026 and must have cleared the technical assessment with a minimum score of 70%. Rajesh is a Computer Science graduate with 68% marks, was born on May 12, 2002 and scored 75% in the technical assessment.
What decision should be made regarding his application? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]
question.hi:
दी गई स्थिति को ध्यान से पढ़िए तथा सभी प्रासंगिक तथ्यों, शर्तों और सीमाओं पर विचार कीजिए। केवल दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त, व्यावहारिक तथा तार्किक निर्णय वाला विकल्प चुनिए।
एक आईटी कंपनी निम्न मानदंडों पर सिस्टम एडमिनिस्ट्रेटर चुनती है: अभ्यर्थी कंप्यूटर साइंस में स्नातक हो और उसके कम से कम 60% अंक हों, 1 जनवरी 2026 को उसकी आयु कम से कम 21 वर्ष हो तथा उसने तकनीकी मूल्यांकन में कम से कम 70% अंक प्राप्त किए हों। राजेश कंप्यूटर साइंस में स्नातक है, उसके 68% अंक हैं, उसका जन्म 12 मई 2002 को हुआ है तथा उसने तकनीकी मूल्यांकन में 75% अंक प्राप्त किए हैं।
उसके आवेदन के संबंध में क्या निर्णय लिया जाना चाहिए? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

1.en: The candidate should be selected for the position.
1.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए चुना जाना चाहिए।

2.en: The candidate should be rejected for the position.
2.hi: अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए अस्वीकार किया जाना चाहिए।

3.en: The application should be referred to the IT Director.
3.hi: आवेदन आईटी निदेशक को भेजा जाना चाहिए।

4.en: The data provided is inadequate to take a decision.
4.hi: निर्णय लेने के लिए दिया गया डेटा अपर्याप्त है।

solution.en:
Rajesh is a Computer Science graduate with 68% marks, which is more than the required 60% ✔
He was born on 12 May 2002, so on 1 January 2026 he is 23 years old, which is more than the required 21 years ✔
He scored 75% in the technical assessment, which is more than the required 70% ✔
All three conditions are satisfied, so he should be selected for the position

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): The candidate should be selected for the position.
solution.hi:
राजेश कंप्यूटर साइंस में स्नातक है और उसके 68% अंक हैं, जो आवश्यक 60% से अधिक हैं ✔
उसका जन्म 12 मई 2002 को हुआ, अतः 1 जनवरी 2026 को वह 23 वर्ष का है, जो आवश्यक 21 वर्ष से अधिक है ✔
उसने तकनीकी मूल्यांकन में 75% अंक प्राप्त किए, जो आवश्यक 70% से अधिक हैं ✔
तीनों शर्तें पूरी होती हैं, अतः उसे पद के लिए चुना जाना चाहिए

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प (1): अभ्यर्थी को पद के लिए चुना जाना चाहिए। है।

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The professor gave a lucid explanation of the concept. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Lucid (स्पष्ट) = clear and easy to understand.
Confusing (भ्रमित) = unclear
Clear (स्पष्ट) = easy to understand ✔
Dark (अंधेरा) = obscure; complicated (जटिल) = complex; synonyms: coherent, intelligible.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Clear.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The researcher was meticulous in recording data. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meticulous (सूक्ष्मता से काम करने वाला) = extremely careful and precise.
Careless (लापरवाह) = negligent
Hasty (जल्दबाज) = rushed
Thorough (पूर्ण) = complete and careful ✔
Casual (आकस्मिक) = informal or unconcerned.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Thorough.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: BANTER [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Banter (हँसी-मज़ाक) = light, playful conversation.
Chitchat (गपशप) = informal conversation ✔
Ridicule (उपहास) = mockery
Argument (बहस) = dispute; lecture (व्याख्यान) = formal talk.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): chitchat.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: INSCRUTABLE [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Inscrutable (दुरूह) = impossible to understand.
Mysterious (रहस्यमय) = difficult to explain ✔
Transparent (पारदर्शी) = clear
Understandable (समझने योग्य) = comprehensible; obvious (स्पष्ट) = evident.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Mysterious.

question.en: What is the synonym of the word “proponent”? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Proponent (समर्थक) = a person advocating something.
Critic (आलोचक) = one who finds fault
Detractor (निंदक) = disparager
Opponent (विरोधी) = adversary
Supporter (समर्थक) = advocate ✔

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Supporter.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: IMPECUNIOUS [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Impecunious (निर्धन) = having little or no money.
Poor (गरीब) = lacking money ✔
Affluent (धनी) = wealthy
Wealthy (संपन्न) = rich; rich (अमीर) = affluent; synonyms: penniless, indigent.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Poor.

question.en: What is the synonym of the word “serene”? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Serene (शांत) = calm and peaceful.
Calm (शांत) = peaceful ✔
Bright (चमकीला) = shining
Angry (क्रोधित) = irate; disturbed (अशांत) = agitated.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Calm.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: NEFARIOUS [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Nefarious (दुष्ट) = wicked or criminal.
Just (न्यायपूर्ण) = fair
Virtuous (सदाचारी) = moral
Good (अच्छा) = virtuous
Wicked (दुष्ट) = evil ✔

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): wicked.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: LUGUBRIOUS [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Lugubrious (शोकपूर्ण) = sad and mournful.
Bright (उज्ज्वल) = cheerful or shining
Mournful (शोकपूर्ण) = sorrowful ✔
Happy (प्रसन्न) = joyful; hopeful (आशावान) = optimistic.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Mournful.

question.en: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: INDEMNIFY [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Indemnify (क्षतिपूर्ति करना) = compensate for loss or damage.
Charge (शुल्क लेना) = demand payment
Remunerate (पारिश्रमिक देना) = pay or compensate ✔
Tax (कर लगाना) = levy; fine (जुर्माना) = penalize.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Remunerate.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The storm began to abate after several hours. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Abate (कम होना) = become less intense.
Intensify (तीव्र करना) = increase
Diminish (कम होना) = decrease ✔
Destroy (नष्ट करना) = ruin; delay (टालना) = postpone.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Diminish.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
She took a pragmatic approach to solving the problem. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक) = practical rather than theoretical.
Idealistic (आदर्शवादी) = guided by ideals
Emotional (भावुक) = driven by feelings
Practical (व्यावहारिक) = realistic and workable ✔
Theoretical (सैद्धांतिक) = abstract.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Practical.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Excoriate [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Excoriate (कड़ी निंदा करना) = to criticise someone very severely.
Praise (प्रशंसा करना) = to express approval ✔
Berate (डाँटना) = to scold angrily – synonym
Condemn (निंदा करना) = to express strong disapproval – synonym
Rebuke (फटकारना) = to reprimand sharply – synonym
More antonyms: commend, laud, extol.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Praise.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Crepuscular [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Crepuscular (संध्याकालीन, गोधूलि का) = relating to twilight; (of animals) active at dawn and dusk.
Diurnal (दिनचर) = active in full daytime ✔
Dusk (साँझ) = the darker stage of twilight – related, not opposite
Dim (धुँधला) = not bright – similar to twilight
Twilight (गोधूलि) = the time of soft light after sunset – synonym
More antonyms: daytime, broad-daylight.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Diurnal.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

The professor was known for his abstruse lecturing style. [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Abstruse (दुर्बोध) = difficult to understand.
Simple (सरल) = easy to understand ✔
Complex (जटिल) = complicated – synonym
Recondite (गूढ़) = little known, obscure – synonym
Obscure (अस्पष्ट) = not clear – synonym
More antonyms: lucid, clear, plain.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Simple.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

His speech was marred by a certain infelicity of expression that confused the audience. [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Infelicity (अनुपयुक्तता) = an unsuitable or inappropriate expression or remark.
Appropriateness (उपयुक्तता) = being suitable or proper ✔
Unhappiness (दुख) = sadness – an older sense of infelicity, not opposite
Misfortune (दुर्भाग्य) = bad luck – close to infelicity, not opposite
Awkwardness (भद्दापन) = clumsiness – synonym
More antonyms: aptness, suitability, felicity.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Appropriateness.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.Prudent [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Prudent (विवेकी, समझदार) = acting with care and thought for the future.
Reckless (लापरवाह) = acting without thinking of danger ✔
Wise (बुद्धिमान) – synonym
Thoughtful (विचारशील) – synonym
Careful (सावधान) – synonym
More antonyms: rash, imprudent, careless.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Reckless.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

The new law had a pernicious effect on the local economy. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Pernicious (अत्यंत हानिकारक) = having a harmful effect, especially gradually.
Beneficial (लाभदायक) = having a good effect ✔
Harmful (हानिकारक) – synonym
Damaging (नुकसानदायक) – synonym
Deleterious (हानिकारक) – synonym
More antonyms: advantageous, wholesome, salutary.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Beneficial.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Peregrinate [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Peregrinate (भ्रमण करना, यात्रा करना) = to travel or wander from place to place.
Stay (ठहरना) = to remain in one place ✔
Wander (भटकना) – synonym
Roam (घूमना) – synonym
Travel (यात्रा करना) – synonym
More antonyms: remain, settle, abide.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Stay.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Intransigent [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Intransigent (हठी, अड़ियल) = refusing to change one's views or agree.
Flexible (लचीला) = willing to change or compromise ✔
Unyielding (न झुकने वाला) – synonym
Dogmatic (हठधर्मी) – synonym
Obstinate (ज़िद्दी) – synonym
More antonyms: compliant, accommodating, amenable.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Flexible.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Sententious [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Sententious (उपदेशात्मक, आडंबरपूर्ण) = given to pompous moralising.
Unpretentious (सरल, आडंबरहीन) = simple and modest ✔
Moralistic (नीतिवादी) – synonym
Terse (संक्षिप्त) = brief – an older sense of sententious (pithy), not opposite
Concise (संक्षिप्त) – also close to the 'pithy' sense
More antonyms: modest, humble, plain-spoken.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Unpretentious.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Jejune [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Jejune (नीरस, फीका) = dull and uninteresting; naive.
Interesting (रोचक) ✔
Insipid (फीका) – synonym
Bland (नीरस) – synonym
Dull (उबाऊ) – synonym
More antonyms: stimulating, engaging, mature.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Interesting.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Enigmatic [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Enigmatic (रहस्यमय) = difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious.
Lucid (स्पष्ट) = clear and easy to understand ✔
Obscure (अस्पष्ट) – synonym
Arcane (गूढ़) – synonym
Ambiguous (द्व्यर्थक, अस्पष्ट) – synonym
More antonyms: clear, transparent, plain.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Lucid.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word "sophisticated"? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Sophisticated (परिष्कृत, जटिल) = highly developed and complex; worldly and refined.
Simple (सरल) = plain, not complex ✔
Controlled (नियंत्रित) – unrelated
Cultured (सुसंस्कृत) – synonym
Refined (परिष्कृत) – synonym
More antonyms: naive, unrefined, crude.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Simple.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Zealous [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Zealous (उत्साही, जोशीला) = full of great energy or enthusiasm.
Apathetic (उदासीन) = showing no interest or enthusiasm ✔
Ardent (उत्साही) – synonym
Fervent (जोशीला) – synonym
Eager (उत्सुक) – synonym
More antonyms: indifferent, unenthusiastic, half-hearted.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Apathetic.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Altruism [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Altruism (परोपकार) = selfless concern for the well-being of others.
Egoism (अहंवाद, स्वार्थ) = concern only for oneself ✔
Selflessness (निःस्वार्थता) – synonym
Generosity (उदारता) – synonym
Charity (दान) – synonym
More antonyms: selfishness, self-interest, egotism.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Egoism.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

The committee’s admonition regarding the safety breach was taken seriously by the staff. [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Admonition (चेतावनी, फटकार) = a firm warning or reprimand.
Commendation (प्रशंसा) = formal praise ✔
Counsel (सलाह) = advice – close to admonition
Forewarning (पूर्व चेतावनी) – synonym
Reprimand (फटकार) – synonym
More antonyms: praise, approval, applause.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Commendation.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The witness was accused of being mendacious during the trial. [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Mendacious (झूठा) = telling lies or being untruthful.
Dishonest (बेईमान) = not honest
Truthful (सत्यवादी) = telling the truth ✔
False (झूठा) = not true
Deceitful (धोखेबाज) = misleading others
More antonyms: honest, veracious, sincere.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Truthful.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The witness gave a murky account of the incident, making it hard to follow. [SSC CGL 06/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Murky (धुंधला, अस्पष्ट) = dark, unclear or difficult to understand.
Dark (अंधेरा) = lacking light
Gloomy (उदास) = dark or depressing
Obscure (अस्पष्ट) = not clearly expressed
Clear (स्पष्ट) = easy to understand ✔
More antonyms: lucid, transparent, plain.

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Clear.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Tacit [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Tacit (अकथित, मौन) = understood or implied without being stated.
Expressed (अभिव्यक्त) = stated openly in words ✔
Implied (निहित) = suggested but not directly stated
Informed (सूचित) = having or giving information
Understood (समझा गया) = grasped mentally
More antonyms: explicit, stated, declared.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Expressed.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Recalcitrant [SSC CGL 07/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Recalcitrant (हठी, उद्दंड) = stubbornly refusing to obey authority.
Defiant (विद्रोही) = openly resistant
Compliant (आज्ञाकारी) = willing to obey ✔
Disobedient (अवज्ञाकारी) = refusing to follow rules
Rebellious (विद्रोही) = resisting authority
More antonyms: obedient, submissive, tractable.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Compliant.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Internecine [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Internecine (पारस्परिक विनाशकारी) = destructive to both sides within a group.
Internal (आंतरिक) = situated within
External (बाहरी) = situated outside
Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण) = free from conflict ✔
Civil (नागरिक/विनम्र) = relating to citizens or polite
More antonyms: peaceful, amicable, concordant.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Harmonious.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Inveterate [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Inveterate (पक्का, दीर्घकालीन) = firmly established by long habit.
Chronic (पुराना) = persisting for a long time
Casual (आकस्मिक) = occasional and without firm commitment ✔
Habitual (आदतन) = done regularly as a habit
Long-standing (दीर्घकालीन) = existing for a long time
More antonyms: occasional, incidental, sporadic.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Casual.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Somniferous [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Somniferous (निद्राजनक) = inducing sleep.
Somnolent (उनींदा) = sleepy
Sedative (शामक) = calming or sleep-promoting
Stimulant (उत्तेजक) = increasing alertness and activity ✔
Sleep-inducing (नींद लाने वाला) = causing sleep
More antonyms: invigorating, alerting, activating.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Stimulant.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Obsolete [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Obsolete (अप्रचलित) = no longer produced, used or useful.
Ancient (प्राचीन) = belonging to the distant past
Current (वर्तमान) = belonging to the present time ✔
Useless (बेकार) = serving no purpose
Outdated (पुराना) = old-fashioned
More antonyms: modern, contemporary, up-to-date.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Current.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Copious [SSC CGL 08/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Copious (प्रचुर) = abundant in quantity or supply.
Prolix (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण) = using too many words
Scarce (दुर्लभ, अपर्याप्त) = insufficient or rare ✔
Comprehensive (व्यापक) = covering all aspects
Voluminous (विशाल) = very large or extensive
More antonyms: meagre, sparse, scanty.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Scarce.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Placate [SSC CGL 09/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Placate (शांत करना) = make someone less angry or hostile.
Soothe (शांत करना) = calm or comfort
Appease (संतुष्ट करना) = pacify by meeting demands
Infuriate (क्रोधित करना) = make extremely angry ✔
Calm (शांत करना) = make tranquil
More antonyms: enrage, provoke, antagonize.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Infuriate.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Voluble [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Voluble (वाचाल) = speaking fluently and at length.
Talkative (बातूनी) = fond of talking
Garrulous (अधिक बोलने वाला) = excessively talkative
Reticent (अल्पभाषी) = reserved and reluctant to speak ✔
Chatty (गपशप करने वाला) = inclined to chat
More antonyms: taciturn, reserved, uncommunicative.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Reticent.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The villagers were destitute after the devastating floods. [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Destitute (निर्धन) = lacking the basic necessities of life.
Wealthy (धनवान) = having abundant money and possessions ✔
Penniless (निर्धन) = having no money
Needy (जरूरतमंद) = lacking necessities
Poor (गरीब) = having little money
More antonyms: affluent, prosperous, rich.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Wealthy.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
At the editor's request, the author agreed to abridge the book's final chapter. [SSC CGL 10/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Abridge (संक्षिप्त करना) = shorten a text without losing its essential meaning.
Shorten (छोटा करना) = reduce in length
Condense (संघनित करना) = make more concise
Expand (विस्तार करना) = increase in length or scope ✔
Curtail (कम करना) = cut short
More antonyms: enlarge, lengthen, elaborate.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Expand.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Quiescent [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Quiescent (शांत, निष्क्रिय) = inactive or at rest.
Dormant (सुप्त) = temporarily inactive
Active (सक्रिय) = engaged in action ✔
Silent (मौन) = without sound
Passive (निष्क्रिय) = not acting
More antonyms: dynamic, lively, vigorous.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Active.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Pellucid [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Pellucid (स्पष्ट, पारदर्शी) = transparent or easy to understand.
Limpid (निर्मल) = clear and transparent
Transparent (पारदर्शी) = allowing light through
Murky (धुंधला) = dark and unclear ✔
Clear (स्पष्ट) = easy to see or understand
More antonyms: opaque, cloudy, obscure.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Murky.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Gregarious [SSC CGL 12/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Gregarious (मिलनसार) = fond of company and sociable.
Social (सामाजिक) = enjoying interaction
Reserved (संकोची) = slow to reveal feelings or mix freely ✔
Friendly (मिलनसार) = kind and approachable
Outgoing (खुला-मिलनसार) = socially confident
More antonyms: withdrawn, reclusive, unsociable.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Reserved.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Ignaminious [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Ignominious (अपमानजनक) = deserving or causing public disgrace.
Honorable (सम्माननीय) = deserving respect ✔
Shameful (लज्जाजनक) = causing shame
Disgraceful (अपमानजनक) = bringing dishonour
Infamous (कुख्यात) = famous for something bad
More antonyms: reputable, respectable, esteemed.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Honorable.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The prime minister gave a perfunctory nod to the reporters. [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Perfunctory (औपचारिकता मात्र) = done with minimal effort or care.
Thorough (पूर्ण, गहन) = done with great care and completeness ✔
Hasty (जल्दबाज) = done hurriedly
Casual (अनौपचारिक) = informal or unconcerned
Careless (लापरवाह) = lacking attention
More antonyms: meticulous, diligent, attentive.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Thorough.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The school enforced stringent rules regarding student attendance. [SSC CGL 13/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Stringent (कठोर) = strict, precise and demanding.
Lax (ढीला) = not sufficiently strict ✔
Firm (दृढ़) = resolute
Rigorous (कठोर) = extremely thorough and strict
Strict (सख्त) = demanding obedience
More antonyms: lenient, flexible, permissive.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Lax.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The witness gave a precise account of the incident. [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Precise (यथार्थ) = exact and accurate.
Specific (विशिष्ट) = clearly identified
Exact (यथार्थ) = strictly correct
Inaccurate (अशुद्ध) = containing errors ✔
Correct (सही) = free from error
More antonyms: imprecise, vague, approximate.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Inaccurate.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
He is merely a dilettante who paints for fun but lacks any formal training. [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Dilettante (शौकिया) = a person who pursues an art without serious professional commitment.
Amateur (शौकिया) = non-professional
Dabbler (शौक में लिप्त) = someone with superficial interest
Professional (व्यावसायिक) = trained and engaged professionally ✔
Tyro (नौसिखिया) = beginner
More antonyms: expert, specialist, master.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Professional.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Magnanimous [SSC CGL 14/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Magnanimous (उदार) = generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival.
Noble (महान) = morally admirable
Forgiving (क्षमाशील) = ready to pardon
Petty (छोटी सोच वाला) = small-minded and mean ✔
Generous (उदार) = willing to give
More antonyms: mean-spirited, spiteful, uncharitable.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Petty.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Vituperative [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Vituperative (गालीपूर्ण) = bitterly abusive.
Complimentary (प्रशंसापूर्ण) = expressing praise ✔
Abusive (अपमानजनक) = insulting
Scolding (डाँटने वाला) = rebuking
Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी) = seeking revenge; other antonyms: laudatory, approving.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Complimentary.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Acquiescent [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Acquiescent (सहमत) = ready to accept without protest.
Agreeable (सहमत) = willing to agree
Obliging (सहायक) = willing to help
Obdurate (हठी) = stubbornly refusing to change ✔
Obsequious (चापलूस) = excessively obedient; other antonyms: resistant, defiant.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Obdurate.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The teacher gave the students ample time to complete the examination. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Ample (पर्याप्त से अधिक) = more than enough.
Plentiful (प्रचुर) = existing in large amounts
Sufficient (पर्याप्त) = enough; abundant (भरपूर) = plentiful
Meagre (अपर्याप्त) = small or insufficient ✔

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Meagre.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The Chairman decided to convene a meeting of all the board members. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Convene (बुलाना) = call people together for a meeting.
Gather (इकट्ठा करना) = bring together
Assemble (सभा करना) = gather; summon (बुलाना) = call
Disperse (तितर-बितर करना) = scatter ✔

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Disperse.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The new software update was compatible with all older versions of the hardware. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Compatible (संगत) = able to work together without conflict.
Consistent (संगत) = in agreement
Conflicting (विरोधी) = incompatible or opposed ✔
Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण) = in agreement; adaptable (अनुकूलनीय) = adjustable.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Conflicting.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The lawyers tried to protract the trial by filing unnecessary motions. [SSC CGL 15/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Protract (लंबा खींचना) = prolong.
Prolong (लंबा करना) = extend
Curtail (छोटा करना) = shorten or reduce ✔
Extend (बढ़ाना) = make longer; lengthen (लंबा करना) = prolong.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Curtail.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Rehabilitation [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Rehabilitation (पुनर्वास) = restoration to health or normal functioning.
Recuperation (स्वास्थ्यलाभ) = recovery
Deterioration (गिरावट) = worsening ✔
Restoration (पुनर्स्थापना) = repair; adjustment (समायोजन) = adaptation.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Deterioration.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Euphoria [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Euphoria (अत्यधिक हर्ष) = intense happiness.
Bliss (परमानंद) = perfect joy
Elation (हर्षोन्माद) = great happiness
Despair (निराशा) = complete loss of hope ✔
Joy (आनंद) = happiness; other antonyms: gloom, misery.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Despair.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Benevolent [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Benevolent (परोपकारी) = kind and generous.
Charitable (दानशील) = generous
Kind (दयालु) = caring
Cruel (क्रूर) = deliberately causing suffering ✔
Gentle (कोमल) = mild and kind; other antonyms: malevolent, unkind.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Cruel.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “ostensible”? [SSC CGL 16/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Ostensible (प्रकट/दिखावटी) = appearing true but not necessarily actual.
Real (वास्तविक) = genuine or actual ✔
Depressed (उदास) = sad
Illogical (अतार्किक) = unreasonable; unpredictable (अप्रत्याशित) = uncertain.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Real.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “mendacious”? [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Mendacious (मिथ्यावादी) = dishonest or untruthful.
Truthful (सत्यवादी) = honest ✔
Hidden (छिपा) = concealed
Joyful (आनंदित) = happy; depressed (उदास) = dejected.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Truthful.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Trivial [SSC CGL 22/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Trivial (तुच्छ) = unimportant.
Insignificant (महत्वहीन) = unimportant
Vital (अत्यावश्यक) = essential ✔
Petty (तुच्छ) = minor; small (छोटा) = little; other antonyms: significant, crucial.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Vital.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Adorn [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Adorn (सजाना) = decorate or beautify.
Decorate (सजाना) = adorn
Disfigure (बिगाड़ना) = spoil the appearance ✔
Beautify (सुंदर बनाना) = improve appearance; accessorize = add accessories.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Disfigure.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “tenacious”? [SSC CGL 23/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Tenacious (दृढ़) = persistent and determined.
Hesitant (संकोची) = reluctant or lacking determination ✔
Angry describes emotion; “flated” is not an antonym.
Strong is closer to a synonym.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Hesitant.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Lament [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Lament (विलाप करना) = express sorrow.
Celebrate (जश्न मनाना) = express joy ✔
Mourn (शोक करना) = grieve
Wail (विलाप करना) = cry loudly; grieve (दुःखी होना) = sorrow.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Celebrate.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The historian spent years attempting to establish the verity of the ancient scrolls. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Verity (सत्यता) = truthfulness or truth.
Authenticity (प्रामाणिकता) = genuineness
Probity (सत्यनिष्ठा) = integrity
Mendacity (झूठ) = dishonesty ✔
Rectitude (नेकी) = moral correctness

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Mendacity.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The team's morose attitude after the defeat was visible to everyone. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Morose (उदास) = gloomy and sullen.
Gloomy (उदास) = depressed
Sullen (खिन्न) = resentfully silent
Cheerful (प्रसन्न) = happy ✔
Glum (उदास) = dejected.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Cheerful.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The young pop star was surrounded by the adulation of her millions of fans. [SSC CGL 24/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Adulation (अत्यधिक प्रशंसा) = excessive admiration.
Criticism (आलोचना) = disapproval ✔
Praise (प्रशंसा) = approval
Worship (पूजा) = reverence; flattery (चापलूसी) = excessive praise.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Criticism.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Mitigate [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Mitigate (कम करना) = reduce severity.
Intensify (तीव्र करना) = increase in strength ✔
Reduce (घटाना) = lessen
Pacify (शांत करना) = calm; ease (कम करना) = alleviate.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Intensify.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The dictator was obsessed with the aggrandizement of his own power and wealth. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Aggrandizement (विस्तार/बढ़ोतरी) = increase in power or status.
Exaltation (उत्कर्ष) = elevation
Ennoblement (उत्कृष्ट बनाना) = elevation
Abasement (अपमान/पतन) = degradation ✔
Glorification (महिमामंडन) = exaltation

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Abasement.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “intrepid”? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Intrepid (निर्भय) = fearless and adventurous.
Fearless (निर्भय) = unafraid
Humble (विनम्र) = modest
Timid (डरपोक) = fearful ✔
Clear (स्पष्ट) = obvious.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Timid.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Succinct [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Succinct (संक्षिप्त) = briefly and clearly expressed.
Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण) = using too many words ✔
Concise (संक्षिप्त) = brief
Terse (संक्षिप्त) = brief; brief (अल्प) = short.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Verbose.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “lucid”? [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Lucid (स्पष्ट) = clear and easy to understand.
Bright (तेज) = vivid or intelligent
Clear (स्पष्ट) = intelligible
Confused (अस्पष्ट) = unclear ✔
Transparent (पारदर्शी) = clear.

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Confused.

question.en: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word “Murky”. [SSC CGL 27/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Murky (धुंधला) = dark or unclear.
Lucid (स्पष्ट) = clear ✔
Doubtful (संदिग्ध) = uncertain
Mysterious (रहस्यमय) = obscure; confusing (भ्रमित) = unclear.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Lucid.

question.en: What is the antonym of the word “meticulous”? [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meticulous (सूक्ष्मता से काम करने वाला) = very careful.
Careless (लापरवाह) = negligent ✔
Detailed (विस्तृत) = thorough
Flexible (लचीला) = adaptable; precise (यथार्थ) = exact.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Careless.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Detrimental [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Detrimental (हानिकारक) = harmful.
Helpful (लाभदायक) = beneficial ✔
Harmful (हानिकारक) = damaging
Damaging (क्षतिकर) = injurious; toxic (विषैला) = poisonous.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Helpful.

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Apathy [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Apathy (उदासीनता) = lack of interest or feeling.
Indifference (उदासीनता) = unconcern
Passion (जुनून) = intense feeling ✔
Disinterest (अरुचि) = lack of interest; detachment (अलगाव) = emotional distance.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Passion.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The editor praised the columnist for the brevity of her political analysis. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Brevity (संक्षिप्तता) = concise expression.
Prolixity (शब्दाडंबर) = excessive wordiness ✔
Conciseness (संक्षिप्तता) = brevity
Pithiness (सारगर्भितता) = concise force; terse (संक्षिप्त) = brief

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Prolixity.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The witness provided corroborative evidence that supported the suspect's alibi. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Corroborative (पुष्टिकारक) = supporting with evidence.
Contradictory (विरोधी) = conflicting ✔
Supporting (समर्थक) = corroborating
Confirming (पुष्टि करने वाला) = verifying; validating = confirming.

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Contradictory.

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The basketball team was looking for a lanky player to defend the post. [SSC CGL 28/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Lanky (लंबा-दुबला) = tall and thin.
Tall (लंबा) = of great height
Thin (पतला) = slim; gaunt (दुबला) = lean and haggard
Stocky (गठीला) = short and broad ✔

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Stocky.

question.en:
The Indian government has appointed a new diplomat to head the official residence and office representing India in France.

What is the correct one-word substitute for “the official residence and office representing India in France”? [SSC CGL 30/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Embassy (दूतावास) = the official residence and office of an ambassador representing his country in a foreign capital.
France is not a Commonwealth country, so India's mission in Paris is an embassy.
Consulate (वाणिज्य दूतावास) = office of a consul in a city other than the capital, handling visas and trade
High Commission (उच्चायोग) = mission of one Commonwealth country in another
Chancery (कुलाधिकार कार्यालय) = only the office section of an embassy, not the residence

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Embassy.

question.en: Choose the correct one-word substitution for: ‘The act of stealing from shops’. [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Shoplifting (दुकान से चोरी) = stealing goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer.
Robbery (डकैती) = stealing from a person using force or threat
Looting (लूटपाट) = stealing during riots, war or disorder
Burglary (सेंधमारी) = breaking into a building to steal

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Shoplifting.

question.en: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'A person who flatters for personal gain.' [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Sycophant (चाटुकार) = a person who flatters important people to gain an advantage.
Altruist (परोपकारी) = a person who selflessly helps others
Protégé (शिष्य, संरक्षित व्यक्ति) = a person guided and supported by an experienced person
Mentor (मार्गदर्शक) = an experienced adviser

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Sycophant.

question.en: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'Pleasure derived from others' misfortune.' [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Schadenfreude (दूसरों के दुख पर खुशी) = pleasure felt at another person's misfortune.
Antipathy (घृणा, विरक्ति) = a strong feeling of dislike
Empathy (समानुभूति) = the ability to share another's feelings
Sympathy (सहानुभूति) = feeling sorry for someone's trouble

Hence, the correct answer is option (2): Schadenfreude.

question.en: What is the correct one-word substitution for "descent from an ancestor; family or ancestral line"? [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Lineage (वंश, कुल) = direct descent from an ancestor; ancestral line.
Heritage (विरासत) = traditions, culture or property passed down
Dynasty (राजवंश) = a line of rulers from the same family
Legacy (विरासत, धरोहर) = something left behind by a person for later generations

Hence, the correct answer is option (3): Lineage.

question.en: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'Travelling from place to place for work.' [SSC CGL 01/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Peripatetic (घुमंतू) = travelling from place to place, especially for work.
Premedieval (मध्ययुग-पूर्व) = belonging to the period before the Middle Ages
Wayfarer (पथिक) = a traveller on foot – a person, not the act of travelling for work
Sedentary (गतिहीन) = sitting a lot; staying in one place – opposite

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Peripatetic.

question.en: Which of the following is a one-word substitution for a life-sized model of the human body used to display clothes? [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Mannequin (पुतला) = a life-size model of the human body used to display clothes in shops.
Sculptor (मूर्तिकार) = an artist who makes sculptures
Tailor (दर्ज़ी) = a person who makes or alters clothes
Designer (डिज़ाइनर) = a person who plans the look of clothes or objects

Hence, the correct answer is option (1): Mannequin.

question.en:
Choose the appropriate one-word substitution for:

A person who composes music. [SSC CGL 05/10/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Composer (संगीतकार) = a person who writes music.
Vocalist (गायक) = a person who sings, especially in a band
Singer (गायक) = a person who sings
Lyricist (गीतकार) = a person who writes the words of songs

Hence, the correct answer is option (4): Composer.
